visit:1.en: It was rare for a disciple from another sect to come to Cloud Sea. The *visit* lasted only one afternoon, yet the young stranger walked every terrace and studied each herb garden with quiet, careful eyes. Master Qingwu watched from the high arch and said nothing at all.
visit:1.cnHint: 一位外宗弟子前来____，只待了一个下午，却将每座草药园都仔细看了一遍。
visit:1.hook: Before he left, the stranger paused and wrote one word in the dust.
visit:1.line: 'This *visit* tells us more about them than they intend,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: It was rare for a disciple from another sect to come to Cloud Sea.
sentences.cn: 外宗的弟子来云海很少见。

sentences.en: The *visit* lasted only one afternoon, yet the young stranger walked every terrace and studied each herb garden with quiet, careful eyes.
Master Qingwu watched from the high arch and said nothing at all.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从高拱门那边看着，什么都没说。

worry:1.en: I carried the morning's herb list to the outer garden, but two plants on it were missing. A small *worry* settled in my chest as I counted the empty patches a second time. Shen Wujiu found me there and read the list over my shoulder without a word.
worry:1.cnHint: 晨间草药清单上有两株不见了，我心生____，数了第二遍仍是如此。
worry:1.hook: Shen Wujiu's face, when he finished reading, was carefully blank.
worry:1.line: 'Your *worry* is reasonable — someone was here before dawn,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: I carried the morning's herb list to the outer garden, but two plants on it were missing.
sentences.cn: 我把早上的采摘单拿到外花园，可单子上的两种植物不见了。

sentences.en: A small *worry* settled in my chest as I counted the empty patches a second time.
Shen Wujiu found me there and read the list over my shoulder without a word.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎找到我的时候，默不作声地从我肩膀后面读了一遍单子。

adapt:1.en: The terrace gardens changed with every season, and new disciples had to *adapt* quickly or lose whole batches of herbs. I spent the first cool morning replanting the frost-shy roots closer to the warm eastern stones. Xiaoxing watched me work and clapped softly when the last root settled in.
adapt:1.cnHint: 新弟子必须迅速____季节变化，我把怕霜的草根移到向阳的东侧石边。
adapt:1.hook: Xiaoxing's smile faded as clouds rolled over the eastern peak.
adapt:1.line: 'You must *adapt* your planting before the frost comes tonight,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: The terrace gardens changed with every season, and new disciples had to *adapt* quickly or lose whole batches of herbs.
I spent the first cool morning replanting the frost-shy roots closer to the warm eastern stones.
sentences.cn: 我花了第一个凉爽的早晨，把怕霜的根系重新移到东边暖和的石头旁。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing watched me work and clapped softly when the last root settled in.
sentences.cn: 小杏看着我干活，最后一根根系落稳时轻轻鼓起掌来。

bit:1.en: Master Qingwu handed me a formula carved on a thin strip of bark. I read it once, then again, understanding only a *bit* of its meaning — enough to know it described something powerful, not enough to know whether it was a cure or a warning. The bark felt warm.
bit:1.cnHint: 师尊递给我一张树皮符文，我只读懂了其中的一____，却已感到它非同寻常。
bit:1.hook: The bark grew warmer the longer I held it.
bit:1.line: 'Even a small *bit* of this formula can change a cloud's path,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu handed me a formula carved on a thin strip of bark.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊递给我一条刻着公式的薄树皮。

sentences.en: I read it once, then again, understanding only a *bit* of its meaning — enough to know it described something powerful, not enough to know whether it was a cure or a warning.
The bark felt warm.
sentences.cn: 树皮是温热的。

check:1.en: Before the outer gate was sealed for the night, Shen Wujiu walked the full length of the herb terrace to *check* that every marker stone stood in its place. I followed a few steps behind, noting the ones that had shifted since morning. The last stone was missing entirely.
check:1.cnHint: 夜间封门前，师兄沿草药台阶逐一____标记石，最后一块却不见了。
check:1.hook: Where the last stone had stood, the earth was freshly turned.
check:1.line: '*Check* each marker before you leave — order here is not decoration,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Before the outer gate was sealed for the night, Shen Wujiu walked the full length of the herb terrace to *check* that every marker stone stood in its place.
I followed a few steps behind, noting the ones that had shifted since morning.
sentences.cn: 我跟在他身后几步远，留意着那些自晨间以来有所移动的石碑。

sentences.en: The last stone was missing entirely.
sentences.cn: 最后一块石碑彻底不见了。

easily:1.en: The stone steps of Cloud Sea Sect wound upward through pale mist. I had expected the climb to leave me breathless, but Shen Wujiu moved so *easily* that his white robe barely shifted. He paused, turned, and offered his hand with a quiet smile. Above us, the peak was already glowing.
easily:1.cnHint: 师兄在云雾中____地攀上石阶，令我惊叹不已。
easily:1.hook: But the glow was not sunlight — something had awakened above.
easily:1.line: 'A true disciple *easily* reads the mountain's breath before their first step.'

sentences.en: The stone steps of Cloud Sea Sect wound upward through pale mist.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的石阶蜿蜒向上，穿过苍白的雾气。

sentences.en: I had expected the climb to leave me breathless, but Shen Wujiu moved so *easily* that his white robe barely shifted.
He paused, turned, and offered his hand with a quiet smile.
sentences.cn: 他停下脚步，转身，用一个温静的笑容向我伸出手。

sentences.en: Above us, the peak was already glowing.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶的山峰已经开始发光。

protect:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a slow circle in the air with her brush. A faint ring of pale light settled around the courtyard gate. 'Words spoken with true intent can *protect* what force alone cannot hold,' she said. The other disciples bowed. I pressed the phrase into memory like a seed into soil.
protect:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊用一句话语____了整个山门，弟子们静静聆听。
protect:1.hook: Then the gate lantern flickered, and no wind was blowing.
protect:1.line: 'Learn this word well — it may *protect* you when the cloud breaks.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a slow circle in the air with her brush.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊用毛笔在空中缓缓画出一道圆。

sentences.en: A faint ring of pale light settled around the courtyard gate.
sentences.cn: 一圈淡淡的苍白光晕落在院门周围。

sentences.en: 'Words spoken with true intent can *protect* what force alone cannot hold,' she said.
The other disciples bowed.
sentences.cn: 其他弟子都低了头。

sentences.en: I pressed the phrase into memory like a seed into soil.
sentences.cn: 我把那句话压进记忆里，就像把种子按进土壤。

advantage:1.en: Shen Wujiu laid three spirit-herb scrolls on the flat rock between us. 'Knowing the name of a herb before you need it is your greatest *advantage*,' he said. I copied each character with care. Far below, the sea of clouds shifted, swallowing a distant peak whole.

advantage:1.hook: The swallowed peak had held the oldest word-garden in the sect.
advantage:1.line: 'Name a thing rightly, and its name becomes your *advantage*.'

break:1.en: The morning gong sounded, and Master Qingwu called it a *break* in the day's recitation. Disciples scattered across the stone terrace, whispering half-learned formulas to the open air. Xiaoxing found me at the edge, watching a hawk ride a thermal upward through the mist.
break:1.cnHint: 师尊宣布一天诵读中途____，弟子们在露台上小歇片刻。
break:1.hook: The hawk carried something silver in its talons, and it was flying toward our peak.
break:1.line: 'Use every *break* wisely — the mountain does not rest between lessons.'

Disciples scattered across the stone terrace, whispering half-learned formulas to the open air.

conclude:1.en: After three rounds of recitation, Master Qingwu folded her hands and let silence hold the hall for a long moment. 'We *conclude* today's lesson with a question, not an answer,' she said softly. She wrote one unknown word on the board and left it there, unanswered, as the candles dimmed.
conclude:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊以一个问题____了今天的课程，答案留给弟子自己寻找。
conclude:1.hook: The unknown word on the board began, very slowly, to glow.
conclude:1.line: 'When you can *conclude* the meaning from context alone, you are ready.'

sentences.en: After three rounds of recitation, Master Qingwu folded her hands and let silence hold the hall for a long moment.

figure:1.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the carved stone at the sect entrance. A tall *figure* was cut into it — neither clearly man nor spirit, arms raised toward the clouds, mouth open as if speaking. 'That is the First Disciple,' she said. 'Every word we study was found by them, one by one.'
figure:1.cnHint: 小星指着门口石碑上的____，讲述了第一位弟子寻找字语的故事。
figure:1.hook: I noticed the carved mouth had been worn smooth — as if many hands had touched it in silence.
figure:1.line: 'Study that *figure* well — its posture is itself the first formula.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the carved stone at the sect entrance.

fit:1.en: Master Qingwu handed me a small jade tablet etched with a beginner's formula. I turned it over and tried to *fit* the words to the feeling rising in my chest — something warm, something half-remembered. The tablet hummed once, faintly, and then went still in my palm.
fit:1.cnHint: 我试着将玉牌上的字语____心中那股隐约的感应，玉牌随之轻鸣。
fit:1.hook: A second hum answered from somewhere deep beneath the floating mountain.
fit:1.line: 'Find the word that will *fit* the feeling — that is the whole art.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu handed me a small jade tablet etched with a beginner's formula.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊递给我一块小玉牌，上面刻着初学者的咒语。

sentences.cn: 玉牌轻轻嗡鸣了一声，然后在我掌心里静止了下来。

particular:1.en: Shen Wujiu stopped me at the herb-terrace gate and pointed to one *particular* plant among dozens — its leaves pale silver, its stem no thicker than a brush handle. 'That one has a name that can calm a storm,' he said quietly. 'Learn it before the season turns.'

particular:1.hook: Behind us, the wind shifted, and the season, it seemed, was already turning.
particular:1.line: 'This *particular* word is rare — do not waste it on a small wind.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stopped me at the herb-terrace gate and pointed to one *particular* plant among dozens — its leaves pale silver, its stem no thicker than a brush handle.
'That one has a name that can calm a storm,' he said quietly.

sentences.en: 'Learn it before the season turns.'
sentences.cn: 季节改变前把它学会。

stick:1.en: The stone path wound to the edge of the floating mountain, where morning mist hung like a held breath. Master Qingwu pressed a word-herb against the cracked rock, and I watched it *stick* firmly to the surface, its green light seeping inward like ink into cloth. 'Hold it there,' she said. 'The mountain must accept it.' Far below, the sea of clouds churned.

stick:1.hook: Beneath our feet, the mountain gave a single, deep groan.
stick:1.line: 'Let the word *stick* to the stone before you speak the next syllable.'

sentences.cn: 石路蜿蜒到浮山的边缘，晨雾在那里悬挂得像一口屏住的呼吸。

sentences.en: Far below, the sea of clouds churned.

effective:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small scroll at the outer gate, where wind swept loose petals from the sky-plum trees. 'This formula is the most *effective* one for sealing cracks in the mountain path,' he said, his voice calm and sure. I read it twice, feeling its syllables settle in my chest like warm stones. The gate lantern flickered once and went still.

effective:1.hook: Then a second crack split the path, wider than the first.

sentences.cn: 沈无咎在外门递给我一卷小纸条，天梅树的花瓣被风吹得漫天飘洒。

I read it twice, feeling its syllables settle in my chest like warm stones.

sentences.en: The gate lantern flickered once and went still.
sentences.cn: 门灯闪烁了一次，然后归于静止。

fear:1.en: At the outer terrace, clouds rolled in fast, swallowing the lower peaks whole. Xiaoxing stood beside me, her robe pressed flat by the wind. I felt a sharp *fear* rise in my throat — not of falling, but of the silence the clouds carried with them, as though every word in the world had been erased. She took one quiet breath and wrote a single character in the air.
fear:1.cnHint: 站在外台上，我心中升起一阵____，不是因为高处，而是因为云雾中奇异的寂静。
fear:1.hook: The character she wrote began, slowly, to bleed light.
fear:1.line: '*Fear* is just a word that has not yet found its formula.'

sentences.en: At the outer terrace, clouds rolled in fast, swallowing the lower peaks whole.
sentences.cn: 在外层平台上，云团快速滚入，吞没了下方的山峰。

hit:1.en: We practiced breath-casting on the wide stone terrace below the first arch. I released my word three times; the first two faded like smoke. The third time, the syllable *hit* the target stone square at its centre, and a ring of pale blue light spread outward across the ground. Shen Wujiu nodded once. Somewhere above, a bell rang that no one had touched.
hit:1.cnHint: 练习时，我第三次出声，字力终于精准地____到了靶心石上。
hit:1.hook: The bell rang again — and there was no bell tower on this peak.
hit:1.line: 'Let the word build until it can *hit* the stone without force.'

sentences.cn: 我们在第一拱门下方的宽阔石台上练习了词咒。

assume:1.en: Master Qingwu met us on the herb path where luminous roots crossed the stone like sleeping veins. 'Do not *assume* a word has only one meaning,' she said, turning a silver-leafed herb in her fingers. 'This one heals. It also locks. The mountain taught it both, and the mountain does not forget.' I looked at the herb and felt the ground tilt, very slightly, beneath me.
assume:1.cnHint: 师尊告诫我们，不要____一个字只有一种含义，因为每株字草都身兼数用。
assume:1.hook: The silver leaf curled shut, as if it had heard her.
assume:1.line: 'Never *assume* a healing word cannot also become a seal.'

sentences.cn: 我看着那株草药，感觉脚下的地面微微倾斜。

generally:1.en: Xiaoxing walked me through the seed garden on the eastern ledge, where rows of unspoken words lay dormant in dark soil. '*Generally* the blue-stem words wake first,' she said, crouching to brush one with her finger. 'But this season something is wrong — none of them have opened.' She stood, and her shadow fell long across the silent rows. The clouds below us rose a little higher.

generally:1.line: '*Generally* you would hear them humming by the third dawn.'

sentences.en: The clouds below us rose a little higher.
sentences.cn: 我们下方的云升高了一些。

interaction:1.en: On the bridge between the second and third peaks, Master Qingwu set two word-stones side by side and stepped back. 'Watch the *interaction*,' she said. The two stones pulsed in turn, their light weaving together until a third shape rose between them — something none of us had seen named before. She wrote it down without speaking. The bridge swayed once in still air.

interaction:1.line: 'The *interaction* of two words can birth a third that neither word knows.'

sentences.cn: 那座桥在静止的空气中摇晃了一次。

top:1.en: I climbed to the *top* of the gate pillar at dawn to hang the new word-banner, as Shen Wujiu had shown me. From there the whole Cloud Sea spread below, white and still as a held thought. I tied the last knot and looked down — and saw, carved into the pillar just beneath my feet, a word I did not recognize, older than anything in the sect's library.

top:1.line: 'At the *top* of every pillar there is a word the sect has not yet read.'

fruit:1.en: The outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect smelled of morning dew and old bark. Master Qingwu held up a small, glowing orb and said it was the *fruit* of ten years spent learning the Word of Renewal — one seed of meaning, grown patient and full. I cupped it in both hands and felt warmth spread to my wrists.

fruit:1.hook: Then the orb pulsed once, and the light turned the colour of a warning.
fruit:1.line: 'This *fruit* took me ten years — do not let it fall,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me to pick up the stone marked with the Word of Burden.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎让我拿起刻有"负担之词"的石头。

sentences.en: The moment I touched it, I felt a *weight* far beyond stone — something pressing from the inside out, like a held breath looking for a way free.

academic:1.en: At the archive hall built into the cliff face, rows of scrolls glowed faintly in the dim light. Xiaoxing said the older scrolls held *academic* records of every word ever mastered at Cloud Sea Sect — names, dates, and the exact moment each disciple first made a word respond. She ran one finger along a shelf and stopped without saying why.
academic:1.cnHint: 师妹介绍说，崖壁档案堂里存放着宗门的____记录，记载着每个弟子的修炼节点。
academic:1.hook: Her finger rested on a scroll with no name on its cover.
academic:1.line: 'The *academic* records never lie — your first response will be written here,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: At the archive hall built into the cliff face, rows of scrolls glowed faintly in the dim light.
sentences.cn: 悬崖凿出的档案殿里,一排排经卷在昏暗中隐隐发光。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing said the older scrolls held *academic* records of every word ever mastered at Cloud Sea Sect — names, dates, and the exact moment each disciple first made a word respond.
She ran one finger along a shelf and stopped without saying why.
sentences.cn: 她沿着书架滑动一根手指,在某处停下,什么也没说。

consequence:1.en: The stone path outside the Sect gate was silent at dawn. I had skipped my morning recitation, thinking no one would notice. But Master Qingwu stood at the gate, eyes calm as still water. 'Every skipped word has a *consequence*,' she said. 'The cloud you cannot name will carry you nowhere.' A cold wind rose from below the mountain.
consequence:1.cnHint: 我逃掉了晨课，却在山门口遇见了师尊，她说每一个被忽略的词语都有____。
consequence:1.hook: Below the gate, the clouds parted — revealing nothing but darkness.
consequence:1.line: 'Every skipped word has a *consequence*,' Master Qingwu said softly.

sentences.en: The stone path outside the Sect gate was silent at dawn.
sentences.cn: 清晨时,宗门山门外的石径寂无一人。

sentences.en: I had skipped my morning recitation, thinking no one would notice.
sentences.cn: 我逃过了早课念诵,以为没人会发现。

sentences.en: But Master Qingwu stood at the gate, eyes calm as still water.
sentences.cn: 但青梧师尊站在山门口,眼神平静如镜面般的水。

sentences.en: 'Every skipped word has a *consequence*,' she said.
'The cloud you cannot name will carry you nowhere.'
sentences.cn: "你叫不出名字的云,载不了你去任何地方。"

sentences.en: A cold wind rose from below the mountain.
sentences.cn: 山下吹起一阵冷风。

realize:1.en: I stood at the outer terrace, watching cloud-mist curl around the lower peaks. Shen Wujiu handed me a small herb — a word-leaf of healing. Only when it dissolved on my tongue did I *realize* how dry and tired my voice had grown from days of silent study. The herb tasted of rain and something older. Far below, a bell rang once and stopped.
realize:1.cnHint: 直到药草在舌尖化开，我才____自己的声音已因长期沉默而变得多么疲惫。
realize:1.hook: The bell rang once — and the clouds below began to glow.
realize:1.line: 'You will *realize* its value only when your voice fails you,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: I stood at the outer terrace, watching cloud-mist curl around the lower peaks.
sentences.cn: 我站在外阳台上,看云雾在下面的山峰间翻卷。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small herb — a word-leaf of healing.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一片小草药——一片治愈的字叶。

sentences.en: Only when it dissolved on my tongue did I *realize* how dry and tired my voice had grown from days of silent study.
The herb tasted of rain and something older.
sentences.cn: 那草药尝起来像雨水,还有什么更古老的味道。

sentences.en: Far below, a bell rang once and stopped.
sentences.cn: 远下方,一口钟敲了一下,然后停住。

mostly:1.en: The outer courtyard was *mostly* quiet before the morning bell, except for Xiaoxing, who practiced her word-steps at the edge of the stone platform each day. I watched her feet trace the syllables of a wind formula across the cold ground. She never fell. I tried once and nearly stepped off the cloud-ledge. A feather drifted up from the white sea below.
mostly:1.cnHint: 外院清晨____是安静的，只有师妹一人在石台边练习踏字步。
mostly:1.hook: The feather hung still in the air — as if the wind itself was listening.
mostly:1.line: 'It is *mostly* patience, not talent, that keeps you from falling,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: The outer courtyard was *mostly* quiet before the morning bell, except for Xiaoxing, who practiced her word-steps at the edge of the stone platform each day.
I watched her feet trace the syllables of a wind formula across the cold ground.
sentences.cn: 我看着她的脚在冰冷的地面上踏出风诀的音节。

sentences.en: She never fell.
sentences.cn: 她从没踏空过。

sentences.en: I tried once and nearly stepped off the cloud-ledge.
sentences.cn: 我试过一次,差点踩出了云崖。

sentences.en: A feather drifted up from the white sea below.
sentences.cn: 一根羽毛从下面白色的海里飘起。

exactly:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a single word in the air above the outer path. The light-stroke hung there, trembling. 'Place your breath *exactly* here,' she said, pressing one finger to a point inside the glowing character. I tried. The word flared gold for one heartbeat, then faded. Shen Wujiu said nothing, but his eyes were wide. Smoke rose from where the word had been.
exactly:1.cnHint: 师尊要我把呼吸____地落在那个悬空字符的某一点上。
exactly:1.hook: Where the word had burned, a small crack split the stone path.
exactly:1.line: 'Place your breath *exactly* here, and not one breath-width away,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a single word in the air above the outer path.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在外径上方的空气里写了一个字。

sentences.en: The light-stroke hung there, trembling.
sentences.cn: 光笔在那儿悬着,微微颤动。

sentences.en: 'Place your breath *exactly* here,' she said, pressing one finger to a point inside the glowing character.
I tried.
sentences.cn: 我试了。

sentences.en: The word flared gold for one heartbeat, then faded.
sentences.cn: 那个字闪了一下金光,然后消褪。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said nothing, but his eyes were wide.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎什么都没说,但眼睛睁得很大。

sentences.en: Smoke rose from where the word had been.
sentences.cn: 那个字消失的地方升起了烟。

vary:1.en: Outside the herb-word garden on the east terrace, the air itself seemed to breathe. Xiaoxing showed me how the color of a word-leaf could *vary* with the hour — pale silver at dawn, deep green at noon, faintly gold at dusk. 'The meaning shifts with the light,' she said. I reached out to touch a dusk-gold leaf. My fingers came away warm.
vary:1.cnHint: 师妹向我展示了词草的颜色如何随时辰____，清晨、正午、黄昏各不相同。
vary:1.hook: The gold leaf curled shut the moment a cloud passed over the sun.
vary:1.line: 'The power they carry will *vary*, so choose your hour with care,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Outside the herb-word garden on the east terrace, the air itself seemed to breathe.
sentences.cn: 东阳台的草药字园外,空气本身似乎在呼吸。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me how the color of a word-leaf could *vary* with the hour — pale silver at dawn, deep green at noon, faintly gold at dusk.
'The meaning shifts with the light,' she said.
sentences.cn: "意思随光而变,"她说。

sentences.en: I reached out to touch a dusk-gold leaf.
sentences.cn: 我伸出手去碰一片暮色金色的叶子。

sentences.en: My fingers came away warm.
sentences.cn: 我的手指收回来时是温热的。

brain:1.en: Shen Wujiu sat beside me on the outer steps, watching me struggle with a memory formula. 'A cultivator's *brain* is like a deep well,' he said. 'Pour too many words in at once and they spill.' He tapped the side of his head gently. I closed my scroll. Above us, two birds flew in slow circles, casting moving shadows across the stone.
brain:1.cnHint: 师兄坐在台阶旁告诉我，修行者的____就像一口深井，一次灌入太多词语只会溢出来。
brain:1.hook: The birds' shadows merged into one — and then vanished entirely.
brain:1.line: 'A cultivator's *brain* needs rest as much as it needs study,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu sat beside me on the outer steps, watching me struggle with a memory formula.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎坐在我身边的外阶上,看我在念一个记忆诀。

sentences.en: 'A cultivator's *brain* is like a deep well,' he said.
'Pour too many words in at once and they spill.'
sentences.cn: "一下子倒进太多字,它们就会溢出来。"

sentences.en: He tapped the side of his head gently.
sentences.cn: 他轻轻敲了敲自己的脑侧。

sentences.en: I closed my scroll.
sentences.cn: 我合上卷轴。

sentences.en: Above us, two birds flew in slow circles, casting moving shadows across the stone.
sentences.cn: 我们上方,两只鸟在缓缓盘旋,在石面上投出移动的影子。

stress:1.en: The assessment path wound along the outer cliff edge. Each disc of stone bore a word, and I had to speak them in the right rhythm. Master Qingwu watched from a distance. The *stress* of the test pressed down like a low cloud. I spoke the first word cleanly. The stone lit up. My heart settled, just slightly. Then the last stone began to shake.
stress:1.cnHint: 在悬崖外侧的测试路上，考核的____压得像低垂的云，我深吸一口气说出了第一个词。
stress:1.hook: The last stone shook once, then rose slowly into the air.
stress:1.line: 'Let the *stress* sharpen you — do not let it silence you,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The assessment path wound along the outer cliff edge.
sentences.cn: 考验之路沿着悬崖边缘蜿蜒。

sentences.en: Each disc of stone bore a word, and I had to speak them in the right rhythm.
sentences.cn: 每块石盘上都有一个字,我得用对的节奏念它们。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched from a distance.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在远处看着。

sentences.en: The *stress* of the test pressed down like a low cloud.
I spoke the first word cleanly.
sentences.cn: 我清晰地念出了第一个字。

sentences.en: The stone lit up.
sentences.cn: 石头亮了起来。

sentences.en: My heart settled, just slightly.
sentences.cn: 我的心稍稍定了些。

sentences.en: Then the last stone began to shake.
sentences.cn: 然后最后那块石头开始震动。

financial:1.en: A traveling merchant had climbed to the Sect's outer gate, offering rare word-scrolls for sale. Shen Wujiu studied the price list and shook his head. 'My *financial* situation allows for one scroll only,' he said with a small smile. He chose the simplest one — a single healing word. That night, he used it to mend a cracked step near my room. A light lingered there until dawn.
financial:1.cnHint: 师兄看了看价格单，说自己的____状况只允许他买一卷词简。
financial:1.hook: The light on the mended step was still glowing when the morning bell rang.
financial:1.line: 'My *financial* situation is modest, but one good word is enough,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: A traveling merchant had climbed to the Sect's outer gate, offering rare word-scrolls for sale.
sentences.cn: 一个旅商爬上了宗门山门,拿着罕见的字卷要卖。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu studied the price list and shook his head.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎看了看价目表,摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'My *financial* situation allows for one scroll only,' he said with a small smile.
He chose the simplest one — a single healing word.
sentences.cn: 他选了最简单的一张——一个治愈的字。

sentences.en: That night, he used it to mend a cracked step near my room.
sentences.cn: 那晚,他用它修补了我房间旁边裂开的台阶。

sentences.en: A light lingered there until dawn.
sentences.cn: 一道光在那儿一直亮到天亮。

trouble:1.en: The morning market on the outer bridge was loud with traders offering rare word-stones. I had only three copper coins left. Shen Wujiu pulled me aside: 'Do not touch the red ones.' A vendor noticed us hesitating and raised his voice. That small moment of *trouble* drew every eye on the bridge to us — including a pair that did not belong to any trader.
trouble:1.cnHint: 我在集市上陷入____，引来了不该注意我们的目光。
trouble:1.hook: The watcher's robe bore no sect mark at all.
trouble:1.line: 'A little *trouble* now is better than a great wound later,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: The morning market on the outer bridge was loud with traders offering rare word-stones.
sentences.cn: 外桥上的清晨市集里,小贩们在兜售罕见的字石。

sentences.en: I had only three copper coins left.
sentences.cn: 我只剩三个铜板了。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pulled me aside: 'Do not touch the red ones.'
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把我拉到一边:"别碰那些红色的。"

sentences.en: A vendor noticed us hesitating and raised his voice.
sentences.cn: 一个小贩注意到我们在犹豫,提高了嗓门。

sentences.en: That small moment of *trouble* drew every eye on the bridge to us — including a pair that did not belong to any trader.

reflect:1.en: At the still pool beside the gate, new disciples were told to speak one word and watch how the water moved. I chose the word for 'sky.' The surface did not *reflect* my face — it showed a mountain above the one we were standing on, hidden in clouds no eye could reach from here. Xiaoxing gripped my sleeve without a word.
reflect:1.cnHint: 水面没有____出我的脸，而是映出了一座隐藏的山。
reflect:1.hook: The hidden mountain had a light burning in its peak.
reflect:1.line: 'What a pool can *reflect* is not always what you expect to see,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: At the still pool beside the gate, new disciples were told to speak one word and watch how the water moved.
sentences.cn: 山门边的静池旁,新弟子被要求念一个字,看水怎么动。

sentences.en: I chose the word for 'sky.'
sentences.cn: 我选了"天"这个字。

sentences.en: The surface did not *reflect* my face — it showed a mountain above the one we were standing on, hidden in clouds no eye could reach from here.
Xiaoxing gripped my sleeve without a word.
sentences.cn: 小杏没说话,攥住了我的袖子。

attend:1.en: Every new disciple was required to *attend* the Dawn Word Assembly on the outer terrace, where Master Qingwu would speak the first formula of the season aloud. I arrived just as the clouds below the mountain began to glow orange. The word Master Qingwu chose this year was not one listed in any text I had read. A cold wind rose the moment she finished speaking it.
attend:1.cnHint: 我们必须____清晨的词语仪式，师尊念出了一个从未见过的字。
attend:1.hook: The cold wind carried a smell of rain and old iron.
attend:1.line: 'All disciples must *attend* — the word spoken today will follow you for a year,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Every new disciple was required to *attend* the Dawn Word Assembly on the outer terrace, where Master Qingwu would speak the first formula of the season aloud.
I arrived just as the clouds below the mountain began to glow orange.
sentences.cn: 我赶到时,山下的云已经开始泛起橙色的光。

sentences.en: The word Master Qingwu chose this year was not one listed in any text I had read.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊今年选的那个字不在任何我读过的书里。

sentences.en: A cold wind rose the moment she finished speaking it.
sentences.cn: 她念完那个字的瞬间,一阵冷风吹了起来。

belief:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small stone carved with a single character. 'This was given to me on my first day,' he said. 'I have carried it ever since.' He told me that every step on a floating mountain begins not with strength but with *belief* — that the stone beneath your foot is real, that the word in your mouth has weight. Far below, a section of cloud thinned and showed only open sky.
belief:1.cnHint: 师兄说，踏上浮山的第一步靠的是____，而非力气。
belief:1.hook: Through that gap in the cloud, something dark was rising.
belief:1.line: 'Without *belief* in the word, even the strongest formula is empty air,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small stone carved with a single character.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一块刻着单个字的小石头。

sentences.en: 'This was given to me on my first day,' he said.
sentences.cn: "这是我第一天得到的，"他说。

sentences.en: 'I have carried it ever since.'
sentences.cn: "我一直带着它。"

sentences.en: He told me that every step on a floating mountain begins not with strength but with *belief* — that the stone beneath your foot is real, that the word in your mouth has weight.
Far below, a section of cloud thinned and showed only open sky.
sentences.cn: 远处一块云散开了，露出下面空荡荡的天空。

carry:1.en: Each first-year disciple was given a small cloth bundle at the gate — inside were three dried word-leaves, one vial of cloud water, and a folded map of the outer paths. Master Qingwu said we were allowed to *carry* only what fit in that single bundle for the first month. I tied mine carefully and noticed that Xiaoxing's bundle was already giving off a faint silver light. She had not opened it yet.
carry:1.cnHint: 每位新弟子只能____一个小包裹，而师妹的包裹已经发出银光。
carry:1.hook: No one else seemed to notice the light but me.
carry:1.line: '*Carry* only what is yours — borrowed power always finds its way back,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Each first-year disciple was given a small cloth bundle at the gate — inside were three dried word-leaves, one vial of cloud water, and a folded map of the outer paths.
sentences.cn: 每个新入门的弟子在山门处都会得到一个小布包——里面装着三片干燥的字叶、一小瓶云水和一张外围山路的折叠图。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said we were allowed to *carry* only what fit in that single bundle for the first month.
I tied mine carefully and noticed that Xiaoxing's bundle was already giving off a faint silver light.
sentences.cn: 我仔细地系好布包，注意到小杏的包裹已经散发出淡淡的银色光芒。

sentences.en: She had not opened it yet.
sentences.cn: 她还没打开过。

else:1.en: After the assembly I lingered near the carved stone pillars at the terrace edge. The other disciples had all gone inside. I felt sure I had missed something — a gesture, a sound, a meaning — something *else* beneath the surface of the ceremony that the rest seemed to understand without being told. A single white feather drifted up from the clouds below and landed at my feet, pointing inward toward the hall.
else:1.cnHint: 我觉得仪式之下还有____的含义，一根白羽从云中飘来落在脚边。
else:1.hook: The feather was warm, as if it had just been shed.
else:1.line: 'If something feels like it means *else* beyond its words, trust that feeling,' Xiaoxing said later.

sentences.en: After the assembly I lingered near the carved stone pillars at the terrace edge.
sentences.cn: 集会结束后，我在平台边缘的雕花石柱附近逗留了一会儿。

sentences.en: The other disciples had all gone inside.
sentences.cn: 其他弟子都已经进去了。

sentences.en: I felt sure I had missed something — a gesture, a sound, a meaning — something *else* beneath the surface of the ceremony that the rest seemed to understand without being told.
A single white feather drifted up from the clouds below and landed at my feet, pointing inward toward the hall.
sentences.cn: 一根白色的羽毛从下面的云层中飘升上来，落在我脚边，指向大厅的方向。

prepare:1.en: The morning bell had not yet rung when Shen Wujiu shook my shoulder. 'The herb-naming trial begins at dawn,' he said. 'We must *prepare* our word-scrolls tonight.' I rolled the thin paper carefully, pressing each character into memory. Outside, the clouds below the mountain began to glow a faint, uneasy red.
prepare:1.cnHint: 天亮前，师兄提醒我要为草药命名考验____好一切。
prepare:1.hook: The red glow deepened, and something beneath the clouds began to rise.
prepare:1.line: 'We must *prepare* our word-scrolls before the trial bell rings.'

sentences.en: The morning bell had not yet rung when Shen Wujiu shook my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 晨钟还没有敲响，沈无咎就摇醒了我的肩膀。

sentences.en: 'The herb-naming trial begins at dawn,' he said.
sentences.cn: "草药命名试炼在天亮时开始，"他说。

sentences.en: 'We must *prepare* our word-scrolls tonight.'
I rolled the thin paper carefully, pressing each character into memory.
sentences.cn: 我仔细地卷起薄纸，把每个字都压进记忆里。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds below the mountain began to glow a faint, uneasy red.
sentences.cn: 外面，山下的云开始泛起淡淡的、令人不安的红光。

workplace:1.en: Master Qingwu led us to the Herb Terrace, a wide stone platform hanging over the sea of clouds. 'This terrace is your *workplace* now,' she said quietly. 'Every word you learn here is a tool. Lose it, and you lose a piece of your strength.' I touched the cold stone railing and felt how far down the clouds truly were.
workplace:1.cnHint: 师尊将我们带到草药台，告诉我们这里就是我们的____。
workplace:1.hook: A crack, thin as a hair, split the stone beneath my hand.
workplace:1.line: 'This terrace is your *workplace* — treat every word learned here with care.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us to the Herb Terrace, a wide stone platform hanging over the sea of clouds.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊带我们来到药草平台，一个悬在云海之上的宽阔石制平台。

sentences.en: 'This terrace is your *workplace* now,' she said quietly.
'Every word you learn here is a tool.
sentences.cn: "你在这里学到的每一个字都是一件工具。

sentences.en: Lose it, and you lose a piece of your strength.'
sentences.cn: 丢失它，你就丧失了一分力量。"

sentences.en: I touched the cold stone railing and felt how far down the clouds truly were.
sentences.cn: 我摸了摸冰冷的石栏杆，感受到下方的云有多么遥远。

post:1.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the great wooden board at the sect gate. Someone had used a brush made from a storm-cloud feather to *post* a new list of forbidden word-formulas overnight. The ink still smelled of lightning. Disciples crowded close, whispering. I counted seven words I had already memorised, and a cold feeling settled in my chest.
post:1.cnHint: 小星发现有人在宗门门口____了一张新的禁用咒语名单。
post:1.hook: The seventh word on the list was the one Master Qingwu had taught only me.
post:1.line: 'Who dared to *post* forbidden formulas on the sect gate at night?'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the great wooden board at the sect gate.
sentences.cn: 小杏指向宗门大门上的那块巨大木板。

sentences.en: Someone had used a brush made from a storm-cloud feather to *post* a new list of forbidden word-formulas overnight.
The ink still smelled of lightning.
sentences.cn: 墨汁里还带着闪电的味道。

sentences.en: Disciples crowded close, whispering.
sentences.cn: 弟子们聚在一起，窃窃私语。

sentences.en: I counted seven words I had already memorised, and a cold feeling settled in my chest.
sentences.cn: 我数了数，其中有七个字我已经背过了，一股寒意沉入了我的胸口。

complete:1.en: I had three word-scrolls left to fill before the trial. Shen Wujiu watched me write and said nothing until the last stroke was dry. 'You *complete* every task as if it might be your final one,' he said, with something like respect in his voice. I tied the scrolls together. High above, the peak of the mountain vanished into sudden cloud.
complete:1.cnHint: 师兄看着我写完最后一卷字卷，说我____每件事都像在做最后一次。
complete:1.hook: The cloud swallowed the peak whole, and did not move again.
complete:1.line: 'You *complete* each scroll as though it might be your last — good.'

sentences.en: I had three word-scrolls left to fill before the trial.
sentences.cn: 我还剩三卷字轴要填。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu watched me write and said nothing until the last stroke was dry.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎看着我写字，直到最后一笔干透了才开口。

sentences.en: 'You *complete* every task as if it might be your final one,' he said, with something like respect in his voice.
I tied the scrolls together.
sentences.cn: 我把字轴绑在一起。

sentences.en: High above, the peak of the mountain vanished into sudden cloud.
sentences.cn: 高空中，山峰突然消没在云里。

measure:1.en: Master Qingwu placed a slender jade rod across my open palm. 'To *measure* a herb's spiritual weight, you hold it here and count your own heartbeats,' she said. I tried with a sprig of cloud-moss. My heart beat seven times before the rod tilted. 'Seven,' she murmured. 'That is either very promising or very dangerous.'
measure:1.cnHint: 师尊教我用玉杆来____草药的灵力重量。
measure:1.hook: She did not explain which of the two she believed.
measure:1.line: 'Hold the rod still — use it to *measure* the herb's spiritual weight.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a slender jade rod across my open palm.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我摊开的手心上放了一根纤细的玉杆。

sentences.en: 'To *measure* a herb's spiritual weight, you hold it here and count your own heartbeats,' she said.
I tried with a sprig of cloud-moss.
sentences.cn: 我试着用一根云苔。

sentences.en: My heart beat seven times before the rod tilted.
sentences.cn: 我的心跳了七下，玉杆才倾斜。

sentences.en: 'Seven,' she murmured.
sentences.cn: "七下，"她低声说。

sentences.en: 'That is either very promising or very dangerous.'
sentences.cn: "这要么是非常有潜力，要么非常危险。"

recommend:1.en: Before the morning lesson, Xiaoxing pulled me aside. 'I *recommend* you study the word for wind-root before anyone else does,' she whispered. 'Master Qingwu mentioned it twice yesterday. That always means it appears in the trial.' She slipped a small scroll into my hand and hurried away before I could thank her. The wind picked up sharply.
recommend:1.cnHint: 小星偷偷找到我，____我在考前重点学习"风根"这个词。
recommend:1.hook: The scroll in my hand trembled, though the air had gone still.
recommend:1.line: 'I *recommend* you study wind-root tonight — trust me on this.'

sentences.en: Before the morning lesson, Xiaoxing pulled me aside.
sentences.cn: 早课前，小杏把我拉到一边。

sentences.en: 'I *recommend* you study the word for wind-root before anyone else does,' she whispered.
'Master Qingwu mentioned it twice yesterday.
sentences.cn: "青梧师尊昨天提了两次。

sentences.en: That always means it appears in the trial.'
sentences.cn: 那通常意味着它会出现在试炼里。"

sentences.en: She slipped a small scroll into my hand and hurried away before I could thank her.
sentences.cn: 她把一卷小纸条塞进我的手里，还没等我道谢就匆匆离开了。

sentences.en: The wind picked up sharply.
sentences.cn: 风突然刮起来了。

resource:1.en: Shen Wujiu spread a map of the floating mountains across the stone table. 'Every mountain holds a different *resource*,' he explained. 'One grows words for healing. One grows words for speed. Master only the mountain that suits your path.' I stared at the map for a long time. One peak had no label at all, only a small ink smear shaped like an eye.
resource:1.cnHint: 师兄解释说每座山都是不同的____，蕴藏着不同类型的灵词。
resource:1.hook: The unlabelled peak seemed to shift slightly each time I looked away.
resource:1.line: 'Each mountain is a *resource* — choose the one that fits your path.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread a map of the floating mountains across the stone table.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在石桌上展开了浮山的地图。

sentences.en: 'Every mountain holds a different *resource*,' he explained.
'One grows words for healing.
sentences.cn: "一座山长出治愈的字。

sentences.en: One grows words for speed.
sentences.cn: 一座山长出加速的字。

sentences.en: Master only the mountain that suits your path.'
sentences.cn: 师尊只掌握适合你道路的那座山。"

sentences.en: I stared at the map for a long time.
sentences.cn: 我盯着地图看了很久。

sentences.en: One peak had no label at all, only a small ink smear shaped like an eye.
sentences.cn: 其中一个峰顶没有标签，只有一个小墨迹，形状像一只眼睛。

specific:1.en: Master Qingwu set five herbs on the table and folded her hands. 'I want a *specific* answer,' she said. 'Not the family of the herb, not the colour of its flower. Name the exact word-formula it carries, or say nothing.' The other disciples shifted nervously. I looked at the middle herb, the one with no scent, and felt the answer rise in me like a held breath.
specific:1.cnHint: 师尊要求我给出____的答案，必须说出草药携带的确切咒语公式。
specific:1.hook: The scentless herb began, very slowly, to glow.
specific:1.line: 'Give me a *specific* answer — the exact formula, nothing broader.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set five herbs on the table and folded her hands.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在桌子上摆了五种草药，交叉放好双手。

sentences.en: 'I want a *specific* answer,' she said.
'Not the family of the herb, not the colour of its flower.
sentences.cn: "不是草药的科属，不是花的颜色。

sentences.en: Name the exact word-formula it carries, or say nothing.'
sentences.cn: 说出它携带的准确字诀，或者什么都别说。"

sentences.en: The other disciples shifted nervously.
sentences.cn: 其他弟子紧张地动了动。

sentences.en: I looked at the middle herb, the one with no scent, and felt the answer rise in me like a held breath.
sentences.cn: 我看着中间那株没有香气的草药，感觉答案像一口憋着的气升起来了。

major:1.en: The herb market on the lower terrace hummed with traders calling out names of rare words. Xiaoxing pointed to a glowing leaf. 'That one carries a *major* formula,' she said, 'strong enough to lift a stone bridge.' I reached for it, then stopped. Something in the air felt wrong — too still, too sweet.
major:1.cnHint: 集市上，小星指着一株发光的草药，说它蕴含一个____的法诀。
major:1.hook: The leaf pulsed once, then went dark in my hand.
major:1.line: 'That one carries a *major* formula — handle it with great care.'

sentences.en: The herb market on the lower terrace hummed with traders calling out names of rare words.
sentences.cn: 下层平台的草药市集里到处是商人喊着稀有字诀的名字。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pointed to a glowing leaf.
sentences.cn: 小杏指向一片发光的叶子。

sentences.en: 'That one carries a *major* formula,' she said, 'strong enough to lift a stone bridge.'
I reached for it, then stopped.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去够它，然后停住了。

sentences.en: Something in the air felt wrong — too still, too sweet.
sentences.cn: 空气里有什么不对劲——太静了，太甜了。

communication:1.en: On the open terrace where disciples gathered each morning, Master Qingwu drew a circle in the air with one finger. 'All healing begins with *communication* — between the word and the body that receives it.' I wrote the character down. Wind rose from nowhere and scattered my notes across the clouds below.
communication:1.cnHint: 清雾师尊在晨练台上讲道，治愈之术始于____，始于字与身体之间的感应。
communication:1.hook: My scattered notes reformed in the air — but the words had changed.
communication:1.line: 'All healing begins with *communication* between the word and the one who listens.'

sentences.en: On the open terrace where disciples gathered each morning, Master Qingwu drew a circle in the air with one finger.
sentences.cn: 在弟子们每天早晨聚集的开阔平台上，青梧师尊用一根手指在空中划了一个圆。

sentences.en: 'All healing begins with *communication* — between the word and the body that receives it.'
I wrote the character down.
sentences.cn: 我把那个字写了下来。

sentences.en: Wind rose from nowhere and scattered my notes across the clouds below.
sentences.cn: 风从无处升起，把我的笔记吹散到下面的云海里。

market:1.en: The cloud *market* below the East Peak was loud with colour and smell. Traders spread word-scrolls on low tables, each scroll glowing faintly with stored meaning. Shen Wujiu moved ahead of me without looking back. I followed, but when I turned to check the gate, it had already closed behind us.
market:1.cnHint: 东峰下的____热闹非凡，师兄沈无咎走在前面，我一回头，发现身后的门已悄然关上。
market:1.hook: The gate seal glowed red — entry was one way only.
market:1.line: 'In this *market*, every word you buy costs you one you already know.'

sentences.en: The cloud *market* below the East Peak was loud with colour and smell.
Traders spread word-scrolls on low tables, each scroll glowing faintly with stored meaning.
sentences.cn: 商人们把字卷铺在低矮的桌子上，每一卷都闪烁着微弱的储存之光。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu moved ahead of me without looking back.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎走在我前面，没有回头看我。

sentences.en: I followed, but when I turned to check the gate, it had already closed behind us.
sentences.cn: 我跟在后面，转身看向门口时，它已经在身后关上了。

apply:1.en: Shen Wujiu showed me how to *apply* the healing word to a cracked stone pillar on the outer terrace. I pressed the syllable like a cloth to a wound, and the crack sealed with a soft green light. He nodded once. Behind us, a second pillar split open without warning.
apply:1.cnHint: 师兄教我如何将愈合词____在碎裂的石柱上，刚刚成功，身后另一根石柱却无故裂开。
apply:1.hook: The second crack spread faster than the first.
apply:1.line: '*Apply* the word gently — force will only widen the break.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu showed me how to *apply* the healing word to a cracked stone pillar on the outer terrace.
I pressed the syllable like a cloth to a wound, and the crack sealed with a soft green light.
sentences.cn: 我把那个音节像布一样按在裂纹上，裂缝在柔和的绿光中愈合了。

sentences.en: He nodded once.
sentences.cn: 他点了一下头。

sentences.en: Behind us, a second pillar split open without warning.
sentences.cn: 我们身后，第二根柱子突然裂开了。

per:1.en: Master Qingwu handed me a chart of daily practice. 'Three recitations *per* hour, no more,' she said quietly. 'Words have weight. Too many at once and the mountain feels it.' I folded the chart carefully. That night, the mountain shook once, as though someone had not followed her advice.
per:1.cnHint: 清雾师尊嘱咐我每小时____诵读次数有限，当晚山体却微微震动，似乎有人违了此戒。
per:1.hook: The tremor came from directly beneath the Hall of Words.
per:1.line: 'Three recitations *per* hour — the mountain counts even when you do not.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu handed me a chart of daily practice.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊递给我一份日常修行的表单。

sentences.en: 'Three recitations *per* hour, no more,' she said quietly.
'Words have weight.
sentences.cn: 字有分量。

sentences.en: Too many at once and the mountain feels it.'
sentences.cn: 一次太多的话，山就能感觉到。

sentences.en: I folded the chart carefully.
sentences.cn: 我小心地折好了表单。

sentences.en: That night, the mountain shook once, as though someone had not followed her advice.
sentences.cn: 那晚，山震动了一次，好像有人没有听从她的建议。

treat:1.en: At the edge of the morning mist, Xiaoxing handed me a small wrapped bundle. 'A cloud-petal sweet — a little *treat* before the hard lesson,' she said with a soft smile. The sweetness lasted only a moment. When I swallowed, the word for 'flight' appeared briefly on my tongue, then vanished.
treat:1.cnHint: 小星在晨雾边递给我一块云瓣糖，说是苦课前的一点____，甜味消散后，"飞"字竟短暂浮现在舌尖。
treat:1.hook: I tasted the word again — fainter now, and moving deeper.
treat:1.line: 'Here, a small *treat* before Master Qingwu tests us on the wind formulas.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the morning mist, Xiaoxing handed me a small wrapped bundle.
sentences.cn: 在清晨雾气的边缘，小杏递给我一个小包裹。

sentences.en: 'A cloud-petal sweet — a little *treat* before the hard lesson,' she said with a soft smile.
The sweetness lasted only a moment.
sentences.cn: 甜味只持续了一瞬间。

sentences.en: When I swallowed, the word for 'flight' appeared briefly on my tongue, then vanished.
sentences.cn: 当我吞下去时，"飞"这个字短暂地出现在我的舌尖上，然后消失了。

creative:1.en: The assignment was simple: combine two known words into one new formula. Most disciples stacked them neatly, safely. I tried something *creative* — I wove the word for 'root' around the word for 'cloud.' The result floated upward and stuck to the ceiling of the practice hall, gently pulsing.
creative:1.cnHint: 在造词练习中，我尝试了一种____的组合，将"根"字与"云"字交织，结果飘到了练功房顶上。
creative:1.hook: Master Qingwu looked up at it for a long time without speaking.
creative:1.line: 'A *creative* choice — but wild things that float must also know how to land.'

sentences.en: The assignment was simple: combine two known words into one new formula.
sentences.cn: 任务很简单：把两个已知的字结合成一个新的方式。

sentences.en: Most disciples stacked them neatly, safely.
sentences.cn: 大多数弟子们整齐地、稳妥地堆叠它们。

sentences.en: I tried something *creative* — I wove the word for 'root' around the word for 'cloud.'
The result floated upward and stuck to the ceiling of the practice hall, gently pulsing.
sentences.cn: 结果飘向上方，粘在练功厅的天花板上，轻轻地跳动着。

perform:1.en: On the stone stage above the sea of clouds, each new disciple had to *perform* one learned word before the whole sect. I stood at the edge, breathed out, and spoke the word for 'still.' The wind stopped. Every cloud below the mountain held its shape. Then, slowly, something rose from beneath them.
perform:1.cnHint: 在云海上方的石台上，每位新弟子须当众____一个习得之词，我念出"静"字后，云下有什么东西慢慢升了上来。
perform:1.hook: Whatever rose from the clouds had no shape that words could name.
perform:1.line: 'When you *perform* a word before the sect, the sky itself becomes your judge.'

sentences.en: On the stone stage above the sea of clouds, each new disciple had to *perform* one learned word before the whole sect.
I stood at the edge, breathed out, and spoke the word for 'still.'
sentences.cn: 我站在边缘，呼出一口气，说出了"静"这个字。

sentences.en: The wind stopped.
sentences.cn: 风停了。

sentences.en: Every cloud below the mountain held its shape.
sentences.cn: 山下方的每一朵云都保持了形状。

sentences.en: Then, slowly, something rose from beneath them.
sentences.cn: 然后，缓缓地，什么东西从云下升起来了。

policy:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a silk scroll beside the misty bridge. 'Every disciple must read this,' she said. The sect's *policy* on forbidden words was written in ink that glowed faintly gold: no one could speak the wind formula alone, not until their third year. I pressed my thumb to the seal, binding myself to its terms. Outside, the bridge lanterns flickered without wind.
policy:2.cnHint: 师尊在云雾桥边展开一卷丝帛，要求弟子遵守门规中的____。
policy:2.hook: The seal on my thumb began to burn at midnight.
policy:2.line: 'The *policy* of this sect protects you as much as it binds you.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a silk scroll beside the misty bridge.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在雾气缭绕的桥边展开了一卷丝绸。

sentences.en: 'Every disciple must read this,' she said.
sentences.cn: 她说，每个弟子都必须读这个。

sentences.en: The sect's *policy* on forbidden words was written in ink that glowed faintly gold: no one could speak the wind formula alone, not until their third year.
I pressed my thumb to the seal, binding myself to its terms.
sentences.cn: 我按下大拇指在封印上，把自己约束在它的条款下。

sentences.en: Outside, the bridge lanterns flickered without wind.
sentences.cn: 外面，桥上的灯笼在没有风的情况下闪烁着。

industry:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the lower terrace, where dozens of disciples ground dried word-herbs by hand. 'This is how every great cultivator begins,' he said quietly. The *industry* of the sect never stopped — morning or night, hands moved, words were prepared, power was built one careful step at a time. I picked up a stone pestle and joined them. A single black feather drifted down from the sky above.
industry:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到下层台地，亲眼见识了云海宗日夜不停的____。
industry:2.hook: The feather landed upright in the grinding powder and did not fall.
industry:2.line: 'The *industry* of this place is what turns raw talent into real strength.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the lower terrace, where dozens of disciples ground dried word-herbs by hand.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎领我到下层平台，那里有几十个弟子用手研磨干的字草。

sentences.en: 'This is how every great cultivator begins,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: 他静静地说，这就是每个伟大修行者的开始。

sentences.en: The *industry* of the sect never stopped — morning or night, hands moved, words were prepared, power was built one careful step at a time.
I picked up a stone pestle and joined them.
sentences.cn: 我拿起一个石杵加入了他们。

sentences.en: A single black feather drifted down from the sky above.
sentences.cn: 一根黑色的羽毛从上面的天空飘落下来。

concern:2.en: Xiaoxing found me sitting alone at the cliff's edge, staring into the sea of clouds below. She sat beside me without a word, then asked softly what troubled me. I told her my *concern*: the word I had been given to study felt hollow, as if something had already drained its meaning away. She looked at my practice scroll and went very still. Far below, something large moved beneath the clouds.
concern:2.cnHint: 师妹发现我独自坐在崖边，问起我心中的____。
concern:2.hook: She folded my scroll closed and said nothing more that evening.
concern:2.line: 'Your *concern* is not foolish — I felt the same hollow word last spring.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found me sitting alone at the cliff's edge, staring into the sea of clouds below.
sentences.cn: 小杏在悬崖边找到我，我一个人坐在那里，凝视下方的云海。

sentences.en: She sat beside me without a word, then asked softly what troubled me.
sentences.cn: 她无言地坐在我身边，然后轻声问我什么让我困扰。

sentences.en: I told her my *concern*: the word I had been given to study felt hollow, as if something had already drained its meaning away.
She looked at my practice scroll and went very still.
sentences.cn: 她看着我的练习卷，突然静止不动。

sentences.en: Far below, something large moved beneath the clouds.
sentences.cn: 远下方，什么大东西在云下移动。

present:2.en: On the morning of the first full moon, Master Qingwu called us to the Hall of Echoes. She placed a small jade bottle on the altar — a *present* for the disciple who could recite the water formula without a single pause. I steadied my breath and began. My voice did not waver. She slid the bottle toward me, eyes calm. Behind me, I heard Shen Wujiu exhale slowly, and the candle flames all leaned east at once.
present:2.cnHint: 在满月之晨，师尊为能完整背诵水诀的弟子准备了一份____。
present:2.hook: Every candle in the hall leaned east, toward the forbidden peak.
present:2.line: 'This *present* carries a formula inside it — open it only when you are ready.'

sentences.en: On the morning of the first full moon, Master Qingwu called us to the Hall of Echoes.
sentences.cn: 在第一个满月的早晨，青梧师尊召集我们到回音厅。

sentences.en: She placed a small jade bottle on the altar — a *present* for the disciple who could recite the water formula without a single pause.
I steadied my breath and began.
sentences.cn: 我稳定了呼吸，开始了。

sentences.en: My voice did not waver.
sentences.cn: 我的声音没有颤抖。

sentences.en: She slid the bottle toward me, eyes calm.
sentences.cn: 她把瓶子推向我，眼神平静。

sentences.en: Behind me, I heard Shen Wujiu exhale slowly, and the candle flames all leaned east at once.
sentences.cn: 身后，我听到沈无咎缓缓呼气，所有的烛火都向东倾斜了。

claim:2.en: A stranger in gray robes appeared at the sect gate and said he had come for the lost word-scroll found near the eastern bridge. Shen Wujiu stepped forward and asked for proof. The man could not give any. 'You cannot *claim* what you cannot name,' Shen Wujiu said, his voice flat and final. The stranger left without speaking again. That night, the eastern bridge lanterns burned a deep, uneasy red.
claim:2.cnHint: 一名灰袍陌生人来到宗门，试图____一卷在东桥附近发现的失落词卷。
claim:2.hook: By dawn, the stranger's footprints in the dust pointed the wrong direction.
claim:2.line: 'You cannot *claim* a word you have never spoken aloud.'

sentences.en: A stranger in gray robes appeared at the sect gate and said he had come for the lost word-scroll found near the eastern bridge.
sentences.cn: 一个穿着灰色袍子的陌生人出现在宗门门口，说他是来领在东桥边找到的丢失的字卷的。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stepped forward and asked for proof.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎走上前问他有没有证明。

sentences.en: The man could not give any.
sentences.cn: 那个人拿不出来。

sentences.en: 'You cannot *claim* what you cannot name,' Shen Wujiu said, his voice flat and final.
The stranger left without speaking again.
sentences.cn: 陌生人没再说话就离开了。

sentences.en: That night, the eastern bridge lanterns burned a deep, uneasy red.
sentences.cn: 那晚，东桥的灯笼燃烧着深红色，不祥的红。

half:2.en: The restoration formula for a torn scroll required two disciples to speak together, but Xiaoxing had lost her voice to a cold mountain wind. I read the first *half* of the formula alone, and the scroll mended itself up to its center — then stopped. The torn edge hung there, trembling, neither whole nor broken. Xiaoxing touched it gently with one finger. The mountain beneath us gave a low, slow shudder.
half:2.cnHint: 只念了修复词诀的前____，残卷便停在了中间，不再愈合。
half:2.hook: The scroll's torn center trembled like a held breath.
half:2.line: 'One *half* spoken alone is not a formula — it is an open question.'

sentences.en: The restoration formula for a torn scroll required two disciples to speak together, but Xiaoxing had lost her voice to a cold mountain wind.
sentences.cn: 修复一道破损的卷轴需要两个弟子一起诵读，但小杏被冷山风夺走了嗓音。

sentences.en: I read the first *half* of the formula alone, and the scroll mended itself up to its center — then stopped.
The torn edge hung there, trembling, neither whole nor broken.
sentences.cn: 破损的边缘就那样颤抖着，既不完整也不破碎。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing touched it gently with one finger.
sentences.cn: 小杏用一根手指轻轻碰了碰它。

sentences.en: The mountain beneath us gave a low, slow shudder.
sentences.cn: 我们脚下的山峰发出了一声低沉、缓慢的震颤。

successful:2.en: After seven failed attempts, I finally guided the small cloud-seed word to full bloom. Master Qingwu watched from the doorway, arms folded. 'You are *successful*,' she said simply, 'but look at the color.' The bloom was white where it should have been pale blue. She turned and walked away without explaining. I looked at the word still glowing on the page, and noticed for the first time that one brushstroke was facing the wrong way.
successful:2.cnHint: 经过七次失败，我终于____地让云种词开花，却被师尊指出颜色有误。
successful:2.hook: The wrong-colored bloom began to spin slowly in still air.
successful:2.line: 'Being *successful* once does not mean you have understood — look closer.'

sentences.en: After seven failed attempts, I finally guided the small cloud-seed word to full bloom.
sentences.cn: 尝试了七次失败后，我终于让那朵小云种文字盛开了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched from the doorway, arms folded.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从门口看着，双臂交叉。

sentences.en: 'You are *successful*,' she said simply, 'but look at the color.'
The bloom was white where it should have been pale blue.
sentences.cn: 花朵应该是淡蓝色，却开出了白色。

sentences.en: She turned and walked away without explaining.
sentences.cn: 她转身走开了，没有任何解释。

sentences.en: I looked at the word still glowing on the page, and noticed for the first time that one brushstroke was facing the wrong way.
sentences.cn: 我看着页面上仍在发光的那个字，第一次注意到其中一笔笔画方向反了。

access:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me an old bronze key and told me it would open the lower archive, where word-maps of the cloud sea were stored. But when I reached the iron door and turned the key, nothing moved. He had not mentioned that *access* to the archive required speaking a gate-word first, whispered at the lock. I leaned close and tried every word I knew. On my last try, the door opened — and the room inside was completely empty.
access:2.cnHint: 师兄给了我一把旧铜钥匙，却没有告诉我进入下层藏档室还需要开门的____条件。
access:2.hook: The archive was empty, but fresh ink marks covered the floor.
access:2.line: '*Access* to that room is earned in two steps — the key is only the first.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me an old bronze key and told me it would open the lower archive, where word-maps of the cloud sea were stored.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一把老铜钥匙，说它能打开下层档案库，那里存放着云海的字图。

sentences.en: But when I reached the iron door and turned the key, nothing moved.
sentences.cn: 但当我走到铁门前转动钥匙时，什么都没有动。

sentences.en: He had not mentioned that *access* to the archive required speaking a gate-word first, whispered at the lock.
I leaned close and tried every word I knew.
sentences.cn: 我靠近了身体，试了试我知道的每一个字。

sentences.en: On my last try, the door opened — and the room inside was completely empty.
sentences.cn: 最后一次尝试时，门开了——里面的房间却空荡荡的。

positive:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled the old scroll on the stone table. Each word inside it gave off a faint glow. 'These are not mere signs,' she said softly. 'Each one carries a *positive* force — it pushes life forward, like sunlight through morning fog.' I traced the first word with one finger and felt warmth rise through my hand.
positive:2.cnHint: 师尊展开古卷，说每个字都带着____的力量，能推动生命向前。
positive:2.hook: But the last word on the scroll had no glow at all.
positive:2.line: 'Each word here carries a *positive* force, like sunlight through morning fog.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled the old scroll on the stone table.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石桌上摊开了那卷古老的卷轴。

sentences.en: Each word inside it gave off a faint glow.
sentences.cn: 卷轴里的每个字都发出了微弱的光芒。

sentences.en: 'These are not mere signs,' she said softly.
sentences.cn: "这些不仅仅是符号，"她轻声说道。

sentences.en: 'Each one carries a *positive* force — it pushes life forward, like sunlight through morning fog.'
I traced the first word with one finger and felt warmth rise through my hand.
sentences.cn: 我用一根手指描过第一个字，感到温暖从手心升起。

economic:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the lower market terrace, where disciples traded word-seeds for spirit stones. 'The whole sect runs on this exchange,' he said, sweeping one hand across the busy stalls. 'It is a small *economic* world of its own, hidden inside the clouds.' I watched a girl trade a single rare seed for a full month of shelter.
economic:2.cnHint: 师兄带我去集市，说门派靠这种____交换体系运转。
economic:2.hook: Then I noticed one stall with no seller — only a locked iron box, trembling.
economic:2.line: 'It is a small *economic* world of its own, hidden inside the clouds.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the lower market terrace, where disciples traded word-seeds for spirit stones.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我来到下层集市平台，弟子们在那里用字种交换灵石。

sentences.en: 'The whole sect runs on this exchange,' he said, sweeping one hand across the busy stalls.
sentences.cn: "整个宗派就靠这种交换运转，"他挥动一只手扫过熙攘的摊位，说道。

sentences.en: 'It is a small *economic* world of its own, hidden inside the clouds.'
I watched a girl trade a single rare seed for a full month of shelter.
sentences.cn: 我看着一个女孩用一颗稀有的种子换了整整一个月的住所。

link:2.en: In the archive cave, I found a stone tablet carved with two words joined by a fine line. Xiaoxing knelt beside me and whispered, 'That carved line is a *link* — it means these two words share one root. Speak them together and they grow stronger.' I tried it, and the cave walls shivered with a sound like distant bells.
link:2.cnHint: 在藏书洞中，小星说两个字之间刻着的细线是一个____，让它们共享一个根。
link:2.hook: The sound kept going long after I stopped speaking.
link:2.line: 'That carved line is a *link* — speak both words together and they grow stronger.'

sentences.en: In the archive cave, I found a stone tablet carved with two words joined by a fine line.
sentences.cn: 在档案洞里，我发现了一块石碑，上面刻着两个由细线连接的字。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing knelt beside me and whispered, 'That carved line is a *link* — it means these two words share one root.
Speak them together and they grow stronger.'
sentences.cn: 一起诵读它们就会变得更强大。

sentences.en: I tried it, and the cave walls shivered with a sound like distant bells.
sentences.cn: 我试了试，洞窟的墙壁随之颤动，发出了远方钟声一样的音响。

produce:2.en: Master Qingwu handed me a clay bowl of ordinary soil and one word-seed no bigger than a grain of rice. 'Press the word into the earth,' she said, 'and wait.' Within three breaths the soil shifted and began to *produce* a thin green shoot, bright as jade, giving off a clean herbal scent. I had made something alive from almost nothing.
produce:2.cnHint: 师尊让我把字种压入土中，土壤很快开始____出一株嫩绿的小苗。
produce:2.hook: The shoot then turned toward me instead of toward the light.
produce:2.line: 'Press the word into earth and watch it *produce* something alive from almost nothing.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu handed me a clay bowl of ordinary soil and one word-seed no bigger than a grain of rice.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊递给我一碗普通的土和一颗字种，不比米粒大多少。

sentences.en: 'Press the word into the earth,' she said, 'and wait.'
sentences.cn: "把字按进土里，"她说，"然后等待。"

sentences.en: Within three breaths the soil shifted and began to *produce* a thin green shoot, bright as jade, giving off a clean herbal scent.
I had made something alive from almost nothing.
sentences.cn: 我用几乎什么都没有创造出了一些活物。

worth:2.en: I spent three days copying the same healing word without rest, my brush hand stiff and sore. On the fourth morning, the word finally lit up gold on the page. Master Qingwu looked at it and gave a slow nod. 'Every hour of effort was *worth* it,' she said quietly. 'A word earned through struggle holds twice the power of one given freely.'
worth:2.cnHint: 经过三天苦练，字终于发出金光，师尊说每一个小时的努力都是____的。
worth:2.hook: She then pointed to a second word on the list — far harder than the first.
worth:2.line: 'Every hour of effort was *worth* it — a hard-won word holds twice the power.'

sentences.en: I spent three days copying the same healing word without rest, my brush hand stiff and sore.
sentences.cn: 我花了三天不停地抄写同一个治疗的字，笔手又僵又酸。

sentences.en: On the fourth morning, the word finally lit up gold on the page.
sentences.cn: 第四天早上，那个字终于在页面上泛起了金光。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu looked at it and gave a slow nod.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊看了一眼，缓缓点了点头。

sentences.en: 'Every hour of effort was *worth* it,' she said quietly.
'A word earned through struggle holds twice the power of one given freely.'
sentences.cn: "一个通过奋斗而得到的字拥有两倍的力量，比那些随意得到的要强得多。"

common:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me the long list of words that all disciples must learn in their first month. Most of them seemed plain, even dull. 'Do not look down on these,' she warned, tapping the list. 'The most *common* word can open the oldest gate — power hides in the familiar.' I looked again and noticed each word was worn smooth, like a stone touched by a thousand hands.
common:2.cnHint: 小星提醒我，最____的字往往能打开最古老的门，力量藏在熟悉之中。
common:2.hook: At the bottom of the list, one word had no translation beside it at all.
common:2.line: 'The most *common* word can open the oldest gate — never look down on it.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me the long list of words that all disciples must learn in their first month.
sentences.cn: 小杏给我看了所有弟子第一个月必须学习的字的长列表。

sentences.en: Most of them seemed plain, even dull.
sentences.cn: 大多数看起来很普通，甚至很乏味。

sentences.en: 'Do not look down on these,' she warned, tapping the list.
sentences.cn: "不要小看这些，"她警告说，点了点列表。

sentences.en: 'The most *common* word can open the oldest gate — power hides in the familiar.'
I looked again and noticed each word was worn smooth, like a stone touched by a thousand hands.
sentences.cn: 我再看一遍，注意到每个字都被磨得光滑了，像被千万只手触摸过的石头。

daily:2.en: Each morning before sunrise I climbed to the outer terrace and read one new word aloud into the open sky. Master Qingwu had said this *daily* practice was the true foundation — not talent, not rare herbs, but the slow layering of effort, word by word, day by day. On the forty-ninth morning the sea of clouds below me suddenly parted, and I saw something dark moving underneath.
daily:2.cnHint: 每天的____练习才是真正的根基，师尊说力量来自日积月累，而非天赋。
daily:2.hook: Whatever moved beneath the clouds was rising fast.
daily:2.line: 'This *daily* practice is your true foundation — not talent, but slow and steady effort.'

sentences.en: Each morning before sunrise I climbed to the outer terrace and read one new word aloud into the open sky.
sentences.cn: 每天日出前，我爬上外层平台，向开放的天空大声诵读一个新字。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had said this *daily* practice was the true foundation — not talent, not rare herbs, but the slow layering of effort, word by word, day by day.
On the forty-ninth morning the sea of clouds below me suddenly parted, and I saw something dark moving underneath.
sentences.cn: 第四十九个早上，我下面的云海突然分开了，我看到有什么黑色的东西在下面移动。

determine:2.en: The sealed scroll arrived at dawn, carried by a wind that smelled of pine and cold stone. I unrolled it slowly. Master Qingwu had written only one line: 'Your path into the inner hall will *determine* whether the Sect accepts your first word-herb.' I read it three times. Outside, the clouds below our mountain turned a deep, warning gold.
determine:2.cnHint: 师尊的封印卷轴令我明白，这次考验将____我能否踏入内堂。
determine:2.hook: The gold in the clouds deepened, then vanished all at once.
determine:2.line: 'Your choice will *determine* the colour of your qi for years to come.'

sentences.en: The sealed scroll arrived at dawn, carried by a wind that smelled of pine and cold stone.
sentences.cn: 密封的卷轴在黎明时到达，由一阵闻起来像松树和冷石头的风带来。

sentences.en: I unrolled it slowly.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢打开它。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had written only one line: 'Your path into the inner hall will *determine* whether the Sect accepts your first word-herb.'
I read it three times.
sentences.cn: 我读了三遍。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds below our mountain turned a deep, warning gold.
sentences.cn: 外面，我们山下的云彩变成了深深的、警告般的金色。

response:2.en: I knocked on the stone door of the archive and waited. No sound came. I knocked again, harder. At last a thin slip of paper slid under the door — Master Qingwu's *response* to my question about the lost healing word. It read: 'Ask the mountain, not the disciple.' The candle behind me blew out with no wind.
response:2.cnHint: 师尊用一张纸条作为____，却让我去问山而不是问人。
response:2.hook: The candle smoke rose in a shape I did not want to name.
response:2.line: 'I have been waiting for your *response* since the last new moon.'

sentences.en: I knocked on the stone door of the archive and waited.
sentences.cn: 我敲了敲档案库的石门，然后等待。

sentences.en: No sound came.
sentences.cn: 没有声音传来。

sentences.en: I knocked again, harder.
sentences.cn: 我又敲了一次，更用力了。

sentences.en: At last a thin slip of paper slid under the door — Master Qingwu's *response* to my question about the lost healing word.
It read: 'Ask the mountain, not the disciple.'
sentences.cn: 上面写着："问山，别问弟子。"

sentences.en: The candle behind me blew out with no wind.
sentences.cn: 我身后的蜡烛在没有风的情况下吹灭了。

search:2.en: Xiaoxing came to me at midday, her eyes wide. 'I began a *search* for the missing herb-word three days ago,' she said, spreading a hand-drawn map across the flat rock between us. Red circles marked every cave on the eastern slope. One cave had been crossed out in fresh ink. Somewhere below us, the clouds gave a low, rolling sound.
search:2.cnHint: 师妹展开地图，告诉我她____失踪药字的经过，其中一处洞穴已被划去。
search:2.hook: The crossed-out cave was the one closest to the cloud line.
search:2.line: 'My *search* led me to a door that should not exist here.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing came to me at midday, her eyes wide.
sentences.cn: 小杏在正午时分来找我，眼睛睁得很大。

sentences.en: 'I began a *search* for the missing herb-word three days ago,' she said, spreading a hand-drawn map across the flat rock between us.
Red circles marked every cave on the eastern slope.
sentences.cn: 红色的圈子标记了东坡上的每一个山洞。

sentences.en: One cave had been crossed out in fresh ink.
sentences.cn: 其中一个山洞被用新鲜的墨水划掉了。

sentences.en: Somewhere below us, the clouds gave a low, rolling sound.
sentences.cn: 我们下方某处，云层发出低沉、翻滚的声音。

due:2.en: Shen Wujiu set my word-herb practice sheet on the stone table. Three characters were circled. 'These errors are *due* to rushing,' he said, tapping each circle slowly. 'A healer who rushes writes death instead of cure.' I nodded, heat rising in my face. Behind him, a thin crack appeared in the mountain wall and then, just as quietly, closed.
due:2.cnHint: 师兄说我的错误____于太过仓促，一个急躁的治愈者只会写出死亡而非治愈。
due:2.hook: The crack in the wall left a smell of something burnt and sweet.
due:2.line: 'These mistakes are *due* to a habit you must break before winter.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu set my word-herb practice sheet on the stone table.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把我的字诀练习纸放在了石桌上。

sentences.en: Three characters were circled.
sentences.cn: 三个字被圈了起来。

sentences.en: 'These errors are *due* to rushing,' he said, tapping each circle slowly.
'A healer who rushes writes death instead of cure.'
sentences.cn: 一个急躁的治愈者写出的是死亡，而不是治疗。

sentences.en: I nodded, heat rising in my face.
sentences.cn: 我点了点头，脸上泛起热意。

sentences.en: Behind him, a thin crack appeared in the mountain wall and then, just as quietly, closed.
sentences.cn: 他身后，山壁上出现了一条细细的裂纹，随即又无声地合上了。

regard:2.en: Master Qingwu stood at the cliff edge, watching the sea of clouds below. I approached and bowed. She did not turn. 'I *regard* this hour before sunset as the only honest moment of the day,' she said. 'The light shows what words hide.' She handed me a small stone carved with a word I had never seen. It was warm, as if recently held.
regard:2.cnHint: 师尊____日落前的时光最为真实，并将一块刻有陌生字符的温热石头交给了我。
regard:2.hook: The carved word began to glow the moment my fingers closed around it.
regard:2.line: 'I *regard* every new disciple as a sentence the Sect has not yet finished writing.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the cliff edge, watching the sea of clouds below.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在崖边，俯视着下方的云海。

sentences.en: I approached and bowed.
sentences.cn: 我走近并行礼。

sentences.en: She did not turn.
sentences.cn: 她没有转身。

sentences.en: 'I *regard* this hour before sunset as the only honest moment of the day,' she said.
'The light shows what words hide.'
sentences.cn: 光线揭露了言语隐瞒的东西。

sentences.en: She handed me a small stone carved with a word I had never seen.
sentences.cn: 她递给我一块小石头，上面刻着一个我从未见过的字。

sentences.en: It was warm, as if recently held.
sentences.cn: 石头是温热的，好像才被人握过。

true:2.en: The old letter was folded inside my practice robe, placed there by a hand I did not see. I opened it carefully. The message was short: 'Only one word-formula in this hall is *true*. The rest are tests.' I looked up at the twelve herb-word banners hanging above me. They all looked identical. A single feather drifted down from the rafters and landed on the third banner from the left.
true:2.cnHint: 一封神秘信件告诉我，大厅中只有一个药字公式是____的，其余皆是考验。
true:2.hook: The feather did not fall like a feather — it fell like a choice.
true:2.line: 'Tell me which reading is *true*, and I will open the inner gate for you.'

sentences.en: The old letter was folded inside my practice robe, placed there by a hand I did not see.
sentences.cn: 那封旧信折叠在我的练功袍里，由一只我没看见的手放进去的。

sentences.en: I opened it carefully.
sentences.cn: 我小心地打开了它。

sentences.en: The message was short: 'Only one word-formula in this hall is *true*.
The rest are tests.'
sentences.cn: 其余的都是考验。

sentences.en: I looked up at the twelve herb-word banners hanging above me.
sentences.cn: 我抬起头，看着上方悬挂的十二条药字横幅。

sentences.en: They all looked identical.
sentences.cn: 它们看起来完全一样。

sentences.en: A single feather drifted down from the rafters and landed on the third banner from the left.
sentences.cn: 一根单独的羽毛从椽子上飘落下来，落在左边第三条横幅上。

depend:2.en: Shen Wujiu found me staring at the two herb-word paths painted on the floor of the lower hall. 'Which way?' I asked. He crouched beside me. 'It will *depend* on what your body remembers, not what your mind has learned,' he said quietly. He straightened, stepped back, and folded his arms. The painted lines beneath my feet began to faintly pulse with light.
depend:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，选择哪条路将____于我身体的记忆，而非头脑所学的知识。
depend:2.hook: Both paths pulsed once, then only one continued to glow.
depend:2.line: 'How fast you heal will *depend* on whether you trust the word or fear it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu found me staring at the two herb-word paths painted on the floor of the lower hall.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎发现我在盯着下殿地板上画着的两条药字之路。

sentences.en: 'Which way?'
sentences.cn: 你选哪条？

sentences.en: I asked.
sentences.cn: 我问道。

sentences.en: He crouched beside me.
sentences.cn: 他在我身边蹲下。

sentences.en: 'It will *depend* on what your body remembers, not what your mind has learned,' he said quietly.
He straightened, stepped back, and folded his arms.
sentences.cn: 他站起身，退后一步，交叉双臂。

sentences.en: The painted lines beneath my feet began to faintly pulse with light.
sentences.cn: 我脚下的绘制线条开始微微发出光芒。

expensive:2.en: The merchant from the lower mountain laid three vials on the cloth before me. Each held a distilled word-herb — rare syllables pressed into liquid form. 'The middle one is the most *expensive*,' he said, watching my hands. 'It holds a word that has not been spoken aloud in forty years.' I reached for it without thinking. The vial was cold, far colder than the air around it.
expensive:2.cnHint: 商人告诉我，中间那瓶最____，因为它封存着一个四十年无人敢出声念诵的字。
expensive:2.hook: When my hand touched the vial, the clouds below the mountain rose three feet.

sentences.en: The merchant from the lower mountain laid three vials on the cloth before me.
sentences.cn: 来自下山的商人在我面前的布上摆了三个小瓶。

sentences.en: Each held a distilled word-herb — rare syllables pressed into liquid form.
sentences.cn: 每个瓶子里都装着一种蒸馏的字诀草药——罕见的音节被压制成液体形式。

sentences.en: 'The middle one is the most *expensive*,' he said, watching my hands.
'It holds a word that has not been spoken aloud in forty years.'
sentences.cn: 它保存着一个四十年未曾出声的字。

sentences.en: I reached for it without thinking.
sentences.cn: 我想都没想就伸手去拿。

sentences.en: The vial was cold, far colder than the air around it.
sentences.cn: 瓶子冰冷刺骨，远比周围的空气还要冷。

conduct:2.en: A sealed bamboo scroll arrived at my door before dawn, stamped with Master Qingwu's mark. Inside, a single line described how a disciple's *conduct* in the herb garden — every careful step, every quiet breath — shaped the potency of the words they later spoke. I pressed the scroll to my chest and listened to the wind.
conduct:2.cnHint: 一封封好的竹简在黎明前送到了我门口，讲述弟子的____会影响草药的灵力。
conduct:2.hook: Outside, a single white petal fell upward into the clouds.
conduct:2.line: 'Your *conduct* among the herbs speaks louder than any formula you learn.'

sentences.en: A sealed bamboo scroll arrived at my door before dawn, stamped with Master Qingwu's mark.
sentences.cn: 一个密封的竹简在天亮前送到了我的门口，盖着青梧师尊的印记。

sentences.en: Inside, a single line described how a disciple's *conduct* in the herb garden — every careful step, every quiet breath — shaped the potency of the words they later spoke.
I pressed the scroll to my chest and listened to the wind.
sentences.cn: 我把竹简贴在胸口，听着风声。

reveal:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a hollow behind the waterfall where the mist was thickest. He pressed both palms to a mossy stone, and the rock split open to *reveal* a row of glowing seed pods, each one humming a different syllable of an ancient word. My breath caught in my throat.
reveal:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到瀑布后的石洞，双掌一按，岩石裂开，____出一排发光的种荚。
reveal:2.hook: One pod pulsed in rhythm with my own heartbeat.
reveal:2.line: 'These stones *reveal* themselves only to those who carry true intent.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a hollow behind the waterfall where the mist was thickest.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎领我来到瀑布后面的一个凹地，那里雾气最浓。

sentences.en: He pressed both palms to a mossy stone, and the rock split open to *reveal* a row of glowing seed pods, each one humming a different syllable of an ancient word.
My breath caught in my throat.
sentences.cn: 我的呼吸停住了。

powerful:2.en: Xiaoxing placed a small clay jar in my hands and told me it contained the dust of a word so *powerful* that even Master Qingwu kept it locked below the lowest cloud tier. The jar was warm and faintly trembling, as though something inside still remembered what it once could do.
powerful:2.cnHint: 师妹递给我一只小陶罐，说里面装着一个____无比的词语的尘粉，连师尊都将它封存在最低的云层之下。
powerful:2.hook: A thin crack appeared along the jar's rim as I held it.
powerful:2.line: 'A *powerful* word imprisoned is still a word that wants to be spoken.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing placed a small clay jar in my hands and told me it contained the dust of a word so *powerful* that even Master Qingwu kept it locked below the lowest cloud tier.
The jar was warm and faintly trembling, as though something inside still remembered what it once could do.
sentences.cn: 那个罐子温热而微微颤抖，好像里面的东西还记得自己曾经能做什么。

wonder:2.en: Xiaoxing sat beside the sky pool and stared at the cloud map floating above the water. 'I *wonder* whether the path on the eastern edge was drawn for those who are ready,' she said softly, 'or for those who only believe they are.' The map shivered and folded itself into a crane.
wonder:2.cnHint: 师妹坐在天池边，凝视水面上漂浮的云图，轻声说她____东边那条路究竟为谁而设。
wonder:2.hook: The paper crane flew one circle and then dropped into the water.
wonder:2.line: 'I *wonder* if the map answers only the question you are afraid to ask.'
