sentences.en: Xiaoxing sat beside the sky pool and stared at the cloud map floating above the water.
sentences.cn: 小杏坐在天池旁，盯着浮在水面上的云图。

sentences.en: 'I *wonder* whether the path on the eastern edge was drawn for those who are ready,' she said softly, 'or for those who only believe they are.'
The map shivered and folded itself into a crane.
sentences.cn: 云图颤抖着，把自己折成了一只纸鹤。

design:2.en: Master Qingwu left a diagram on the stone table outside the gate — a lattice of roots and syllables she had used to *design* the sect's oldest healing formula. Every line crossed every other line at a precise angle. I spent the whole morning tracing it without once reaching the centre.
design:2.cnHint: 师尊在石桌上留下一张图，那是她用来____门派最古老疗愈法式的根系与音节格阵。
design:2.hook: At noon, a shadow fell across the diagram in the shape of a hand.
design:2.line: 'I did not *design* this for speed — I designed it to teach patience.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu left a diagram on the stone table outside the gate — a lattice of roots and syllables she had used to *design* the sect's oldest healing formula.
Every line crossed every other line at a precise angle.
sentences.cn: 每条线都以精确的角度与其他线相交。

sentences.en: I spent the whole morning tracing it without once reaching the centre.
sentences.cn: 我整个上午都在描描它，却始终到不了中心。

exercise:2.en: Each morning before mist lifted, Shen Wujiu would *exercise* on the narrow ledge above the cloud line, repeating each word-form slowly, the syllables rising as visible breath in the cold air. He told me the body had to learn a word before the voice could trust it fully.
exercise:2.cnHint: 每天清晨，师兄在云线上方的窄石台上____，将每个词的形态反复演练，让身体先于声音记住它。
exercise:2.hook: This morning his shadow on the rock face was shaped wrong.
exercise:2.line: '*Exercise* the word with your feet and your hands before you speak it aloud.'

sentences.en: Each morning before mist lifted, Shen Wujiu would *exercise* on the narrow ledge above the cloud line, repeating each word-form slowly, the syllables rising as visible breath in the cold air.
He told me the body had to learn a word before the voice could trust it fully.
sentences.cn: 他告诉我身体必须先学会一个字，声音才能完全信任它。

space:2.en: Behind the eastern library wall, a narrow *space* between two shelves held nothing but a faint scent — pine resin and something older, like rain before it falls. Xiaoxing said that Master Qingwu had cleared that gap deliberately, so that one word, when it was finally ready, would have somewhere to live.
space:2.cnHint: 东藏书楼两排书架之间有一处狭窄的____，师妹说师尊特意留空，等待某个词语准备好后来此安居。
space:2.hook: The scent grew suddenly stronger when I leaned close and whispered nothing.
space:2.line: 'Every word needs a *space* to rest before it is strong enough to be used.'

sentences.en: Behind the eastern library wall, a narrow *space* between two shelves held nothing but a faint scent — pine resin and something older, like rain before it falls.
Xiaoxing said that Master Qingwu had cleared that gap deliberately, so that one word, when it was finally ready, would have somewhere to live.
sentences.cn: 小杏说青梧师尊故意把那个空隙清理了出来，这样当一个字终于准备好的时候，就有地方住。

career:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a pale scroll across the stone table. 'Every disciple who enters this sect must choose a path,' she said quietly. 'Healing, battle, or flight — your *career* as a cultivator begins with that single choice.' I pressed my hand to the silk and felt three distinct pulses rise through my fingers.
career:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，每位弟子都必须选择一条____，从而开始修行之路。
career:2.hook: One of the three pulses was far colder than it should have been.
career:2.line: 'Your *career* as a cultivator begins with that single choice.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a pale scroll across the stone table.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石桌上铺开了一卷淡色的卷轴。

sentences.en: 'Every disciple who enters this sect must choose a path,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "每个进入本宗的弟子都要选择一条路，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: 'Healing, battle, or flight — your *career* as a cultivator begins with that single choice.'
I pressed my hand to the silk and felt three distinct pulses rise through my fingers.
sentences.cn: 我把手按在丝绸上，感觉到三股不同的脉动穿过我的指尖。

medium:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin jade slip carved with a single word. 'In our sect, jade is the *medium* through which a spoken word travels to another disciple,' he explained, 'the way water carries a stone's ripple to the far shore.' I held it up; the character inside glowed faintly, then went dark.
medium:2.cnHint: 师兄解释说，玉简是传递话语的____，就像水传递涟漪一样。
medium:2.hook: The glow returned — and the character on the slip had changed.
medium:2.line: 'Jade is the *medium* through which a spoken word travels to another disciple.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin jade slip carved with a single word.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一块薄薄的玉简，上面刻着一个字。

sentences.en: 'In our sect, jade is the *medium* through which a spoken word travels to another disciple,' he explained, 'the way water carries a stone's ripple to the far shore.'
I held it up; the character inside glowed faintly, then went dark.
sentences.cn: 我把它举起来，里面的字微微发亮，随后又暗了下去。

office:2.en: At the peak of the second mountain stood a small stone room that disciples called the *office* of records. Every word a cultivator had ever spoken in training was kept there, pressed into bamboo strips. I climbed the steep path alone and found the door already open, the strips scattered across the floor.
office:2.cnHint: 山顶有一间存放所有弟子修炼记录的____，我独自前去时，门竟然已经开着。
office:2.hook: One bamboo strip near the entrance bore my name — written in ink that was still wet.
office:2.line: 'Come to the *office* of records before the next bell, or your words will be sealed.'

sentences.en: At the peak of the second mountain stood a small stone room that disciples called the *office* of records.
Every word a cultivator had ever spoken in training was kept there, pressed into bamboo strips.
sentences.cn: 每一个修行弟子在训练中说过的话都被保存在那里，压在竹简上。

sentences.en: I climbed the steep path alone and found the door already open, the strips scattered across the floor.
sentences.cn: 我独自爬过陡峭的山路，发现门已经开了，竹简散落在地板上。

culture:2.en: Xiaoxing sat beside me at the edge of the cliff, her feet dangling above the clouds. 'The *culture* of our sect is built on one truth,' she said softly, 'that every word you learn changes the shape of your spirit, the way rain slowly changes stone.' Below us the sea of clouds shifted, and something vast moved beneath its surface.
culture:2.cnHint: 师妹告诉我，本门的____建立在一个真理之上：每一个词都会改变修行者的灵魂。
culture:2.hook: The clouds parted just enough to show a shadow larger than any mountain.
culture:2.line: 'The *culture* of our sect is built on one truth — words change the spirit.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing sat beside me at the edge of the cliff, her feet dangling above the clouds.
sentences.cn: 小杏坐在我身边，靠近悬崖边，两脚在云层上晃啊晃。

sentences.en: 'The *culture* of our sect is built on one truth,' she said softly, 'that every word you learn changes the shape of your spirit, the way rain slowly changes stone.'
Below us the sea of clouds shifted, and something vast moved beneath its surface.
sentences.cn: 我们下方的云海涌动着，一个巨大的东西在表面下移动。

college:2.en: Master Qingwu called our training hall a *college* of living words. 'Other sects study dead texts,' she said, standing at the centre of the circular room. 'Here every character breathes.' She pressed two fingers to the stone wall, and a hundred glowing words bloomed outward like petals opening at dawn.
college:2.cnHint: 师尊将我们的修炼堂称为活字____，说这里每一个字都有生命。
college:2.hook: One word near the ceiling pulsed faster than all the others — it looked like a warning.
college:2.line: 'Welcome to the *college* of living words — nothing here is still.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu called our training hall a *college* of living words.
'Other sects study dead texts,' she said, standing at the centre of the circular room.
sentences.cn: "其他宗派研究死去的文本，"她站在圆形大厅的中央说。

sentences.en: 'Here every character breathes.'
sentences.cn: 这里的每个字都活着。

sentences.en: She pressed two fingers to the stone wall, and a hundred glowing words bloomed outward like petals opening at dawn.
sentences.cn: 她用两根手指按在石墙上，一百个闪闪发光的字向外绽放，像清晨花瓣打开的样子。

value:2.en: I found an old ledger tucked behind the water jar in the store room. Each entry listed a word and a number beside it. Shen Wujiu glanced over my shoulder and said quietly, 'The *value* of a word in this sect is measured by how many lives it has saved, not by how rare it is.' The highest number on the page belonged to the simplest word of all.
value:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，在本门，一个词的____由它曾救过多少人来衡量，而非稀有程度。
value:2.hook: The simplest word had been crossed out — and recently.
value:2.line: 'The *value* of a word is measured by how many lives it has saved.'

sentences.en: I found an old ledger tucked behind the water jar in the store room.
sentences.cn: 我在储藏室水罐后面找到了一本旧账簿。

sentences.en: Each entry listed a word and a number beside it.
sentences.cn: 每一条记录都列着一个字和一个数字。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu glanced over my shoulder and said quietly, 'The *value* of a word in this sect is measured by how many lives it has saved, not by how rare it is.'
The highest number on the page belonged to the simplest word of all.
sentences.cn: 页面上最高的数字属于最简单的一个字。

connection:2.en: During the night meditation, I felt it — a faint thread of warmth linking my chest to the mountain beneath me. Xiaoxing had described this once as the first *connection* between a disciple and the sect's root word, buried deep in the stone. I breathed slowly and the thread grew stronger, then suddenly snapped like a broken string.
connection:2.cnHint: 打坐时，我第一次感受到了弟子与宗门根字之间的____，但它突然断开了。
connection:2.hook: In the silence that followed, something else reached back along that broken thread.
connection:2.line: 'That warmth is the *connection* between you and the sect's root word — guard it.'

sentences.en: During the night meditation, I felt it — a faint thread of warmth linking my chest to the mountain beneath me.
sentences.cn: 在夜间冥想中，我感觉到了——一根细细的温暖线索从我的胸口连到了我脚下的山。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing had described this once as the first *connection* between a disciple and the sect's root word, buried deep in the stone.
I breathed slowly and the thread grew stronger, then suddenly snapped like a broken string.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓呼吸，线索变得更强，随后突然断开，像一根绷断的绳子。

story:2.en: On my third night in the sect I could not sleep, so I climbed to the library shelf and pulled down the oldest volume. It held a single long *story* written in a dialect I barely knew, about a disciple who learned one word so deeply that the word began to speak back. I set the book down carefully when I reached the final line.
story:2.cnHint: 入门第三夜，我在图书馆读到一个古老的____，讲述一位弟子将一个词修炼到极致后发生的事。
story:2.hook: The final line read: 'And on the third night, a new disciple found this page.'
story:2.line: 'Every *story* in that library was written by a disciple who did not finish their path.'

sentences.en: On my third night in the sect I could not sleep, so I climbed to the library shelf and pulled down the oldest volume.
sentences.cn: 进宗的第三个晚上我睡不着，就爬到书架上拿下了最古老的那本书。

sentences.en: It held a single long *story* written in a dialect I barely knew, about a disciple who learned one word so deeply that the word began to speak back.
I set the book down carefully when I reached the final line.
sentences.cn: 当我读到最后一行时，我小心地把书放了下来。

explain:2.en: A folded note appeared under my door before dawn. I opened it to find a single line of script I did not recognise. When I brought it to Shen Wujiu, he studied it and said he could *explain* the symbol — it was an old healing word, lost for a generation, and someone had left it for me on purpose.
explain:2.cnHint: 我在门下发现一张纸条，师兄帮我____了纸条上那个陌生符文的含义。
explain:2.hook: But Shen Wujiu's hand trembled as he spoke.
explain:2.line: 'I can *explain* this symbol, but not why it chose you.'

sentences.en: A folded note appeared under my door before dawn.
sentences.cn: 天亮前，一张折好的纸条出现在我的门下。

sentences.en: I opened it to find a single line of script I did not recognise.
sentences.cn: 我打开它，发现一行我不认识的笔迹。

sentences.en: When I brought it to Shen Wujiu, he studied it and said he could *explain* the symbol — it was an old healing word, lost for a generation, and someone had left it for me on purpose.

examine:2.en: Master Qingwu called me to the Archive Pavilion and placed a jade slip on the stone table before me. 'Do not touch it yet,' she said. 'First, *examine* it with your eyes alone.' The slip was cracked along one edge, and inside the crack a faint green light breathed like something alive.
examine:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊让我先用眼睛仔细____一块破损的玉简，然后才允许我触碰它。
examine:2.hook: The green light blinked once — then went dark.
examine:2.line: '*Examine* the crack first; what you see there will decide everything.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu called me to the Archive Pavilion and placed a jade slip on the stone table before me.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把我叫到了档案阁，在石桌前放了一块玉简。

sentences.en: 'Do not touch it yet,' she said.
sentences.cn: "先别碰，"她说。

sentences.en: 'First, *examine* it with your eyes alone.'
The slip was cracked along one edge, and inside the crack a faint green light breathed like something alive.
sentences.cn: 玉简沿着一条边缘有裂纹，裂缝里有一道淡绿的光，像活着的东西一样呼吸。

influence:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me a cluster of silver-script herbs she had grown in a small pot by the window. She said that the words a disciple whispered nearby could *influence* the way the herbs formed — kind words made the leaves broad and bright, harsh ones made them curl and pale. I looked at my own pot and felt ashamed.
influence:2.cnHint: 小星告诉我，修士平日说的话能____药草生长的形态，我看着自己枯萎的药草沉默了。
influence:2.hook: A single leaf on my pot split cleanly down the middle.
influence:2.line: 'Your words *influence* the herbs more than your hands ever will.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me a cluster of silver-script herbs she had grown in a small pot by the window.
sentences.cn: 小杏给我看了一簇银色纹路的草药，她在窗边的小盆子里养着。

sentences.en: She said that the words a disciple whispered nearby could *influence* the way the herbs formed — kind words made the leaves broad and bright, harsh ones made them curl and pale.
I looked at my own pot and felt ashamed.
sentences.cn: 我看了看自己的盆子，感到羞愧。

argue:2.en: I heard voices in the corridor before breakfast. Shen Wujiu and another disciple were standing by the message board, and they began to *argue* over which of two root-formulas was safer to carry through the lower clouds. Their voices rose, then stopped at once — a warning bell, low and slow, was ringing somewhere far below the mountain.
argue:2.cnHint: 早饭前我听见师兄与另一位师弟在走廊里____，争论携带哪种根式穿越云层更安全。
argue:2.hook: The bell rang a second time, closer than before.
argue:2.line: 'We can *argue* the theory later — right now we need to move.'

sentences.en: I heard voices in the corridor before breakfast.
sentences.cn: 早饭前我听到走廊里传来说话声。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu and another disciple were standing by the message board, and they began to *argue* over which of two root-formulas was safer to carry through the lower clouds.
Their voices rose, then stopped at once — a warning bell, low and slow, was ringing somewhere far below the mountain.
sentences.cn: 他们的声音越来越大，突然停了下来——一口警钟从山下远处缓缓响起，声音低沉而悠长。

pass:2.en: The narrow bridge between the East Peak and the Herb Tower was barely wide enough for two. I watched Master Qingwu *pass* a sealed clay jar to Xiaoxing without a word, and Xiaoxing held it with both hands as if it might shatter. Neither of them looked down at the sea of clouds far below.
pass:2.cnHint: 我看见青雾师尊在悬桥上将一只封泥罐____给小星，两人都没有低头看脚下的云海。
pass:2.hook: A crack ran along the bridge stone where Master Qingwu had stepped.
pass:2.line: '*Pass* this to no one else — not until I tell you it is time.'

sentences.en: The narrow bridge between the East Peak and the Herb Tower was barely wide enough for two.
sentences.cn: 东峰和药塔之间的狭窄桥面只能勉强容纳两个人。

sentences.en: I watched Master Qingwu *pass* a sealed clay jar to Xiaoxing without a word, and Xiaoxing held it with both hands as if it might shatter.
Neither of them looked down at the sea of clouds far below.
sentences.cn: 他们都没有低头看那远处云海深处。

serious:2.en: Xiaoxing came to find me at dusk, her face more *serious* than I had ever seen it. She laid a folded cloth on the table between us and opened it slowly: inside was a torn page from the Sect's oldest record book, and on it was my name written in red ink, next to a date that had not yet come.
serious:2.cnHint: 黄昏时小星神情____地来找我，打开布包给我看了一页写有我名字的古籍残页。
serious:2.hook: The red ink was still wet.
serious:2.line: 'This is *serious* — that date is only three days away.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing came to find me at dusk, her face more *serious* than I had ever seen it.

She laid a folded cloth on the table between us and opened it slowly: inside was a torn page from the Sect's oldest record book, and on it was my name written in red ink, next to a date that had not yet come.
sentences.cn: 她在我们之间的桌上铺开一块折叠的布，缓缓打开了：里面是宗派最古老的记录书上撕下的一页，上面用红墨写着我的名字，旁边是一个还未到来的日期。

despite:2.en: The morning mist was so thick I could barely see the path. *Despite* the poor light, I managed to read the formula carved into the gate post by tracing each stroke with one finger. The last character was one I had never studied, yet my hand moved through it as if it already knew the shape.
despite:2.cnHint: 尽管晨雾浓重，我____视线不清，仍用手指摸索着读出了门柱上刻的法式，最后一个字却陌生得让我心惊。
despite:2.hook: My finger left a faint glow on the stone where it had traced.
despite:2.line: '*Despite* the fog, you read every stroke — that is not an accident.'

sentences.en: The morning mist was so thick I could barely see the path.
sentences.cn: 晨雾浓得我几乎看不清脚下的路。

sentences.en: *Despite* the poor light, I managed to read the formula carved into the gate post by tracing each stroke with one finger.
The last character was one I had never studied, yet my hand moved through it as if it already knew the shape.
sentences.cn: 最后一个字是我从未学过的，但我的手指却像已经熟悉它的形状一样划过。

express:2.en: I stood before Master Qingwu after my first full recitation of the Cloud-Root formula. I wanted to *express* how strange and large it had felt inside my chest when the words took hold, but the language I had grown up with seemed too small for it. She nodded as if she had heard the feeling anyway.
express:2.cnHint: 我在师尊面前背完第一篇云根法式后，想____内心那种奇异的震动，却发现语言不够用。
express:2.hook: Behind Master Qingwu, the candle flame bent toward me and did not straighten.
express:2.line: 'Try to *express* what you felt — the formula listens to more than sound.'

sentences.en: I stood before Master Qingwu after my first full recitation of the Cloud-Root formula.
sentences.cn: 我在青梧师尊面前完整地诵读了一遍云根咒语。

sentences.en: I wanted to *express* how strange and large it had felt inside my chest when the words took hold, but the language I had grown up with seemed too small for it.
She nodded as if she had heard the feeling anyway.
sentences.cn: 她点了点头，仿佛她已经听到了那种感受。

real:2.en: The old stone tablet at the mountain's edge had been covered in moss for years. When I brushed it clean, carved words glowed with a soft blue light. Shen Wujiu stepped closer and whispered that the glow was *real* spiritual energy, not a trick of the morning mist. My fingers trembled as I traced each word.
real:2.cnHint: 我在山边石碑上发现了发光的文字，师兄说那____是灵力而非幻觉。
real:2.hook: Below the last carved word, a fresh scratch had appeared overnight.
real:2.line: 'I am telling you, this glow is *real* — touch it and you will feel the warmth.'

sentences.en: The old stone tablet at the mountain's edge had been covered in moss for years.
sentences.cn: 山边的老石碑被苔藓覆盖了多年。

sentences.en: When I brushed it clean, carved words glowed with a soft blue light.
sentences.cn: 我把它擦干净时，刻在上面的字发出了柔和的蓝光。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stepped closer and whispered that the glow was *real* spiritual energy, not a trick of the morning mist.
My fingers trembled as I traced each word.
sentences.cn: 我的手指颤抖着描过每一个字。

talk:2.en: Master Qingwu rarely left her pavilion, so when she summoned me at dawn I feared the worst. She set a small jade box on the table between us and said nothing for a long moment. Then she began her *talk*, each word landing like a stone dropped into still water. The box, she said, had arrived sealed with my name on it.
talk:2.cnHint: 师尊将一个玉盒放在桌上，与我进行了一场重要的____。
talk:2.hook: She never told me who had sent it.
talk:2.line: 'This *talk* between us must not leave this room — do you understand?'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu rarely left her pavilion, so when she summoned me at dawn I feared the worst.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊很少离开她的阁楼，所以当她在黎明时召我去时，我心想一定是出了大事。

sentences.en: She set a small jade box on the table between us and said nothing for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 她在我们之间的桌上放了一个小玉盒，沉默了很久。

sentences.en: Then she began her *talk*, each word landing like a stone dropped into still water.
The box, she said, had arrived sealed with my name on it.
sentences.cn: 那个盒子，她说，是密封着我的名字送来的。

energy:2.en: Xiaoxing found the cracked spirit stone in the library's lowest shelf and brought it to me at once. Even broken, it pulsed with a steady warmth against my palm. She explained that a whole stone of this grade held enough *energy* to lift a disciple three levels in a single season. We stared at each other in silence.
energy:2.cnHint: 晓星找到了一块破碎的灵石，它蕴含的____足以让弟子快速晋级。
energy:2.hook: A thin crack in the stone widened as we watched.
energy:2.line: 'Feel this — the *energy* inside it is still alive and pushing outward.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found the cracked spirit stone in the library's lowest shelf and brought it to me at once.
sentences.cn: 小杏在图书馆最低的架子上找到了那块裂纹的灵石，立刻拿给了我。

sentences.en: Even broken, it pulsed with a steady warmth against my palm.
sentences.cn: 即使破损了，它在我掌心仍然跳动着稳定的温暖。

sentences.en: She explained that a whole stone of this grade held enough *energy* to lift a disciple three levels in a single season.
We stared at each other in silence.
sentences.cn: 我们沉默地彼此对视。

plan:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread a hand-drawn map across the reading stone and pointed to a narrow path that circled the mountain's blind side. He had spent three nights working out every step. 'A good *plan*,' Master Qingwu said from the doorway, 'but it assumes the bridge is still standing.' None of us had checked.
plan:2.cnHint: 师兄展示了他精心制定的____，但师尊指出了一个关键疏漏。
plan:2.hook: Somewhere below, the clouds shifted to reveal a gap where the bridge should have been.
plan:2.line: 'My *plan* gives us three safe hours before the mist rises again.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread a hand-drawn map across the reading stone and pointed to a narrow path that circled the mountain's blind side.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在读石上铺开一张手绘地图，指向一条绕过山后盲侧的狭窄小径。

sentences.en: He had spent three nights working out every step.
sentences.cn: 他花了整整三个晚上规划好了每一步。

sentences.en: 'A good *plan*,' Master Qingwu said from the doorway, 'but it assumes the bridge is still standing.'
None of us had checked.
sentences.cn: 我们谁都没去检查过。

bear:2.en: The great cloud-cedar at the sect's northern gate had not bloomed in forty years. I passed it every morning without a second thought. Today a single silver blossom had opened on its highest branch, and Xiaoxing told me in a hushed voice that the tree would only *bear* flowers when something of great weight was about to change.
bear:2.cnHint: 北门的云杉开出了银色花朵，师妹说它只在重大变故前才会____花。
bear:2.hook: By evening, seven more blossoms had appeared, each facing the same direction.
bear:2.line: 'They say it will *bear* flowers only once in a disciple's lifetime — and today is that day.'

sentences.en: The great cloud-cedar at the sect's northern gate had not bloomed in forty years.
sentences.cn: 宗派北门那棵伟大的云杉已经四十年没有开花了。

sentences.en: I passed it every morning without a second thought.
sentences.cn: 我每天早上经过它都没有多看一眼。

sentences.en: Today a single silver blossom had opened on its highest branch, and Xiaoxing told me in a hushed voice that the tree would only *bear* flowers when something of great weight was about to change.

organization:2.en: A letter arrived by wind-crane, its seal stamped with a mark I did not know. Shen Wujiu studied it and told me the mark belonged to the Hollow Peak Assembly, an *organization* of wandering scholars who collected lost spiritual words from forgotten sects. They were asking for a meeting. Master Qingwu's expression did not change, but her tea went cold.
organization:2.cnHint: 一封信来自一个叫空峰会的____，他们请求与宗门会面。
organization:2.hook: The wind-crane that delivered the letter had not eaten its seed.
organization:2.line: 'This *organization* has not written to any sect in over thirty years — something has changed.'

sentences.en: A letter arrived by wind-crane, its seal stamped with a mark I did not know.
sentences.cn: 一封信乘风鹤而至，封上盖着我不认识的印记。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu studied it and told me the mark belonged to the Hollow Peak Assembly, an *organization* of wandering scholars who collected lost spiritual words from forgotten sects.
They were asking for a meeting.
sentences.cn: 他们要求安排一次见面。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu's expression did not change, but her tea went cold.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊的表情没有变化，但她的茶已经凉了。

opportunity:2.en: The annual Gathering of Clouds was three days away, when disciples from every sect traded rare words along the sky-market bridges. Xiaoxing gripped my sleeve and said we should go together, because a disciple only heard certain healing words spoken aloud once in their training. 'This is the *opportunity*,' she said, eyes bright. 'Miss it and wait another year.'
opportunity:2.cnHint: 云聚大会即将举行，师妹说这是获得稀有功法的难得____。
opportunity:2.hook: A second letter arrived that same night, forbidding all junior disciples from attending.
opportunity:2.line: 'We cannot waste this *opportunity* — words like those are not written in any book.'

sentences.en: The annual Gathering of Clouds was three days away, when disciples from every sect traded rare words along the sky-market bridges.
sentences.cn: 一年一度的云集大会还有三天就要开始了，那时各派的弟子都会在天市桥上交换稀有的字诀。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing gripped my sleeve and said we should go together, because a disciple only heard certain healing words spoken aloud once in their training.
sentences.cn: 小杏紧紧握住我的袖子，说我们应该一起去，因为一个弟子在修行中只会听到某些疗愈字诀被念诵一次。

sentences.en: 'This is the *opportunity*,' she said, eyes bright.
'Miss it and wait another year.'
sentences.cn: 错过这一次就要再等一年。

professor:2.en: Among the visitors at the outer gate was an old woman with ink-stained sleeves and a walking stick carved from black pine. Shen Wujiu told me quietly that she held the title of *professor* at the Cloud Word Academy, the only school permitted to study forbidden script. She had asked to see no one but me. I had never heard of the Academy before that morning.
professor:2.cnHint: 一位云字学院的____来到门前，点名只见我一人，而我从未听说过那所学院。
professor:2.hook: In her sleeve, a rolled scroll pulsed with faint red light.
professor:2.line: 'A *professor* of forbidden script does not travel this far without a very serious reason.'

sentences.en: Among the visitors at the outer gate was an old woman with ink-stained sleeves and a walking stick carved from black pine.
sentences.cn: 来访者中有一位老妇人，袖口沾满墨迹，拄着一根黑松雕成的拐杖。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me quietly that she held the title of *professor* at the Cloud Word Academy, the only school permitted to study forbidden script.
She had asked to see no one but me.
sentences.cn: 她要求只见我一个人。

sentences.en: I had never heard of the Academy before that morning.
sentences.cn: 那天上午之前，我从未听说过这个学院。

sign:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled the old scroll on the stone table. At its centre sat a single brushed character, glowing faintly gold. 'This *sign* was left by the founders,' she said. 'It holds the oldest healing word the sect has ever known.' I leaned closer, and the gold deepened to amber.
sign:2.cnHint: 师尊展开古卷，指着中央那个发光的____，说它藏着门派最古老的治愈之字。
sign:2.hook: Then the amber light flickered and went dark.
sign:2.line: 'This *sign* has not glowed for three hundred years — until tonight.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled the old scroll on the stone table.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石桌上展开了那幅古老的卷轴。

sentences.en: At its centre sat a single brushed character, glowing faintly gold.
sentences.cn: 卷轴中央坐着一个笔画而成的字，闪烁着淡淡的金光。

sentences.en: 'This *sign* was left by the founders,' she said.
'It holds the oldest healing word the sect has ever known.'
sentences.cn: 它承载着宗派所知最古老的治愈之言。

sentences.en: I leaned closer, and the gold deepened to amber.
sentences.cn: 我靠得更近，金光加深成了琥珀色。

feeling:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small jade slip carved with a single word. The moment my fingers closed around it, a warm current ran up my arm. 'That *feeling*,' he said softly, 'means the word inside has chosen you.' I stood very still, afraid to breathe.
feeling:2.cnHint: 师兄递给我一块玉简，我握住它时有一种奇异的____，他说这意味着玉简中的字选择了我。
feeling:2.hook: Outside, a cold wind rose from the clouds below.
feeling:2.line: 'Trust the *feeling* — it does not come to every disciple.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small jade slip carved with a single word.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一块小玉简，上面雕刻着一个字。

sentences.en: The moment my fingers closed around it, a warm current ran up my arm.
sentences.cn: 我的手指刚要合紧它，一股温热的气流就沿着手臂上升。

sentences.en: 'That *feeling*,' he said softly, 'means the word inside has chosen you.'
I stood very still, afraid to breathe.
sentences.cn: 我站得很静，生怕呼吸。

professional:2.en: The visiting elder from the eastern peak watched me recite the wind formula without a single error. She gave a slow nod. 'Your delivery is already *professional*,' she told Master Qingwu. 'Most new disciples stumble here for months.' A pleased warmth rose in my chest, then I saw Master Qingwu frown.
professional:2.cnHint: 来访的长老称赞我的表现已经很____了，可师尊的眉头却皱了起来。
professional:2.hook: Master Qingwu's frown said the elder had missed something.
professional:2.line: '*Professional* form means nothing if the root word is hollow.'

sentences.en: The visiting elder from the eastern peak watched me recite the wind formula without a single error.
sentences.cn: 来自东峰的访问长老看着我没有出一个错地背诵了风咒。

sentences.en: She gave a slow nod.
sentences.cn: 她缓缓点了点头。

sentences.en: 'Your delivery is already *professional*,' she told Master Qingwu.
'Most new disciples stumble here for months.'
sentences.cn: 大多数新弟子要在这里磕磕绊绊好几个月。

sentences.en: A pleased warmth rose in my chest, then I saw Master Qingwu frown.
sentences.cn: 一股欣喜的暖意在我胸口升起，随后我看到青梧师尊皱起了眉头。

behind:2.en: Xiaoxing had joined the sect one season before me, yet her word-garden already held forty living herbs. Mine held twelve. 'You are not truly *behind*,' she said, pulling a glowing leaf and pressing it into my palm. 'You just started from a different soil.' The leaf was warm, and it did not fade.
behind:2.cnHint: 小星比我早入门一季，她说我并不真的____于她，只是起点的土壤不同。
behind:2.hook: But that night my twelve herbs began to wither one by one.
behind:2.line: 'Falling *behind* only matters if you stop moving forward.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing had joined the sect one season before me, yet her word-garden already held forty living herbs.
sentences.cn: 小杏比我早加入宗派一个季节，她的字园里已经有四十株活生生的草药。

sentences.en: Mine held twelve.
sentences.cn: 我的只有十二株。

sentences.en: 'You are not truly *behind*,' she said, pulling a glowing leaf and pressing it into my palm.
'You just started from a different soil.'
sentences.cn: 你只是从不同的土壤开始的。

sentences.en: The leaf was warm, and it did not fade.
sentences.cn: 叶子是温热的，也没有褪色。

government:2.en: An old record in the library described a time when a council of word-masters formed a *government* over all the floating peaks. They set laws for which words could be spoken aloud and which must stay sealed. Master Qingwu had told us that council vanished without explanation five hundred years ago.
government:2.cnHint: 古籍记载，曾有一群字师组成____管理所有浮山，但那个议会在五百年前无故消失了。
government:2.hook: The page after that entry had been carefully torn away.
government:2.line: 'No *government* of words has risen since — and perhaps that is wise.'

sentences.en: An old record in the library described a time when a council of word-masters formed a *government* over all the floating peaks.
They set laws for which words could be spoken aloud and which must stay sealed.
sentences.cn: 他们为哪些字可以大声诵读、哪些必须封存制定了法律。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had told us that council vanished without explanation five hundred years ago.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊曾告诉我们那个议会在五百年前不知所踪地消失了。

growth:2.en: Master Qingwu measured my word-garden each morning with a thread of silver light. Today the thread lingered over a small blue herb I had planted only three days ago. 'Remarkable *growth*,' she murmured. 'This word usually takes a full month.' She wrote something in her record book and did not show me the page.
growth:2.cnHint: 师尊每天用银光丝线测量我的字田，今天她对一棵蓝草的____感到惊讶，却没把记录本让我看。
growth:2.hook: That evening the blue herb doubled in size again.
growth:2.line: 'Such *growth* in three days — I have not seen this in forty years.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu measured my word-garden each morning with a thread of silver light.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊每天早上用一线银光测量我的字园。

sentences.en: Today the thread lingered over a small blue herb I had planted only three days ago.
sentences.cn: 今天那线银光在我只种了三天的一株小蓝草上停留了下来。

sentences.en: 'Remarkable *growth*,' she murmured.
'This word usually takes a full month.'
sentences.cn: 这个字通常需要整整一个月才能长成。

sentences.en: She wrote something in her record book and did not show me the page.
sentences.cn: 她在记录簿上写下了什么，没让我看那一页。

negative:2.en: Shen Wujiu warned me before I entered the echo cave. 'If a word carries *negative* energy, the cave will return it louder and darker,' he said. 'Speak only words you truly believe.' I chose the word for courage. The cave gave it back clear and bright — but then a second voice answered from deeper inside.
negative:2.cnHint: 师兄警告我，带有____能量的字在回声洞里会被放大变暗，我说了勇气之字，洞却传来第二个声音。
negative:2.hook: The second voice was not an echo — it had its own words.
negative:2.line: 'A *negative* word spoken here can seal your voice for a season.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu warned me before I entered the echo cave.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在我进入回声洞前警告了我。

sentences.en: 'If a word carries *negative* energy, the cave will return it louder and darker,' he said.
'Speak only words you truly believe.'
sentences.cn: 只说你真正相信的字。

sentences.en: I chose the word for courage.
sentences.cn: 我选了勇气这个字。

sentences.en: The cave gave it back clear and bright — but then a second voice answered from deeper inside.
sentences.cn: 洞穴清亮明朗地把它送了回来——但随后一个第二个声音从更深处答应了。

potential:2.en: The silver testing stone in the hall of entry glowed three rings when I pressed my hand to it. Shen Wujiu had lit two on his first day; Xiaoxing had lit four. Master Qingwu studied my three rings for a long moment. 'Three rings show real *potential*,' she said at last, 'but potential is only a seed.' She then turned away before I could ask what the seed needed to grow.
potential:2.cnHint: 银色测试石为我亮起三环，师尊说这显示出真正的____，但她在我追问之前就转身离开了。
potential:2.hook: Behind her, the third ring pulsed once more — then split into two.
potential:2.line: 'Three rings of *potential* is where the most surprising disciples begin.'

sentences.en: The silver testing stone in the hall of entry glowed three rings when I pressed my hand to it.
sentences.cn: 门厅里的银色试石在我把手按上去时亮起了三圈。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu had lit two on his first day; Xiaoxing had lit four.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎第一天亮起了两圈；小杏亮起了四圈。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu studied my three rings for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊盯着我的三圈看了很久。

sentences.en: 'Three rings show real *potential*,' she said at last, 'but potential is only a seed.'
She then turned away before I could ask what the seed needed to grow.
sentences.cn: 她随后转身离开了，没给我问那颗种子需要什么才能生长的机会。

force:2.en: The sealed jar on Master Qingwu's shelf held the word 'storm.' Shen Wujiu warned me never to *force* it open — some words, he said, were not ready to be spoken. I pressed my ear to the cold clay anyway. Inside, something breathed. Outside, the clouds below our mountain began, very slowly, to rise.
force:2.cnHint: 师兄警告我不要____打开那个封印着'风暴'字符的罐子，但我还是凑近去听了。
force:2.hook: The clouds that never climbed this high were climbing now.
force:2.line: 'Do not *force* the jar — a word spoken too soon can shatter the mountain.'

sentences.en: The sealed jar on Master Qingwu's shelf held the word 'storm.'
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊架子上密封的罐子里装着"风暴"这个字。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu warned me never to *force* it open — some words, he said, were not ready to be spoken.
I pressed my ear to the cold clay anyway.
sentences.cn: 我还是把耳朵贴在了冷冰冰的陶罐上。

sentences.en: Inside, something breathed.
sentences.cn: 里面有什么东西在呼吸。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds below our mountain began, very slowly, to rise.
sentences.cn: 外面，我们山下的云开始，非常缓慢地上升。

importance:2.en: A folded note appeared under my door before dawn. It carried only one line in Master Qingwu's hand: 'You will understand the *importance* of silence when silence is all that remains.' I turned it over. The back was blank except for a single ink mark shaped like a closing eye. My lamp went out on its own.
importance:2.cnHint: 师尊留下的字条让我意识到沉默的____，纸背上那个墨印让我心里一紧。
importance:2.hook: The eye on the paper blinked — once.
importance:2.line: 'Remember the *importance* of silence before you speak the next word.'

sentences.en: A folded note appeared under my door before dawn.
sentences.cn: 天亮前一张折叠的纸条出现在我的门下。

sentences.en: It carried only one line in Master Qingwu's hand: 'You will understand the *importance* of silence when silence is all that remains.'
I turned it over.
sentences.cn: 我翻过来。

sentences.en: The back was blank except for a single ink mark shaped like a closing eye.
sentences.cn: 背面是空白的，除了一个形如闭眼的墨迹。

sentences.en: My lamp went out on its own.
sentences.cn: 我的灯自己灭了。

sell:2.en: A traveling merchant docked his sky-boat at our outer gate and offered to *sell* a word none of us recognized — carved on a thin bone tablet, glowing faintly green. Master Qingwu studied it for a long moment, then sent him away without a coin. That night, green light drifted up from the cloud sea below.
sell:2.cnHint: 一个商人想____一块刻有陌生字符的骨片，师尊拒绝了他，但那晚云海中出现了诡异的绿光。
sell:2.hook: The green glow was still rising, and the merchant's boat was gone.
sell:2.line: 'I will *sell* this word once — to whoever is brave enough to speak it first.'

sentences.en: A traveling merchant docked his sky-boat at our outer gate and offered to *sell* a word none of us recognized — carved on a thin bone tablet, glowing faintly green.
Master Qingwu studied it for a long moment, then sent him away without a coin.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊研究了它很久，然后没给一个金币就打发商人走了。

sentences.en: That night, green light drifted up from the cloud sea below.
sentences.cn: 那晚，绿光从我们下方的云海里飘升上来。

replace:2.en: Xiaoxing discovered that the word 'light' on the eastern wall had faded overnight. She asked me to help her *replace* it with a fresh inscription before Master Qingwu noticed. We ground the ink together in the cold morning air. The new character shone silver instead of gold, and the wall hummed in a tone we had never heard.
replace:2.cnHint: 师妹让我帮她____东墙上褪色的'光'字，重新刻写后墙壁发出了从未有过的声音。
replace:2.hook: The silver hum grew louder each time we stepped away.
replace:2.line: 'We must *replace* the word before dawn, or the wall will forget how to hold light.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing discovered that the word 'light' on the eastern wall had faded overnight.
sentences.cn: 小杏发现东墙上的"光"字在一夜之间褪色了。

sentences.en: She asked me to help her *replace* it with a fresh inscription before Master Qingwu noticed.
We ground the ink together in the cold morning air.
sentences.cn: 我们在寒冷的晨风中一起研磨墨汁。

sentences.en: The new character shone silver instead of gold, and the wall hummed in a tone we had never heard.
sentences.cn: 新写的字闪烁着银光而不是金色，墙壁发出了我们从未听过的嗡鸣声。

approach:2.en: Master Qingwu gathered us at the cliff edge and described her *approach* to learning dangerous words: first, write them in water; second, speak them into stone; third, release them to the wind only when the wind asks. Shen Wujiu nodded as if he already knew. Far below, something large moved through the cloud sea, heading toward our mountain.
approach:2.cnHint: 师尊讲述了她学习危险字符的____，与此同时，云海深处有什么东西正朝山上而来。
approach:2.hook: Whatever moved below had no name we had ever learned.
approach:2.line: 'My *approach* is simple: never speak a word you cannot also silence.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu gathered us at the cliff edge and described her *approach* to learning dangerous words: first, write them in water; second, speak them into stone; third, release them to the wind only when the wind asks.
Shen Wujiu nodded as if he already knew.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎点了点头，仿佛他早就知道了。

sentences.en: Far below, something large moved through the cloud sea, heading toward our mountain.
sentences.cn: 远处云海下方，什么庞然大物在移动，正朝我们的山峰靠近。

engage:2.en: Shen Wujiu told me the only way to truly learn a word was to *engage* with it fully — carry it, breathe near it, let it argue with your thoughts. He pressed a slip of paper into my hand. The word on it was 'doubt.' By evening I could not remember why I had ever felt certain of anything. A single bell rang across the empty courtyard.
engage:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我要完全____某个字符才能真正掌握它，他递给我写着'疑'的纸条，傍晚时我已迷失在怀疑里。
engage:2.hook: The bell had no ringer, and it rang a second time.
engage:2.line: 'To *engage* with a word is to let it change you — make sure you change it back.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me the only way to truly learn a word was to *engage* with it fully — carry it, breathe near it, let it argue with your thoughts.
He pressed a slip of paper into my hand.
sentences.cn: 他把一张纸条塞进我的手心。

sentences.en: The word on it was 'doubt.'
sentences.cn: 纸上写的是"疑"字。

sentences.en: By evening I could not remember why I had ever felt certain of anything.
sentences.cn: 到了傍晚，我已经记不起自己为什么曾经对什么事确信不疑。

sentences.en: A single bell rang across the empty courtyard.
sentences.cn: 空荡荡的院子里响起了一声钟鸣。

ensure:2.en: Before I could enter the inner library, I had to copy the word 'boundary' three times without a mistake. Master Qingwu watched in silence. She said the ritual was meant to *ensure* that no student carried an unstable word past the sealed door. I finished the third copy. The door opened by itself, and cold air poured out carrying the faint smell of rain.
ensure:2.cnHint: 师尊要我抄写'界'字三遍，以____没有人把不稳定的字符带入内院，门自己开了。
ensure:2.hook: The rain smell had no rain behind it — not yet.
ensure:2.line: 'Copy it three times to *ensure* the word knows you before you carry it inside.'

sentences.en: Before I could enter the inner library, I had to copy the word 'boundary' three times without a mistake.
sentences.cn: 在我进入内库之前，必须把"界"字抄写三遍而不出错。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched in silence.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊无言地注视着我。

sentences.en: She said the ritual was meant to *ensure* that no student carried an unstable word past the sealed door.
I finished the third copy.
sentences.cn: 我完成了第三遍抄写。

sentences.en: The door opened by itself, and cold air poured out carrying the faint smell of rain.
sentences.cn: 门自己打开了，冰冷的气流涌出来，带着淡淡的雨水味道。

limit:2.en: Xiaoxing found a record in the archive stating that every disciple had a *limit* — a number of words the spirit could hold before it began to forget the ones learned first. She read the number aloud. It was smaller than either of us expected. We stood there counting, quietly, the words we had already learned. Somewhere above, a single cloud drifted loose from the mountain and did not return.
limit:2.cnHint: 师妹在档案中发现每个弟子能掌握的字符数量都有____，这个数字比我们预想的小得多。
limit:2.hook: One of us had already passed the number, and neither of us said it.
limit:2.line: 'Know your *limit* — a mind that holds too many words loses its own name first.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found a record in the archive stating that every disciple had a *limit* — a number of words the spirit could hold before it began to forget the ones learned first.
She read the number aloud.
sentences.cn: 她大声读出了那个数字。

sentences.en: It was smaller than either of us expected.
sentences.cn: 这个数字比我们两个预期的都要小。

sentences.en: We stood there counting, quietly, the words we had already learned.
sentences.cn: 我们站在那里，静静地数着已经学过的字。

sentences.en: Somewhere above, a single cloud drifted loose from the mountain and did not return.
sentences.cn: 远处上方，一朵单独的云从山峰飘散开来，再也没有回来。

perhaps:2.en: The sealed jar on Master Qingwu's shelf had sat untouched for three seasons. Today it trembled on its own. Xiaoxing pressed her ear to the cold stone wall and whispered, '*Perhaps* this word inside is waking up.' A faint green light answered her — steady, then gone.
perhaps:2.cnHint: 小星发现师尊架上的封印罐子在颤动，她低声说这其中的词灵____正在苏醒。
perhaps:2.hook: The jar stilled — but the shelf beneath it had cracked.
perhaps:2.line: '*Perhaps* the word chose this morning for a reason,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: The sealed jar on Master Qingwu's shelf had sat untouched for three seasons.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊架子上的封闭罐子已经静静放了三个季节。

sentences.en: Today it trembled on its own.
sentences.cn: 今天它自己震动了起来。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed her ear to the cold stone wall and whispered, '*Perhaps* this word inside is waking up.'
A faint green light answered her — steady, then gone.
sentences.cn: 淡绿色的光亮回应了她——稳定了一下，又消失了。

video:2.en: In the archive cave, stone tablets lined every wall. One tablet showed moving images — a silent record of an elder reciting the wind formula. Shen Wujiu called it a *video* carved by spiritual light, proof that lost knowledge could still be found. I watched it until the images faded like mist.
video:2.cnHint: 师兄在档案洞窟中找到一块会动的石碑，他说那是用灵光刻制的____，记录了失传的风诀。
video:2.hook: When the images faded, a single unread word remained, glowing red.
video:2.line: 'This *video* holds the last breath of an elder's teaching,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: In the archive cave, stone tablets lined every wall.
sentences.cn: 在档案洞穴里，石板排满了四面八方。

sentences.en: One tablet showed moving images — a silent record of an elder reciting the wind formula.
sentences.cn: 其中一块石板上显现着活动的影像——某位长者默默诵读风咒的记录。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu called it a *video* carved by spiritual light, proof that lost knowledge could still be found.
I watched it until the images faded like mist.
sentences.cn: 我看着这些影像，直到它们像雾气一样消散。

prevent:2.en: A crack split the outer formation stone just before dawn. Shen Wujiu poured the herb-word 'seal' across the gap to *prevent* the cloud-sea fog from rising into the inner courtyard. His hands shook with the effort. The fog pressed hard against the word, hungry and cold.
prevent:2.cnHint: 黎明前结界石出现裂缝，师兄用草药词"封"来____雾气涌入内院。
prevent:2.hook: The fog retreated — but left a dark stain shaped like a hand.
prevent:2.line: 'We must act now to *prevent* the fog from reaching the medicine hall,' Shen Wujiu urged.

sentences.en: A crack split the outer formation stone just before dawn.
sentences.cn: 天亮前不久，外层阵法石上出现了一道裂缝。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu poured the herb-word 'seal' across the gap to *prevent* the cloud-sea fog from rising into the inner courtyard.
His hands shook with the effort.
sentences.cn: 他的手因为用力而颤抖。

sentences.en: The fog pressed hard against the word, hungry and cold.
sentences.cn: 雾气凶狠地冲击着这个字，饥渴而冰冷。

source:2.en: Master Qingwu knelt at a thin stream on the mountain's east face and held a listening-stone to the water. She said every healing word had a *source*, a place where its meaning first rose from the earth like a spring. I knelt beside her and heard, faintly, a syllable I did not yet know.
source:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊在山泉边用听石感知，说每个治愈词都有一个____，就像泉水从大地涌出。
source:2.hook: The syllable I heard was not in any scroll I had ever read.
source:2.line: 'Find the *source* of a word and you will understand its true power,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu knelt at a thin stream on the mountain's east face and held a listening-stone to the water.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊跪在山东面的细流旁，把听石贴在水上。

sentences.en: She said every healing word had a *source*, a place where its meaning first rose from the earth like a spring.
I knelt beside her and heard, faintly, a syllable I did not yet know.
sentences.cn: 我跪在她身边，隐隐听到了一个我还不认识的音节。

available:2.en: The rare herb-word 'clearbone' was listed in the sect's catalog, but when I climbed to the high shelf it was gone. Xiaoxing checked the logbook and shook her head: only three common words were still *available* for a new disciple. I chose the plainest one and felt it hum against my palm.
available:2.cnHint: 小星查阅典籍后摇头，告诉我对新弟子来说目前只有三个普通词灵____。
available:2.hook: The plain word hummed — and then hummed twice, as if answering a call from below.
available:2.line: 'Only these three words are *available* to us before the gate closes,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: The rare herb-word 'clearbone' was listed in the sect's catalog, but when I climbed to the high shelf it was gone.
sentences.cn: 稀有的草字"清骨"在宗门目录上有记载，但我爬到高架子上时它已经不见了。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing checked the logbook and shook her head: only three common words were still *available* for a new disciple.
I chose the plainest one and felt it hum against my palm.
sentences.cn: 我选了最普通的那个，它在我掌心里嗡嗡作响。

customer:2.en: At the floating market between two cliffs, a merchant offered word-seeds in small clay pots. Shen Wujiu leaned close and murmured that every *customer* who bought a cracked pot had later reported strange dreams. I looked down at the pot already in my hands and set it carefully back.
customer:2.cnHint: 在悬崖间的浮市，师兄低声说每个买过裂缝陶罐的____后来都梦见了奇怪的事。
customer:2.hook: The merchant smiled and said my pot had already chosen me.
customer:2.line: 'Every *customer* who left with that seal has returned within a month,' the merchant said softly.

sentences.en: At the floating market between two cliffs, a merchant offered word-seeds in small clay pots.
sentences.cn: 在两处悬崖之间的浮市，一个商人在小陶罐里卖字籽。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu leaned close and murmured that every *customer* who bought a cracked pot had later reported strange dreams.
I looked down at the pot already in my hands and set it carefully back.
sentences.cn: 我低头看了看已经握在手心的陶罐，小心地把它放了回去。

language:2.en: Master Qingwu told us that the sect's oldest scrolls were not written in any living tongue. The *language* of those scrolls was made of pure intention — each mark meant exactly what its writer felt, nothing more and nothing less. I copied one mark and my brush caught fire, then went cold.
language:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊说最古老的卷轴所用的____由纯粹的意念构成，每个符记精确传达书写者的感受。
language:2.hook: The cold brush left a mark I had not chosen to write.
language:2.line: 'Master this *language* and words will obey your heart, not your mouth,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told us that the sect's oldest scrolls were not written in any living tongue.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊告诉我们宗门最古老的卷轴不是用任何活着的语言写的。

sentences.en: The *language* of those scrolls was made of pure intention — each mark meant exactly what its writer felt, nothing more and nothing less.
I copied one mark and my brush caught fire, then went cold.
sentences.cn: 我临摹了一个笔画，笔刷着火了，然后又冷了下去。

test:2.en: At the first-light bell, Master Qingwu set a single candle on the stone floor and told us to keep it burning using only one spoken word for one full hour. She called it a *test* of patience, not power. Xiaoxing's flame dipped at the half-hour mark. Mine burned steady — until the bell rang and the candle vanished.
test:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊在破晓时分布置了一个____：只用一个词让烛火燃烧整整一个时辰。
test:2.hook: The candle was gone, but its smoke had written a character on the ceiling.
test:2.line: 'This *test* will show whether your word holds when your mind wanders,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: At the first-light bell, Master Qingwu set a single candle on the stone floor and told us to keep it burning using only one spoken word for one full hour.
sentences.cn: 晨钟敲响时，青梧师尊在石地上点了一根蜡烛，让我们只用一个字维持它燃烧整整一个时辰。

sentences.en: She called it a *test* of patience, not power.
Xiaoxing's flame dipped at the half-hour mark.
sentences.cn: 小杏的火焰在半个时辰时摇晃了。

sentences.en: Mine burned steady — until the bell rang and the candle vanished.
sentences.cn: 我的火焰稳稳燃烧——直到钟声响起，蜡烛消失了。

stick:2.en: Inside the old storage cave, I found a thin *stick* of black wood pressed between two stones, wrapped in silk the color of morning fog. A single word was carved along its length — not in ink, but burned deep by some past flame. The word still held warmth under my fingers, as if it had been waiting.
stick:2.cnHint: 在储藏洞中，我发现了一根夹在石缝间的黑木____，上面刻着一个字。
stick:2.hook: The carved word was one no living disciple was supposed to know.
stick:2.line: 'This *stick* carries a word older than our Sect's first mountain,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

sentences.en: Inside the old storage cave, I found a thin *stick* of black wood pressed between two stones, wrapped in silk the color of morning fog.
A single word was carved along its length — not in ink, but burned deep by some past flame.
sentences.cn: 一个字被刻在它的长度上——不是用墨，而是被某段过去的火焰烧得很深。

sentences.en: The word still held warmth under my fingers, as if it had been waiting.
sentences.cn: 那个字在我的指尖下仍然温热，仿佛一直在等待。

effective:2.en: Master Qingwu set a pale green leaf on the stone table before me. 'Speak the word written on it,' she said. I did, and the leaf turned to cool mist that settled over a bruised stem nearby, straightening it within moments. 'That,' she said, 'is what *effective* looks like — not loud, just true.'
effective:2.cnHint: 师尊让我对着叶片念出符文，它迅速治愈了受损的茎，展示了什么是真正____的力量。
effective:2.hook: But the stem, now straight, had begun to glow with a color I could not name.
effective:2.line: 'Only a word that heals cleanly can be called *effective*,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set a pale green leaf on the stone table before me.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石桌前放了一片苍白的绿叶。

sentences.en: 'Speak the word written on it,' she said.
sentences.cn: "念出写在上面的字，"她说。

sentences.en: I did, and the leaf turned to cool mist that settled over a bruised stem nearby, straightening it within moments.
sentences.cn: 我念了，那片叶子变成了清冷的雾气，落在附近一根青淤的茎上，片刻间就把它扶直了。

sentences.en: 'That,' she said, 'is what *effective* looks like — not loud, just true.'

fear:2.en: Xiaoxing handed me a small jar sealed with red clay. Inside, pressed flat like a dried flower, was a word-herb known to calm the heart. 'Every new disciple carries *fear* on the first climb,' she said with a kind smile, pressing the jar into my hands. The clouds below the mountain edge looked very far down.
fear:2.cnHint: 小星将一株可以平息____的字草交给我，鼓励我面对攀登时的不安。
fear:2.hook: Above us, the mountain's peak had just disappeared into a cloud that was not there before.
fear:2.line: '*Fear* is only the first step — it means you understand the height,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing handed me a small jar sealed with red clay.
sentences.cn: 小杏递给我一个用红陶土封口的小罐子。

sentences.en: Inside, pressed flat like a dried flower, was a word-herb known to calm the heart.
sentences.cn: 里面压平得像干花的，是一种已知能安心的字草。

sentences.en: 'Every new disciple carries *fear* on the first climb,' she said with a kind smile, pressing the jar into my hands.
The clouds below the mountain edge looked very far down.
sentences.cn: 山边下的云看起来离得很远。

hit:2.en: Shen Wujiu drew a word-formula in the air with two fingers, and a pulse of pale light crossed the courtyard and *hit* the iron bell at its center. A clear tone rang out, and three sparrows on the roof flew off at once. 'The word must land cleanly,' he told me, 'or the bell stays silent.'
hit:2.cnHint: 师兄用符文发出的光____铁钟，钟声清脆，麻雀四散而飞。
hit:2.hook: The bell's echo faded, but the sparrows did not return to their usual branch.
hit:2.line: 'A formula that cannot *hit* its mark is only empty breath,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu drew a word-formula in the air with two fingers, and a pulse of pale light crossed the courtyard and *hit* the iron bell at its center.
A clear tone rang out, and three sparrows on the roof flew off at once.
sentences.cn: 一声清亮的钟声响起，屋顶上的三只麻雀立刻飞走了。

sentences.en: 'The word must land cleanly,' he told me, 'or the bell stays silent.'
sentences.cn: "字必须落得干干净净，"他告诉我，"否则钟声就不会响。"

assume:2.en: I found a folded note slipped under my mat. It read: 'Do not *assume* the word you were given is the only form it holds.' I had read my practice word a hundred times and thought I knew it. Now I turned it over slowly, like a stone with something living beneath, and found a second meaning curled inside the first.
assume:2.cnHint: 纸条提醒我不要____自己已经完全理解了那个修炼用字，它或许还藏着另一层含义。
assume:2.hook: The note had no name on it, and the ink smelled faintly of high-mountain cedar.
assume:2.line: 'Never *assume* one reading of a word is the whole truth,' the note said.

sentences.en: I found a folded note slipped under my mat.
sentences.cn: 我在垫子下面发现了一张折叠的纸条。

sentences.en: It read: 'Do not *assume* the word you were given is the only form it holds.'
I had read my practice word a hundred times and thought I knew it.
sentences.cn: 我已经读过我的练习字一百遍，以为自己懂了。

sentences.en: Now I turned it over slowly, like a stone with something living beneath, and found a second meaning curled inside the first.
sentences.cn: 现在我缓缓翻转它，就像翻一块底下藏着活物的石头，发现第二层意思蜷缩在第一层里面。

generally:2.en: Xiaoxing sat beside me at the edge of the herb terrace and pointed to the clouds below. '*Generally*,' she said, 'the sea of clouds parts at midday and you can see the lower peaks. But some mornings it stays shut, and that is a message too.' We waited together, watching the white surface breathe slowly like something asleep.
generally:2.cnHint: 小星告诉我，____情况下正午时云海会散开，但有时它的不散本身就是一种信号。
generally:2.hook: Today the clouds did not part at all, though the sun was already high and bright.
generally:2.line: '*Generally* the clouds will show you the path, if you are patient,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing sat beside me at the edge of the herb terrace and pointed to the clouds below. '*Generally*,' she said, 'the sea of clouds parts at midday and you can see the lower peaks.
But some mornings it stays shut, and that is a message too.'
sentences.cn: 但有些早晨它关得紧紧的，那也是一个信号。

sentences.en: We waited together, watching the white surface breathe slowly like something asleep.
sentences.cn: 我们一起等待，看着白色的表面缓缓呼吸，像什么熟睡的东西。

interaction:2.en: Master Qingwu drew two word-herbs side by side on the board: one for wind, one for stillness. 'Watch,' she said, and let their edges touch. A soft spiral formed between them, rising slowly. 'This *interaction* is what makes a formula more than the sum of its parts,' she told us. I wrote the word in my notes three times.
interaction:2.cnHint: 师尊让两株字草边缘相触，展示了它们之间的____如何产生出比各自单独更强的效果。
interaction:2.hook: The spiral between the two words was still turning long after class had ended.
interaction:2.line: 'Every *interaction* between words creates something neither word holds alone,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew two word-herbs side by side on the board: one for wind, one for stillness.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在黑板上并排画了两个字草：一个是风，一个是静寂。

sentences.en: 'Watch,' she said, and let their edges touch.
sentences.cn: "看，"她说，让它们的边缘相接。

sentences.en: A soft spiral formed between them, rising slowly.
sentences.cn: 一个柔软的螺旋在它们之间形成，缓缓上升。

sentences.en: 'This *interaction* is what makes a formula more than the sum of its parts,' she told us.
I wrote the word in my notes three times.
sentences.cn: 我在笔记里把这个字写了三遍。

top:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the *top* of the east terrace before dawn, where a flat stone held a single word carved by the Sect's founder. The stone was cold and dark in the pre-dawn quiet. 'Read it aloud once, then be still,' he said. I read it, and the clouds far below shifted like a slow, breathing tide.
top:2.cnHint: 师兄带我到东台____，那里有一块刻着开派祖师文字的石头，大声诵读后云海随之涌动。
top:2.hook: Where the clouds had shifted, a shape rose briefly and then was gone.
top:2.line: 'At the *top* of every mountain there is a word the wind already knows,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the *top* of the east terrace before dawn, where a flat stone held a single word carved by the Sect's founder.
The stone was cold and dark in the pre-dawn quiet.
sentences.cn: 那块石头在黎明前的寂静中又冷又黑。

sentences.en: 'Read it aloud once, then be still,' he said.
sentences.cn: "大声读一遍，然后静止不动，"他说。

sentences.en: I read it, and the clouds far below shifted like a slow, breathing tide.
sentences.cn: 我读了，远下方的云像缓缓的、呼吸的潮汐一样移动了。

consequence:2.en: Master Qingwu placed a single dried leaf on the stone table. 'Every word you speak in this hall carries a *consequence*,' she said quietly. 'Speak a healing word wrongly and the patient suffers. Speak it truly and the clouds themselves will part.' I touched the leaf. It turned to silver dust.
consequence:2.cnHint: 师尊警告我，在这座殿堂中，每一个字都有其____，我轻触那片叶子，它化为了银尘。
consequence:2.hook: The dust rose in the shape of a warning I could not yet read.
consequence:2.line: 'Every word you speak here carries a *consequence* you cannot take back.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a single dried leaf on the stone table.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石桌上放了一片干枯的叶子。

sentences.en: 'Every word you speak in this hall carries a *consequence*,' she said quietly.
'Speak a healing word wrongly and the patient suffers.
sentences.cn: "在这个殿堂里，你说出的每一个字都有后果，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: Speak it truly and the clouds themselves will part.'
sentences.cn: "念错一个治愈的字，病人就会遭殃。

sentences.en: I touched the leaf.
sentences.cn: 念对了，连云本身都会分开。"

sentences.en: It turned to silver dust.
sentences.cn: 我摸了摸那片叶子。

realize:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small jade slip covered in faint marks. I studied it for an hour before I began to *realize* that the marks were not decorations — they were sleeping words, waiting for a voice. The moment I understood, the slip grew warm in my palm.
realize:2.cnHint: 师兄递给我一枚玉简，我花了很长时间才____那些纹路其实是沉睡的文字。
realize:2.hook: Outside, the wind stopped, as if the mountain was also waiting.
realize:2.line: 'Did you *realize* yet that every mark on that slip is alive?'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small jade slip covered in faint marks.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一片小玉简，上面满是淡淡的印记。

sentences.en: I studied it for an hour before I began to *realize* that the marks were not decorations — they were sleeping words, waiting for a voice.
The moment I understood, the slip grew warm in my palm.
sentences.cn: 那块简在我掌心里变得温热了。

mostly:2.en: The medicine garden on the eastern cliff was *mostly* quiet at dawn, the spiritual herbs nodding in cool mist. Xiaoxing knelt beside a row of pale blossoms, whispering a growth word so softly I could barely hear. One blossom opened fully. The others leaned toward it, as if jealous.
mostly:2.cnHint: 清晨，东崖药园____是宁静的，师妹轻声念动催生字诀，一朵花应声而开。
mostly:2.hook: Then a single petal fell upward, against the pull of the earth.
mostly:2.line: 'This garden is *mostly* peaceful — until the words take root and grow wild.'

sentences.en: The medicine garden on the eastern cliff was *mostly* quiet at dawn, the spiritual herbs nodding in cool mist.
Xiaoxing knelt beside a row of pale blossoms, whispering a growth word so softly I could barely hear.
sentences.cn: 小杏跪在一排苍白的花朵旁，用我几乎听不到的声音低声吟诵一个生长字。

sentences.en: One blossom opened fully.
sentences.cn: 一朵花完全绽放了。

sentences.en: The others leaned toward it, as if jealous.
sentences.cn: 其他的花向它倾斜，仿佛嫉妒。

exactly:2.en: Master Qingwu drew a circle of light in the air and told me to copy it *exactly*. My first attempt was too wide. My second was too sharp. On the third try the circle held, glowing a steady blue. She nodded once, then erased it with a breath, and I understood the lesson was only beginning.
exactly:2.cnHint: 师尊要我____临摹她画出的光圈，我第三次才成功，她却将它一口气抹去了。
exactly:2.hook: From the sea of clouds below, something answered with a glow of its own.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a circle of light in the air and told me to copy it *exactly*.
My first attempt was too wide.
sentences.cn: 我第一次尝试画得太宽了。

sentences.en: My second was too sharp.
sentences.cn: 第二次又太尖锐。

sentences.en: On the third try the circle held, glowing a steady blue.
sentences.cn: 第三次，圆圈稳住了，散发出沉稳的蓝光。

sentences.en: She nodded once, then erased it with a breath, and I understood the lesson was only beginning.
sentences.cn: 她点了一下头，然后一吹气就把它抹掉了，我明白这堂课才刚刚开始。

vary:2.en: Shen Wujiu showed me how the color of a spoken word could *vary* with the speaker's mood. Calm speech made the air shimmer gold. Anger turned it a dull red. Grief, surprisingly, produced a deep and lovely green. I tried speaking the same word three ways, and watched the sky change each time.
vary:2.cnHint: 师兄向我展示，说话人的心境不同，字的颜色也会____，我试了三次，天色随之三度变幻。
vary:2.hook: On the fourth try I felt something far away speak back to me.
vary:2.line: 'The light of a word can *vary* — and the mountain listens to every shade.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu showed me how the color of a spoken word could *vary* with the speaker's mood.
Calm speech made the air shimmer gold.
sentences.cn: 平静的言语让空气闪烁出金色。

sentences.en: Anger turned it a dull red.
sentences.cn: 愤怒把它变成暗红色。

sentences.en: Grief, surprisingly, produced a deep and lovely green.
sentences.cn: 悲伤出人意料地产生了深邃而美妙的绿色。

sentences.en: I tried speaking the same word three ways, and watched the sky change each time.
sentences.cn: 我用三种方式说了同一个词，看着天空每次都在变化。

brain:2.en: The training hall was cold and still. Master Qingwu said that spiritual words do not live in the throat or the hand — they live in the *brain*, forming long before the lips move. I closed my eyes and tried to feel a word forming inside my head. A faint hum rose in the rafters above me.
brain:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，灵字并非出于喉咙，而是源于____，我闭目感受，屋梁上随即传来低沉的嗡鸣。
brain:2.hook: When I opened my eyes, the ink on the nearest wall had shifted one stroke.
brain:2.line: 'The word is formed in the *brain* long before your lips ever move.'

sentences.en: The training hall was cold and still.
sentences.cn: 修行堂里冷清而寂静。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said that spiritual words do not live in the throat or the hand — they live in the *brain*, forming long before the lips move.
I closed my eyes and tried to feel a word forming inside my head.
sentences.cn: 我闭上眼睛，试着感受一个词在我脑海里形成。

sentences.en: A faint hum rose in the rafters above me.
sentences.cn: 头顶梁木上升起了一阵微弱的嗡鸣声。

stress:2.en: Xiaoxing sat beside me at the recitation stone, correcting my pronunciation. 'You must place the *stress* on the second part of the word,' she said gently, 'or the herb will wither instead of grow.' I said it again, carefully. A small green shoot pushed through the stone at our feet.
stress:2.cnHint: 师妹在背诵石旁纠正我的发音，告诉我字的____落在后半段，否则草药会枯萎，我重读一遍，脚下破石而出一枚嫩芽。
stress:2.hook: The shoot bore a single bud the color of a coming storm.
stress:2.line: 'Put the *stress* on the second beat — the herb can tell the difference.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing sat beside me at the recitation stone, correcting my pronunciation.
sentences.cn: 小杏坐在我身边的诵经石旁，纠正我的发音。

sentences.en: 'You must place the *stress* on the second part of the word,' she said gently, 'or the herb will wither instead of grow.'
I said it again, carefully.
sentences.cn: 我再说了一遍，小心翼翼。

sentences.en: A small green shoot pushed through the stone at our feet.
sentences.cn: 一根小小的绿芽从我们脚下的石头里钻了出来。

financial:2.en: A sealed letter arrived by cloud-crane, addressed to Master Qingwu. Shen Wujiu told me quietly that the outer sects were facing a *financial* crisis — the herb trade had collapsed and many could no longer afford to study sacred words. Master Qingwu read the letter, then set it face-down without a word.
financial:2.cnHint: 一封密信由云鹤送来，师兄悄悄告诉我，外门正陷入____困境，药材贸易崩溃，许多人已无力修习灵字。
financial:2.hook: That night, every lamp in the hall went out at the same moment.
financial:2.line: 'The outer sects face a *financial* collapse — and words may soon be beyond their reach.'

sentences.en: A sealed letter arrived by cloud-crane, addressed to Master Qingwu.
sentences.cn: 一封密信乘云鹤而来，收件人是青梧师尊。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me quietly that the outer sects were facing a *financial* crisis — the herb trade had collapsed and many could no longer afford to study sacred words.
Master Qingwu read the letter, then set it face-down without a word.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊读完信，沉默地将它翻过来放下了。

easily:2.en: The sealed scroll had rested on the archive shelf for three seasons, untouched. I reached for it, expecting resistance, but it unrolled *easily* beneath my fingers, as though it had been waiting for me alone. The words inside glowed faintly — a map of the lower cloud passes no current disciple was supposed to see.
easily:2.cnHint: 那卷封存的地图竟____地在我手中展开，上面标注着弟子们不该知道的路线。
easily:2.hook: At the scroll's edge, a name had been crossed out — and replaced with mine.
easily:2.line: 'It opened too *easily*,' Shen Wujiu said, stepping back from the shelf.

sentences.en: The sealed scroll had rested on the archive shelf for three seasons, untouched.
sentences.cn: 那卷密封的书简在档案架上搁了三个季节，无人触碰。

sentences.en: I reached for it, expecting resistance, but it unrolled *easily* beneath my fingers, as though it had been waiting for me alone.
The words inside glowed faintly — a map of the lower cloud passes no current disciple was supposed to see.
sentences.cn: 里面的字闪闪发光——一幅下层云道的地图，没有哪个现役弟子应该看到。

protect:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small jade disc into my palm before the trial began. 'Master Qingwu carved the word shelter into its face,' she said. 'It will *protect* you from the cold wind at the lower ridge.' The disc felt warm, almost alive. Above us, dark clouds were already gathering at the mountain's edge.
protect:2.cnHint: 小星递给我一块玉牌，说它能____我免受山脊寒风侵袭。
protect:2.hook: The clouds below were rising faster than any trial was meant to allow.
protect:2.line: 'One word can *protect* a life, if it is the right word,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small jade disc into my palm before the trial began.
sentences.cn: 试炼开始前，小杏把一个小玉盘塞进了我的掌心。

sentences.en: 'Master Qingwu carved the word shelter into its face,' she said.
sentences.cn: "青梧师尊在它的表面刻了'庇护'这个字，"她说。

sentences.en: 'It will *protect* you from the cold wind at the lower ridge.'
The disc felt warm, almost alive.
sentences.cn: 玉盘温热得几乎有了生命。

sentences.en: Above us, dark clouds were already gathering at the mountain's edge.
sentences.cn: 山边上方，乌云已经在聚集了。

advantage:2.en: Shen Wujiu showed me two paths up the eastern slope. The longer trail wound through herb gardens rich with spoken formulas. 'Most disciples take the short cut,' he said, 'but the long path gives you a clear *advantage* — you arrive knowing ten more words than anyone else.' I chose the long path without hesitation.
advantage:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，走长路能让我在知识上获得____，尽管需要多花时间。
advantage:2.hook: But someone had already stripped the herb gardens bare overnight.
advantage:2.line: 'The long path is our *advantage*, and someone knows it,' Shen Wujiu murmured.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu showed me two paths up the eastern slope.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎给我指了两条上东坡的路。

sentences.en: The longer trail wound through herb gardens rich with spoken formulas.
sentences.cn: 较长的山径蜿蜒穿过布满言灵的药园。

sentences.en: 'Most disciples take the short cut,' he said, 'but the long path gives you a clear *advantage* — you arrive knowing ten more words than anyone else.'
I chose the long path without hesitation.
sentences.cn: 我没有犹豫，选择了长路。

break:2.en: Each morning, Master Qingwu led us through four hours of word practice without rest. On the fifth day she raised one hand and said we would take a short *break* — then pointed to a crack running down the central pillar of the hall. It had not been there the night before. No one spoke.
break:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊宣布短暂____，随后我们发现大殿石柱上出现了一道不明裂缝。
break:2.hook: The crack was still growing, one breath at a time.
break:2.line: 'This *break* was not made by wind or age,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

sentences.en: Each morning, Master Qingwu led us through four hours of word practice without rest.
sentences.cn: 每天早上，青梧师尊都带我们进行四小时不间断的词语练习。

sentences.en: On the fifth day she raised one hand and said we would take a short *break* — then pointed to a crack running down the central pillar of the hall.
It had not been there the night before.
sentences.cn: 昨晚没有出现过那条裂缝。

sentences.en: No one spoke.
sentences.cn: 没人说话。

conclude:2.en: I gathered the three clues Shen Wujiu had left along the corridor — a feather, a cold teacup, a single written character pinned to the wall — and stood still for a long moment. From these small things, I could *conclude* that he had left before dawn, in haste, and not by the front gate. The character on the wall meant: do not follow.
conclude:2.cnHint: 我从三件遗留之物____出师兄在黎明前匆忙离开，并不想被人跟随。
conclude:2.hook: The character on the wall began to fade, as if erasing itself.
conclude:2.line: 'What do you *conclude* from what he left behind?' Master Qingwu asked me.

sentences.en: I gathered the three clues Shen Wujiu had left along the corridor — a feather, a cold teacup, a single written character pinned to the wall — and stood still for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 我在走廊里收集了沈无咎留下的三条线索——一根羽毛、一个冷的茶杯、一个钉在墙上的单个文字——然后站了一会儿。

sentences.en: From these small things, I could *conclude* that he had left before dawn, in haste, and not by the front gate.
The character on the wall meant: do not follow.
sentences.cn: 墙上的那个字意思是：不要跟来。

figure:2.en: Deep in the archive, I found an old star chart covered in tiny numbers. Each *figure* matched the position of a floating mountain, marking not where the peaks stood now, but where they had stood a hundred years ago. Something had moved them — deliberately, slowly — into their current pattern, like pieces in a game no one admitted was being played.
figure:2.cnHint: 古老星图上的每个____都对应一座浮山曾经的位置，暗示有人刻意移动过它们。
figure:2.hook: The most recent number on the chart had been added in fresh ink.
figure:2.line: 'Every *figure* on this chart points to the same summit,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: Deep in the archive, I found an old star chart covered in tiny numbers.
sentences.cn: 在档案室的深处，我找到了一张布满细小数字的旧星图。

sentences.en: Each *figure* matched the position of a floating mountain, marking not where the peaks stood now, but where they had stood a hundred years ago.
Something had moved them — deliberately, slowly — into their current pattern, like pieces in a game no one admitted was being played.
sentences.cn: 有什么东西——刻意地、缓慢地——把它们移到了现在的位置，就像在玩一场没人承认在进行的游戏中的棋子。

fit:2.en: The empty niche in the hall's eastern wall had puzzled every disciple for years. I pressed the jade disc Xiaoxing had given me against it almost by accident — and it settled in with a soft click, a perfect *fit*. The wall shivered. Behind the stone, something old and quiet began, at last, to breathe.
fit:2.cnHint: 小星送我的玉牌竟与大殿东墙的凹槽完全____，轻轻嵌入后石壁开始颤动。
fit:2.hook: The sound from behind the wall was not wind — it was syllables.
fit:2.line: 'It should not *fit* so perfectly unless it was always meant to be here,' I said.

sentences.en: The empty niche in the hall's eastern wall had puzzled every disciple for years.
sentences.cn: 大厅东墙上那个空的壁龛多年来一直令每个弟子困惑。

sentences.en: I pressed the jade disc Xiaoxing had given me against it almost by accident — and it settled in with a soft click, a perfect *fit*.
The wall shivered.
sentences.cn: 墙壁颤动了。

sentences.en: Behind the stone, something old and quiet began, at last, to breathe.
sentences.cn: 在石头后面，某个古老而静谧的东西终于开始呼吸了。

particular:2.en: Master Qingwu set twelve herb jars on the low table and told me to choose one. I hesitated over each, sensing the hum of different words inside. She watched without expression. 'You are drawn to that *particular* jar,' she said at last, 'because the word it holds once belonged to your family line.' My hand was already resting on its lid.
particular:2.cnHint: 师尊说我对那个____药罐的感应，是因为其中的词诀曾属于我的家族。
particular:2.hook: Carved beneath the jar's base was a name — the same one crossed out on the scroll.
particular:2.line: 'That *particular* word has not been spoken here in thirty years,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set twelve herb jars on the low table and told me to choose one.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在矮桌上摆了十二个药罐，让我选一个。

sentences.en: I hesitated over each, sensing the hum of different words inside.
sentences.cn: 我在每一个上面都犹豫过，能感觉到里面不同的字在嗡鸣。

sentences.en: She watched without expression.
sentences.cn: 她面无表情地看着。

sentences.en: 'You are drawn to that *particular* jar,' she said at last, 'because the word it holds once belonged to your family line.'
My hand was already resting on its lid.
sentences.cn: 我的手已经按在了它的盖子上。

fruit:2.en: Deep in the Herb Terrace, I found a hollow stone jar sealed with wax. Inside lay a single dried *fruit*, dark as ink, carved with a word I had never seen. Xiaoxing said it was a gift left by a disciple who had already ascended — a final lesson pressed into living matter.
fruit:2.cnHint: 我在药圃石罐中发现了一枚刻有陌生文字的干燥____，据说是前辈弟子留下的最后馈赠。
fruit:2.hook: The carved word began to glow the moment I touched it.
fruit:2.line: 'This *fruit* holds a word that can stop a wound from bleeding,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: Deep in the Herb Terrace, I found a hollow stone jar sealed with wax.
sentences.cn: 在药台的深处，我找到了一个用蜡封住的空心石罐。

sentences.en: Inside lay a single dried *fruit*, dark as ink, carved with a word I had never seen.
Xiaoxing said it was a gift left by a disciple who had already ascended — a final lesson pressed into living matter.
sentences.cn: 小杏说那是一位已经飞升的弟子留下的礼物——最后的功课被压进了活的东西里。

waste:2.en: Shen Wujiu watched me copy the same healing formula for the third time, each stroke wrong in a different way. He set his brush down and spoke with quiet care: do not *waste* the living ink — every drop holds a breath of mountain air that will not come again. I copied more slowly after that.
waste:2.cnHint: 师兄提醒我不要____珍贵的灵墨，因为每一滴都蕴含着山间无可复得的灵气。
waste:2.hook: On my fourth copy, the ink moved on its own.
waste:2.line: 'Do not *waste* the ink — it listens to intention,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu watched me copy the same healing formula for the third time, each stroke wrong in a different way.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎看我第三次抄那个疗愈方子，每一笔都以不同的方式错了。

sentences.en: He set his brush down and spoke with quiet care: do not *waste* the living ink — every drop holds a breath of mountain air that will not come again.
I copied more slowly after that.
sentences.cn: 之后我抄得慢了很多。

learning:2.en: Master Qingwu placed an old scroll on the stone table between us. She said that *learning* in the Cloud Sea Sect was not the collecting of words but the practice of releasing them — a disciple who hoarded formulas without using them would find the words going silent, like herbs left to dry past their season.
learning:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊告诫我，云海宗的____不在于积累文字，而在于运用与释放。
learning:2.hook: The scroll unrolled a little further by itself, revealing a blank page.
learning:2.line: 'True *learning* begins the moment you let a word leave your hand,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed an old scroll on the stone table between us.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把一卷旧书摊在我们之间的石桌上。

sentences.en: She said that *learning* in the Cloud Sea Sect was not the collecting of words but the practice of releasing them — a disciple who hoarded formulas without using them would find the words going silent, like herbs left to dry past their season.

manager:2.en: The sect's Herb Terrace had a human keeper: an older disciple called the *manager* of living words, responsible for every plant that carried a syllable in its roots. I was sent to him with a note from Master Qingwu. He read it, said nothing, and handed me a seedling that trembled in my palm.
manager:2.cnHint: 药圃的____负责管理所有蕴含灵音的植株，青雾师尊让我带着字条去拜访他。
manager:2.hook: The seedling's trembling matched the rhythm of my own heartbeat.
manager:2.line: 'I am the *manager* of what grows here — handle nothing without asking,' he said.

sentences.en: The sect's Herb Terrace had a human keeper: an older disciple called the *manager* of living words, responsible for every plant that carried a syllable in its roots.
I was sent to him with a note from Master Qingwu.
sentences.cn: 我被青梧师尊的一张纸条送到了他那里。

sentences.en: He read it, said nothing, and handed me a seedling that trembled in my palm.
sentences.cn: 他读了，什么也没说，递给我一株在我手心里颤抖的小苗。

knowledge:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a narrow shelf cut into the cliff face, lined with tablets of grey stone. Each tablet held not a full formula but a fragment — one sound, one meaning. He said that *knowledge* of the Cloud Sea was stored this way on purpose, scattered like seeds, so no single person could carry it all away.
knowledge:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到崖壁石架前，解释了为何云海宗的____被刻成碎片分散保存。
knowledge:2.hook: One tablet near the end of the shelf was cracked clean through the middle.
knowledge:2.line: '*Knowledge* here is never held by one pair of hands,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.
