sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a narrow shelf cut into the cliff face, lined with tablets of grey stone.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我来到悬崖面上凿出的一条窄架子前，架子上排满了灰色的石板。

sentences.en: Each tablet held not a full formula but a fragment — one sound, one meaning.
sentences.cn: 每块石板上不是完整的方子，而是一个片段——一个音，一个意思。

sentences.en: He said that *knowledge* of the Cloud Sea was stored this way on purpose, scattered like seeds, so no single person could carry it all away.

mental:2.en: After three days of copying formulas without sleep, my brushwork grew strange — the strokes curved when I meant them straight. Master Qingwu examined my practice sheets and said the problem was not physical but *mental*: a tired mind bends the word before the hand ever moves. She sent me to the rest pavilion with no scroll.
mental:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊看过我的练习后指出，我的问题不在身体而在____状态——疲倦的心会在落笔前就扭曲字形。
mental:2.hook: In the rest pavilion, I heard a formula whisper itself from the empty air.
mental:2.line: 'A *mental* fog will twist a word before your brush even lands,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: After three days of copying formulas without sleep, my brushwork grew strange — the strokes curved when I meant them straight.
sentences.cn: 三天没睡地抄方子后，我的笔法变得很奇怪——本该直的笔画却弯了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu examined my practice sheets and said the problem was not physical but *mental*: a tired mind bends the word before the hand ever moves.
She sent me to the rest pavilion with no scroll.
sentences.cn: 她把我打发到休息亭去，没有给我卷轴。

weight:2.en: The first complete formula I ever held in memory felt like a stone sitting behind my eyes — a *weight* both solid and warm. Xiaoxing said that was correct, that a truly learned word should press against the mind the way a ripe seed presses against its shell. She pressed a finger to her own temple and smiled.
weight:2.cnHint: 小星告诉我，真正记住的灵文应当像成熟种子一样，在脑海中留下真实的____感。
weight:2.hook: That night the weight shifted, and I dreamed of flying.
weight:2.line: 'Feel the *weight* of it — that is how you know the word is yours,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: The first complete formula I ever held in memory felt like a stone sitting behind my eyes — a *weight* both solid and warm.
Xiaoxing said that was correct, that a truly learned word should press against the mind the way a ripe seed presses against its shell.
sentences.cn: 小杏说那是对的，真正学到的字应该像一粒熟透的种子一样紧紧地贴着它的壳。

sentences.en: She pressed a finger to her own temple and smiled.
sentences.cn: 她用一根手指按了按自己的太阳穴，笑了。

academic:2.en: A traveller arrived from a lowland school carrying a letter sealed with formal stamps. Shen Wujiu read it aloud: the visitor wanted to compare our oral tradition with their own *academic* records — written lists of formulas kept in locked rooms and studied from paper alone. Master Qingwu listened, then looked at the clouds below, and said nothing for a long time.
academic:2.cnHint: 一位来自平原学府的访客希望将他们的____研究记录与云海宗的口传传统进行比较。
academic:2.hook: When Master Qingwu finally spoke, the clouds below the mountain rose three feet higher.
academic:2.line: 'Their *academic* lists name the words but never teach them to breathe,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: A traveller arrived from a lowland school carrying a letter sealed with formal stamps.
sentences.cn: 一个来自低地学派的旅客到了，带着贴着正式印章的信。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu read it aloud: the visitor wanted to compare our oral tradition with their own *academic* records — written lists of formulas kept in locked rooms and studied from paper alone.
Master Qingwu listened, then looked at the clouds below, and said nothing for a long time.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊听着，然后看了看下面的云，很久都没有说话。

seek:2.en: The old library floats at the mountain's eastern edge, half hidden in mist. I climb three hundred steps to reach it. Inside, a single oil lamp burns low. I *seek* the formula for cloud-walking among rows of silent scrolls, running my fingers along cold silk until one scroll glows faint gold beneath my touch.
seek:2.cnHint: 我在古老的藏经阁里____一个能在云上行走的法诀。
seek:2.hook: The scroll unrolls on its own, and the words inside are already moving.
seek:2.line: 'I *seek* the one word that can carry a body above the clouds.'

sentences.en: The old library floats at the mountain's eastern edge, half hidden in mist.
sentences.cn: 老图书馆浮在山的东边，半隐在雾里。

sentences.en: I climb three hundred steps to reach it.
sentences.cn: 我爬了三百级台阶才能到达。

sentences.en: Inside, a single oil lamp burns low.
sentences.cn: 里面，一盏油灯烧得很低。

sentences.en: I *seek* the formula for cloud-walking among rows of silent scrolls, running my fingers along cold silk until one scroll glows faint gold beneath my touch.

exist:2.en: Shen Wujiu leads me to a hollow in the cliff face where the stone sweats cold dew. 'Some say the word for silence does not *exist* in our sect's old tongue,' he says, pressing his palm flat against the rock. Beneath his hand, faint carvings appear — a single character I have never seen before.
exist:2.cnHint: 师兄说，沉默这个词也许根本不____于门派古语之中。
exist:2.hook: The character fades the moment his hand lifts, leaving no mark at all.
exist:2.line: 'A word cannot help you if it does not *exist* in any scroll we hold.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu leads me to a hollow in the cliff face where the stone sweats cold dew.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我来到断崖的一个凹陷处，石头上渗出冷露。

sentences.en: 'Some say the word for silence does not *exist* in our sect's old tongue,' he says, pressing his palm flat against the rock.
Beneath his hand, faint carvings appear — a single character I have never seen before.
sentences.cn: 他的手掌下，淡淡的刻画浮现了——一个我从未见过的单独字符。

supply:2.en: Master Qingwu opens a small cedar box and counts out seven dried spirit-leaves, pressing them into my palm. 'Your *supply* of breath-herb for the first season,' she says quietly. Each leaf holds one hour of clear thought at high altitude where the air grows thin and the mind can drift.
supply:2.cnHint: 师尊把我整个季节的灵草____交到我手中。
supply:2.hook: There are only seven leaves, and the first trial is thirty days away.
supply:2.line: 'Guard this *supply* well — once it is gone, the mountain will not forgive careless breathing.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu opens a small cedar box and counts out seven dried spirit-leaves, pressing them into my palm.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊打开一个小杉木盒，数出七片干燥的灵叶，按进我的掌心。

sentences.en: 'Your *supply* of breath-herb for the first season,' she says quietly.
Each leaf holds one hour of clear thought at high altitude where the air grows thin and the mind can drift.
sentences.cn: 每一片叶子都能在高空中维持一小时的清晰思维，那里空气稀薄，思绪容易飘散。

visit:2.en: A grey crane lands on my window ledge before dawn, carrying a ribbon tied around one leg. The ribbon holds a folded note: Xiaoxing requests a *visit* to the Cold Spring Pavilion at noon. She has found something frozen in the ice that should not be there — a word written in fire.
visit:2.cnHint: 小星托仙鹤送来纸条，邀我____寒泉阁。
visit:2.hook: The crane is gone before I finish reading, and it leaves no footprints on the stone.
visit:2.line: 'Come for a *visit* before noon — what I found in the ice cannot wait until evening.'

sentences.en: A grey crane lands on my window ledge before dawn, carrying a ribbon tied around one leg.
sentences.cn: 天亮前，一只灰鹤落在我的窗台上，一条丝带缠绕着它的腿。

sentences.en: The ribbon holds a folded note: Xiaoxing requests a *visit* to the Cold Spring Pavilion at noon.
She has found something frozen in the ice that should not be there — a word written in fire.
sentences.cn: 小杏在冰里发现了不该出现的东西——用火焰写下的字。

worry:2.en: I copy the healing formula three times, comparing each line. Xiaoxing watches from the doorway. 'You look like *worry* has settled on your shoulders like snow,' she says softly. I do not answer. One character in the third line is wrong in all three copies, and I do not know if the error is mine or the original scroll's.
worry:2.cnHint: 小星说，我看起来满身____，像是压了一层雪。
worry:2.hook: Outside, the clouds below the mountain rise higher than they did this morning.
worry:2.line: 'Put your *worry* down for one breath — then look at the character again with fresh eyes.'

sentences.en: I copy the healing formula three times, comparing each line.
sentences.cn: 我把疗愈咒抄了三遍，逐行对照。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing watches from the doorway.
sentences.cn: 小杏从门口看着我。

sentences.en: 'You look like *worry* has settled on your shoulders like snow,' she says softly.
I do not answer.
sentences.cn: 我没有回答。

sentences.en: One character in the third line is wrong in all three copies, and I do not know if the error is mine or the original scroll's.
sentences.cn: 三份抄本的第三行里都有一个字写错了，我分不清是我的笔误还是原卷本身就有问题。

adapt:2.en: The breathing method Master Qingwu taught us was written for lowland air. Up here on the third peak, each breath carries half the usual strength. Shen Wujiu shows me how to *adapt* the rhythm — slower on the draw, longer on the hold — until the thin air stops fighting me and begins to carry me instead.
adapt:2.cnHint: 师兄教我如何____呼吸法，以应对高峰上稀薄的空气。
adapt:2.hook: Just as my breathing steadies, a low bell rings from the peak above — one slow, unmistakable toll.
adapt:2.line: 'You must *adapt* the old method, or the high air will wear you down before the trial begins.'

sentences.en: The breathing method Master Qingwu taught us was written for lowland air.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊教我们的呼吸法是按低地的空气设计的。

sentences.en: Up here on the third peak, each breath carries half the usual strength.
sentences.cn: 在第三峰这么高的地方，每一次呼吸的力量都只有平时的一半。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu shows me how to *adapt* the rhythm — slower on the draw, longer on the hold — until the thin air stops fighting me and begins to carry me instead.

bit:2.en: The spirit-ink dries too fast in the cold. I have only a *bit* of the warming powder Xiaoxing gave me — enough to coat the tip of my brush twice, no more. I choose the two most important strokes of the formula and press forward, hoping the rest of the characters will hold their meaning without warmth.
bit:2.cnHint: 我只剩一____小星给我的保温粉，只够用两笔。
bit:2.hook: The last stroke dries cracked, and the whole formula shimmers like it might vanish.
bit:2.line: 'Even a small *bit* of care at the beginning can save a whole formula from falling apart.'

sentences.en: The spirit-ink dries too fast in the cold.
sentences.cn: 灵墨在严寒中干得太快。

sentences.en: I have only a *bit* of the warming powder Xiaoxing gave me — enough to coat the tip of my brush twice, no more.
I choose the two most important strokes of the formula and press forward, hoping the rest of the characters will hold their meaning without warmth.
sentences.cn: 我只剩下小杏给我的一点温粉——够涂刷两次笔尖，再多就没了。我选了咒文里最重要的两笔按下去，寄希望其他字能在没有温度的情况下保持意义。

check:2.en: Before the gate examination, Shen Wujiu makes me *check* every word I have memorized against the original stone tablet in the outer courtyard. Three characters I was certain of turn out to carry different tones. He says nothing. He only points, and I understand — certainty without checking is the first crack in a foundation.
check:2.cnHint: 考试前，师兄让我把背下来的字逐一____，与外院石碑上的原文对照。
check:2.hook: On the tablet's lower edge, scratched faintly in newer stone, is a word none of our lessons have named.
check:2.line: 'Always *check* the source before you trust what memory tells you it said.'

sentences.en: Before the gate examination, Shen Wujiu makes me *check* every word I have memorized against the original stone tablet in the outer courtyard.
Three characters I was certain of turn out to carry different tones.
sentences.cn: 三个我以为肯定没错的字，音调其实完全不同。

sentences.en: He says nothing.
sentences.cn: 他什么也没说。

sentences.en: He only points, and I understand — certainty without checking is the first crack in a foundation.
sentences.cn: 他只是用手指了指，我明白了——不经检验的确定是地基上的第一道裂缝。

save:2.en: Deep in the lower archive room, I found a jade tablet cracked in two. Master Qingwu knelt beside it, pressing her palms together. 'We must *save* every glyph before the stone fades,' she said. Her breath clouded the cold air. Somewhere below, the clouds shifted, and a faint red light rose.
save:2.cnHint: 师尊命我们在石碑完全碎裂之前，把上面的文字全部____下来。
save:2.hook: The red light beneath the clouds pulsed once, then went still.
save:2.line: 'We must *save* every glyph before the stone fades completely.'

sentences.en: Deep in the lower archive room, I found a jade tablet cracked in two.
sentences.cn: 在下面的藏经室深处，我发现了一块裂成两半的玉简。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu knelt beside it, pressing her palms together.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊跪在它边上，两掌合十。

sentences.en: 'We must *save* every glyph before the stone fades,' she said.
Her breath clouded the cold air.
sentences.cn: 她的呼吸在冷空气中凝成白雾。

sentences.en: Somewhere below, the clouds shifted, and a faint red light rose.
sentences.cn: 下面某处，云层移动了，一道淡淡的红光升起。

service:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the Healing Hall, where outer disciples waited in a long row. 'This *service* is offered once a month,' he said, handing each person a small vial of green mist. The hall smelled of pine and something older. At dusk, one vial glowed brighter than the rest.
service:2.cnHint: 云海宗每月一次为弟子提供治愈____，但今天有一瓶药雾异常发光。
service:2.hook: No one could explain why that single vial burned like a star.
service:2.line: 'This *service* is offered to every disciple, without exception.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the Healing Hall, where outer disciples waited in a long row.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我去了疗愈殿，外门弟子排成长队等在那里。

sentences.en: 'This *service* is offered once a month,' he said, handing each person a small vial of green mist.
The hall smelled of pine and something older.
sentences.cn: 大殿闻起来有松树和某种更古老的气息。

sentences.en: At dusk, one vial glowed brighter than the rest.
sentences.cn: 傍晚时，有一个小瓶比其他的亮。

note:2.en: On the stone table in the library pavilion, I found a folded *note* tucked beneath an old formula scroll. The writing was thin and hurried: 'Do not open the east gate at dawn.' No name. The ink was still faintly warm, as if it had been placed there moments before I arrived.
note:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁的石桌上发现了一张神秘的____，上面写着不要在黎明开东门。
note:2.hook: Outside, the east gate creaked softly in windless air.
note:2.line: 'Read the *note* carefully — every word in it matters.'

sentences.en: On the stone table in the library pavilion, I found a folded *note* tucked beneath an old formula scroll.
The writing was thin and hurried: 'Do not open the east gate at dawn.'
sentences.cn: 笔迹细长又仓促：「天亮时不要打开东门。」

sentences.en: No name.
sentences.cn: 没有署名。

sentences.en: The ink was still faintly warm, as if it had been placed there moments before I arrived.
sentences.cn: 墨迹还微微发热，好像是我到达前不久才放下的。

probably:2.en: Xiaoxing held up the pale blue seed she had found lodged in a crack in the mountain path. 'It is *probably* a sky-herb,' she said, turning it slowly. 'They only fall when the clouds below are troubled.' She wrapped it in silk. High above, a second seed drifted down from nowhere.
probably:2.cnHint: 小星在山路石缝中发现了一粒蓝色种子，她认为这____是一株天草。
probably:2.hook: A second seed fell from a sky with no visible plant.
probably:2.line: 'It is *probably* a sky-herb — we should bring it to Master Qingwu.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing held up the pale blue seed she had found lodged in a crack in the mountain path.
sentences.cn: 小杏举起她从山路裂缝里找到的淡蓝色种子。

sentences.en: 'It is *probably* a sky-herb,' she said, turning it slowly.
'They only fall when the clouds below are troubled.'
sentences.cn: 「只有下面的云层起了波澜，天草才会飘落。」

sentences.en: She wrapped it in silk.
sentences.cn: 她用丝绸把它包起来。

sentences.en: High above, a second seed drifted down from nowhere.
sentences.cn: 高空中，第二粒种子从虚无里飘了下来。

strategy:2.en: In the map room, Shen Wujiu spread a chart of the lower cloud paths across the floor. 'Our *strategy* is simple,' he said. 'Move through the thin mist at the second bell, before the fog-beasts wake.' I studied the route he traced. One section of the path had been crossed out twice.
strategy:2.cnHint: 师兄在地图室讲解穿越云雾的____，但路线中有一段被划掉了两次。
strategy:2.hook: Whatever crossed out that section had done so with a shaking hand.
strategy:2.line: 'Our *strategy* depends on moving before the second bell rings.'

sentences.en: In the map room, Shen Wujiu spread a chart of the lower cloud paths across the floor.
sentences.cn: 在地图室，沈无咎把一张下层云路的图摊在地上。

sentences.en: 'Our *strategy* is simple,' he said.
'Move through the thin mist at the second bell, before the fog-beasts wake.'
sentences.cn: 「第二更时通过薄雾，在雾兽醒来前穿过。」

sentences.en: I studied the route he traced.
sentences.cn: 我研究了他描绘的路线。

sentences.en: One section of the path had been crossed out twice.
sentences.cn: 路线的一段被划掉了两次。

building:2.en: At the edge of the sect grounds stood a *building* no one had entered in years. Its roof tiles were the colour of storm clouds, and vines had sealed the door. Master Qingwu paused before it, her eyes quiet and unreadable. She placed one hand flat against the wood. The vines pulled back.
building:2.cnHint: 在宗门边缘有一座无人踏入多年的____，师尊轻触其门，藤蔓竟自动退开。
building:2.hook: Behind the retreating vines, something on the wall was breathing.
building:2.line: 'That *building* has been sealed since before any of us arrived here.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the sect grounds stood a *building* no one had entered in years.
Its roof tiles were the colour of storm clouds, and vines had sealed the door.
sentences.cn: 它的瓦片颜色像乌云，藤蔓封住了门。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu paused before it, her eyes quiet and unreadable.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在它前面停下，眼神安静而难以捉摸。

sentences.en: She placed one hand flat against the wood.
sentences.cn: 她把一只手平贴在木头上。

sentences.en: The vines pulled back.
sentences.cn: 藤蔓缩了回去。

community:2.en: Master Qingwu gathered all disciples at the central platform. 'We are a *community* of seekers,' she said. 'Every herb you grow, every word you learn, feeds the whole.' She held up a small lantern. Each flame in the courtyard leaned toward it at once, as if listening. Then every flame turned white.
community:2.cnHint: 师尊告诫弟子们，云海宗是一个____，每个人的修行都关乎全体。
community:2.hook: White flames mean only one thing in the old texts: a door is opening.
community:2.line: 'We are a *community*, and what weakens one of us weakens all.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu gathered all disciples at the central platform.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把所有弟子召集到中央平台。

sentences.en: 'We are a *community* of seekers,' she said.
'Every herb you grow, every word you learn, feeds the whole.'
sentences.cn: 「你们种的每一株草，学的每一个字，都在养育整个宗门。」

sentences.en: She held up a small lantern.
sentences.cn: 她举起一盏小灯。

sentences.en: Each flame in the courtyard leaned toward it at once, as if listening.
sentences.cn: 院里的每一束火焰都立刻朝它倾斜，仿佛在倾听。

sentences.en: Then every flame turned white.
sentences.cn: 然后每一束火焰都变成了白色。

internet:2.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a glowing net of silver threads between two pine trees. 'The old masters called this the *internet* of the spirit world,' he said. 'Every thought you press into it travels to every connected peak.' I touched one thread. A distant bell rang in a mountain I could not see.
internet:2.cnHint: 师兄展示了一张灵力编织的丝网，称之为修真界的____，可传递意念至各峰。
internet:2.hook: The bell that answered belonged to a peak lost three centuries ago.
internet:2.line: 'Press your intention into the *internet* and the other peaks will hear.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a glowing net of silver threads between two pine trees.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在两棵松树间展开了一张闪闪发光的银线网。

sentences.en: 'The old masters called this the *internet* of the spirit world,' he said.
'Every thought you press into it travels to every connected peak.'
sentences.cn: 你按进去的每个念头都会传到每个连接的山峰。

sentences.en: I touched one thread.
sentences.cn: 我碰了一根线。

sentences.en: A distant bell rang in a mountain I could not see.
sentences.cn: 一座看不见的远山里响起了钟声。

major:2.en: Inside the sect library, I found a cracked jade tablet. Master Qingwu had told us that a *major* shift in the cloud currents could seal the mountain passes for years. The tablet confirmed it — deep cracks ran across the sky-map carved into its face, matching no pattern I had seen before.
major:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁发现了一块破裂的玉简，上面记载着某个____的预兆。
major:2.hook: The cracks on the tablet still glowed faintly warm.
major:2.line: 'This is a *major* sign — do not touch the tablet again,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Inside the sect library, I found a cracked jade tablet.
sentences.cn: 在宗派的藏经阁里，我找到了一块裂开的玉牌。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had told us that a *major* shift in the cloud currents could seal the mountain passes for years.
The tablet confirmed it — deep cracks ran across the sky-map carved into its face, matching no pattern I had seen before.
sentences.cn: 玉牌证实了——它表面刻着的天空地图上有深深的裂纹，与我见过的任何图案都不相符。

communication:2.en: A small spirit bird landed on my window ledge, carrying a folded leaf sealed with blue wax. Shen Wujiu had warned me that *communication* between the outer peaks was rare — the cloud winds tore most messages apart before they arrived. Yet this leaf was whole, and the wax unbroken.
communication:2.cnHint: 一只灵鸟将一封来自外峰的信件完好无损地送到了我手中，而峰间的____向来极为困难。
communication:2.hook: The blue wax bore a name I did not recognise.
communication:2.line: Shen Wujiu said, '*Communication* between the peaks has been cut — this bird should not exist.'

sentences.en: A small spirit bird landed on my window ledge, carrying a folded leaf sealed with blue wax.
sentences.cn: 一只小灵鸟落在我的窗台上，衔着一片用蓝色蜂蜡封好的折叶。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu had warned me that *communication* between the outer peaks was rare — the cloud winds tore most messages apart before they arrived.
Yet this leaf was whole, and the wax unbroken.
sentences.cn: 可这片叶子完好无损，蜡印也没有破。

market:2.en: Below the third terrace, where the mist thinned each morning, the disciples held a small *market*. Dried word-herbs, empty spirit vials, and hand-copied formula sheets changed hands in quiet trades. Xiaoxing pulled me close to a stall selling something wrapped in grey cloth — she would not say what it was.
market:2.cnHint: 弟子们在晨雾散去时于第三台地开设____，小星在一个摊位前神秘地拉住了我。
market:2.hook: The grey cloth moved once, as if breathing.
market:2.line: 'The *market* only opens when the elders are in retreat,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: Below the third terrace, where the mist thinned each morning, the disciples held a small *market*.
Dried word-herbs, empty spirit vials, and hand-copied formula sheets changed hands in quiet trades.
sentences.cn: 干制的字药、空的灵力瓶子、还有手抄的功法单在安静的交易中易主。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pulled me close to a stall selling something wrapped in grey cloth — she would not say what it was.
sentences.cn: 小杏拉着我靠近一个摊位，上面卖的东西用灰布包着——她不肯说是什么。

apply:2.en: The formula sheet called for three drops of morning dew, gathered from a leaf that faced east. I had to *apply* the liquid to the cracked jade tablet before the sun cleared the cloud line. My hands were steady, but the dew hissed softly the moment it touched the surface.
apply:2.cnHint: 功法卷轴要求我将晨露____在破裂的玉简上，以日出为限。
apply:2.hook: A thin line of silver light spread from each drop.
apply:2.line: '*Apply* it slowly — one wrong drop and the seal will shatter,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The formula sheet called for three drops of morning dew, gathered from a leaf that faced east.
sentences.cn: 功法单上要求三滴晨露，从朝东的叶子上采集。

sentences.en: I had to *apply* the liquid to the cracked jade tablet before the sun cleared the cloud line.
My hands were steady, but the dew hissed softly the moment it touched the surface.
sentences.cn: 我的手很稳，但露水一接触表面就轻声嘶鸣了。

per:2.en: Master Qingwu assigned us one page of formula study *per* day — no more, no less. She said that the mind, like soil, could only hold so much before new roots found nothing to grip. On the seventh day, my assigned page contained a single line that made the lamp flame bend toward me.
per:2.cnHint: 师尊规定我们每天____天研习一页功法，第七天那页上的内容令灯火异动。
per:2.hook: The flame leaned closer each time I read that line.
per:2.line: 'One lesson *per* day keeps the spirit rooted,' said Master Qingwu softly.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu assigned us one page of formula study *per* day — no more, no less.
She said that the mind, like soil, could only hold so much before new roots found nothing to grip.
sentences.cn: 她说心智就像土壤，装得太满新的根就找不到抓力。

sentences.en: On the seventh day, my assigned page contained a single line that made the lamp flame bend toward me.
sentences.cn: 到了第七天，我的功课页上只有一句话，灯火一看到它就朝我弯去。

treat:2.en: Shen Wujiu brought a small clay pot to the courtyard and set it before me without a word. Inside were three cloud-berries — a rare *treat* that elder disciples earned only after completing a full-year trial. He watched me with calm eyes, as though the gift carried a question he had not yet asked.
treat:2.cnHint: 师兄无声地将一份珍贵的____摆在我面前，那是通常只有完成年度考验后才能获得的云果。
treat:2.hook: His calm eyes held something unspoken and heavy.
treat:2.line: Shen Wujiu said, 'Consider it a *treat* — but remember what it asks of you.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu brought a small clay pot to the courtyard and set it before me without a word.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎拎着一个小陶罐来到院子里，无言地放在我面前。

sentences.en: Inside were three cloud-berries — a rare *treat* that elder disciples earned only after completing a full-year trial.
He watched me with calm eyes, as though the gift carried a question he had not yet asked.
sentences.cn: 他用平静的眼神看着我，好像这礼物本身就是一个他还没问出来的问题。

creative:2.en: The assignment seemed simple: arrange five word-herbs into a new formula of our own design. Xiaoxing finished first, her solution so *creative* that the herbs began to spin in a slow circle above her palm without any further instruction. Master Qingwu looked up from her book and set it down.
creative:2.cnHint: 小星以极具____的方式完成了药草排列作业，令药草自行旋转，引起师尊注意。
creative:2.hook: Master Qingwu had not set her book down all month.
creative:2.line: 'That is the most *creative* formula arrangement I have seen this season,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The assignment seemed simple: arrange five word-herbs into a new formula of our own design.
sentences.cn: 这个任务看起来很简单：用五种字药自己设计一个新功法。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing finished first, her solution so *creative* that the herbs began to spin in a slow circle above her palm without any further instruction.
Master Qingwu looked up from her book and set it down.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从书上抬起头，把书放了下去。

perform:2.en: Each new disciple was asked to *perform* one basic sky-step before the assembled elders at dawn. Most managed three paces above the ground before sinking back. When my turn came, I rose higher than expected — and then the clouds below me began to form a shape that had no name in any text.
perform:2.cnHint: 新弟子须在长老面前____一次基础凌云步，轮到我时，脚下云层却变幻出了不知名的形状。
perform:2.hook: No elder spoke, and none looked away.
perform:2.line: '*Perform* the step once more — exactly as you did it,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Each new disciple was asked to *perform* one basic sky-step before the assembled elders at dawn.
Most managed three paces above the ground before sinking back.
sentences.cn: 大多数人在离地三步的地方就沉了下去。

sentences.en: When my turn came, I rose higher than expected — and then the clouds below me began to form a shape that had no name in any text.
sentences.cn: 轮到我时，我升得比预料的高——然后我下面的云开始组成一个在任何典籍里都没有名字的形状。

trouble:2.en: A sealed jar sat on my desk when I woke — no note, no name. Inside, a single dried leaf pulsed with faint gold light. Shen Wujiu leaned in the doorway: 'That herb only grows where *trouble* has already begun. Someone left it as a warning.' I held the jar up. The leaf pulsed faster.
trouble:2.cnHint: 清晨，我桌上出现一个封口罐子，师兄说那种草药只在____来临之处生长。
trouble:2.hook: By nightfall, three more jars appeared — on every new disciple's desk.
trouble:2.line: 'That herb only grows where *trouble* has already begun.'

sentences.en: A sealed jar sat on my desk when I woke — no note, no name.
sentences.cn: 我醒来时桌上放着一个密封的罐子——没有纸条，没有署名。

sentences.en: Inside, a single dried leaf pulsed with faint gold light.
sentences.cn: 罐子里有一片干枯的叶子，闪烁着淡淡的金光。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu leaned in the doorway: 'That herb only grows where *trouble* has already begun.
Someone left it as a warning.'
sentences.cn: 有人留下它作为警告。

sentences.en: I held the jar up.
sentences.cn: 我举起罐子。

sentences.en: The leaf pulsed faster.
sentences.cn: 叶子闪烁得更快了。

reflect:2.en: The still pool at the mountain's edge was said to *reflect* not your face but your deepest fear. I knelt beside it at dawn, alone. The water showed me a blank scroll — every word I had learned, erased. I stood quickly. Somewhere above, a bell rang once, though no wind blew.
reflect:2.cnHint: 山边的水池据说能____出你内心最深的恐惧，我在水中看到了空白的卷轴。
reflect:2.hook: The blank scroll in the water slowly filled with someone else's name.
reflect:2.line: 'This pool will *reflect* what you hide, not what you show.'

sentences.en: The still pool at the mountain's edge was said to *reflect* not your face but your deepest fear.
I knelt beside it at dawn, alone.
sentences.cn: 黎明时我独自跪在它边上。

sentences.en: The water showed me a blank scroll — every word I had learned, erased.
sentences.cn: 水里映出的不是我的脸，而是一卷空白的纸——我学过的每个字都被抹去了。

sentences.en: I stood quickly.
sentences.cn: 我迅速站起身。

sentences.en: Somewhere above, a bell rang once, though no wind blew.
sentences.cn: 什么地方在上面响起了一声钟，虽然没有风。

attend:2.en: A folded notice arrived by cloud-crane: all first-year disciples must *attend* a gathering in the Hall of First Words before the moon rose. Xiaoxing tugged my sleeve. 'I heard the last disciple who arrived late found their study room empty — books, brush, everything gone.' The crane circled once and flew south.
attend:2.cnHint: 一只云鹤送来通知，要求所有新弟子在月升前____大殿集会。
attend:2.hook: The crane's shadow on the floor spelled a word none of us recognised.
attend:2.line: 'We must *attend* the gathering — do not be the last to arrive.'

sentences.en: A folded notice arrived by cloud-crane: all first-year disciples must *attend* a gathering in the Hall of First Words before the moon rose.
Xiaoxing tugged my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 小杏拉了拉我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'I heard the last disciple who arrived late found their study room empty — books, brush, everything gone.'
sentences.cn: 我听说上一个迟到的弟子发现自己的书房空了——书、笔、什么都没了。

sentences.en: The crane circled once and flew south.
sentences.cn: 云鹤转了一圈，向南飞去。

belief:2.en: Master Qingwu set a single white stone on the table between us. 'Your *belief* that words must be spoken aloud is the first wall you must break,' she said, not unkindly. 'The strongest formula this sect holds has never made a sound.' She lifted the stone. Beneath it, the table was carved with a warning I could not yet read.
belief:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，认为咒语必须出声念出的____，是我要打破的第一堵墙。
belief:2.hook: The carved warning beneath the stone was dated one hundred years ahead.
belief:2.line: 'Your *belief* that words must be spoken aloud is the first wall to break.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set a single white stone on the table between us.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我们之间的桌上放了一块白石。

sentences.en: 'Your *belief* that words must be spoken aloud is the first wall you must break,' she said, not unkindly.
'The strongest formula this sect holds has never made a sound.'
sentences.cn: 本门最强的公式从未发出过声音。

sentences.en: She lifted the stone.
sentences.cn: 她抬起了那块石头。

sentences.en: Beneath it, the table was carved with a warning I could not yet read.
sentences.cn: 石桌下刻着一段我还读不懂的警告。

carry:2.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a thin scroll into my hands before the morning mist lifted. 'I need you to *carry* this to the east archive without opening it,' he said, his voice low. 'If it grows warm, set it down and walk away.' Halfway across the bridge, the scroll grew warm. I stopped. Below, the sea of clouds swirled in a tight, silent circle.
carry:2.cnHint: 师兄让我把一个卷轴____到东侧藏经阁，并告诉我如果它变热就放下离开。
carry:2.hook: The clouds below began to spin, forming the shape of an open hand.
carry:2.line: '*Carry* this to the east archive — and do not open it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a thin scroll into my hands before the morning mist lifted.
sentences.cn: 晨雾未散，沈无咎就把一卷薄纸塞进了我的手里。

sentences.en: 'I need you to *carry* this to the east archive without opening it,' he said, his voice low.
'If it grows warm, set it down and walk away.'
sentences.cn: 如果它发烫，就把它放下，然后走开。

sentences.en: Halfway across the bridge, the scroll grew warm.
sentences.cn: 走到桥中间时，纸卷烫了起来。

sentences.en: I stopped.
sentences.cn: 我停住了。

sentences.en: Below, the sea of clouds swirled in a tight, silent circle.
sentences.cn: 下面，云海在一个紧密、寂静的圆圈里翻滚。

else:2.en: Xiaoxing found a name carved inside her desk drawer — not her own. She asked every disciple in the hall, but no one recognised it. 'It must belong to someone *else* entirely,' she told me, 'someone who sat here before the sect moved to this mountain.' She traced the characters. The candle beside her bent its flame toward the drawer, as if listening.
else:2.cnHint: 小星在抽屉里发现了一个刻下的名字，那一定属于____某个人——一个更早之前的弟子。
else:2.hook: The candle flame leaned into the drawer, and would not straighten again.
else:2.line: 'It must belong to someone *else* — someone who sat here long before us.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found a name carved inside her desk drawer — not her own.
sentences.cn: 小杏在她的书桌抽屉里发现了一个名字——不是她自己的。

sentences.en: She asked every disciple in the hall, but no one recognised it.
sentences.cn: 她问了大厅里的每一个弟子，但没人认识这个名字。

sentences.en: 'It must belong to someone *else* entirely,' she told me, 'someone who sat here before the sect moved to this mountain.'
She traced the characters.
sentences.cn: 她描过那些字。

sentences.en: The candle beside her bent its flame toward the drawer, as if listening.
sentences.cn: 她身边的蜡烛弯起火焰，仿佛在倾听抽屉里的秘密。

prepare:2.en: Before dawn, I entered the Medicine Hall to *prepare* the morning elixirs. Dried petals and root powders lay sorted in stone bowls. Master Qingwu had left a list on the shelf: twelve herbs, twelve steps, no room for error. The hall was quiet, but the air smelled of something burning that was not on the list.
prepare:2.cnHint: 我在药堂____晨药，却闻到一股不明来源的焦味。
prepare:2.hook: The smoke rose from a bowl no one had touched.
prepare:2.line: 'You must *prepare* each herb in the order I gave you,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Before dawn, I entered the Medicine Hall to *prepare* the morning elixirs.
Dried petals and root powders lay sorted in stone bowls.
sentences.cn: 干花瓣和根粉被整齐地放在石碗里。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had left a list on the shelf: twelve herbs, twelve steps, no room for error.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在架子上留了一份单子：十二种草药，十二步步骤，没有出错的余地。

sentences.en: The hall was quiet, but the air smelled of something burning that was not on the list.
sentences.cn: 大厅很安静，但空气中弥漫着单子上没有的东西的焦味。

workplace:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me through the lower terrace, past drying racks of golden leaves, to the Inscription Hall. 'This is our *workplace*,' he said, gesturing at rows of stone tablets carved with glowing words. Each tablet held a living formula. I touched one, and a faint hum passed through my fingers like a held breath.
workplace:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到铭文堂，说这里是我们的____。
workplace:2.hook: One tablet had a crack that had not been there yesterday.
workplace:2.line: 'Treat this *workplace* with respect — the stones remember careless hands,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me through the lower terrace, past drying racks of golden leaves, to the Inscription Hall.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我穿过下层平台，经过成排晒干的金色叶子，来到了铭文殿。

sentences.en: 'This is our *workplace*,' he said, gesturing at rows of stone tablets carved with glowing words.
Each tablet held a living formula.
sentences.cn: 每块石板上都刻着一个活的公式。

sentences.en: I touched one, and a faint hum passed through my fingers like a held breath.
sentences.cn: 我摸了一下，一阵轻微的嗡鸣声像一口屏住的气息穿过了我的指尖。

post:2.en: A white crane landed on the outer gate and dropped a rolled leaf at my feet. I unrolled it and found a single sentence written in silver ink. Xiaoxing said the Sect used cranes to *post* urgent messages between floating peaks when wind made the bridges unsafe. The message bore Master Qingwu's seal — and my name.
post:2.cnHint: 小星说宗门用仙鹤____紧急消息，而这封信上写着我的名字。
post:2.hook: The seal was cracked down the middle.
post:2.line: 'They *post* only one kind of news by crane,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: A white crane landed on the outer gate and dropped a rolled leaf at my feet.
sentences.cn: 一只白鹤落在外门上，在我脚下掉了一片卷起的叶子。

sentences.en: I unrolled it and found a single sentence written in silver ink.
sentences.cn: 我打开它，发现用银色墨水写的一句话。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing said the Sect used cranes to *post* urgent messages between floating peaks when wind made the bridges unsafe.
The message bore Master Qingwu's seal — and my name.
sentences.cn: 那条信息上盖着青梧师尊的印章——还有我的名字。

complete:2.en: I spent the whole afternoon copying the Wind-Step formula onto fresh bark paper. When I reached the final stroke, the characters began to glow faintly and then went still. Xiaoxing looked over my shoulder and nodded. 'You *complete* the copy only when every stroke carries intent,' she said. Mine, it seemed, did — barely.
complete:2.cnHint: 小星告诉我，只有每一笔都带有心意，才算____抄录。
complete:2.hook: The last character faded before the ink dried.
complete:2.line: 'To *complete* a formula is to breathe life into each stroke,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: I spent the whole afternoon copying the Wind-Step formula onto fresh bark paper.
sentences.cn: 我花了整个下午把风行公式抄在新树皮纸上。

sentences.en: When I reached the final stroke, the characters began to glow faintly and then went still.
sentences.cn: 当我写到最后一笔时，那些字开始微微发光，然后就静止了。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing looked over my shoulder and nodded.
sentences.cn: 小杏从我肩后看过来，点了点头。

sentences.en: 'You *complete* the copy only when every stroke carries intent,' she said.
Mine, it seemed, did — barely.
sentences.cn: 看起来我的笔划做到了——虽然勉强。

measure:2.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the edge of the peak with a thin jade rod, *measuring* the distance between two drifting cloud-banks. 'The gap tells us when the next wind-path opens,' he explained. I watched the numbers he whispered change with each gust. On the third reading, his hand stilled and he looked east with narrow eyes.
measure:2.cnHint: 师兄用玉尺____两片云层之间的距离，第三次读数时他停了下来。
measure:2.hook: He put the rod away without writing down the last number.
measure:2.line: '*Measure* twice before you step onto any wind-path,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the edge of the peak with a thin jade rod, *measuring* the distance between two drifting cloud-banks.
'The gap tells us when the next wind-path opens,' he explained.
sentences.cn: 他解释说，间隔会告诉我们下一条风路何时打开。

sentences.en: I watched the numbers he whispered change with each gust.
sentences.cn: 我看着他低声说出的数字随着每一阵风而改变。

sentences.en: On the third reading, his hand stilled and he looked east with narrow eyes.
sentences.cn: 第三次读数时，他的手停了下来，眼神向东望去，眯了眯眼。

recommend:2.en: Master Qingwu placed a thin book on the table before me. 'I *recommend* this text above all others for your first month,' she said. It was a short collection of root-word formulas, worn soft at the corners. Xiaoxing whispered that few disciples ever finished it. I opened to the first page and felt the characters shift.
recommend:2.cnHint: 师尊向我____一本古旧的根字法典，小星说很少有弟子读完过它。
recommend:2.hook: The first page showed a warning I could not yet read.
recommend:2.line: 'I *recommend* you read it before you sleep tonight,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a thin book on the table before me.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我面前的桌上放了一本薄书。

sentences.en: 'I *recommend* this text above all others for your first month,' she said.
It was a short collection of root-word formulas, worn soft at the corners.
sentences.cn: 这是一本磨损得软软的根字公式集。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing whispered that few disciples ever finished it.
sentences.cn: 小杏低声说很少有弟子能读完它。

sentences.en: I opened to the first page and felt the characters shift.
sentences.cn: 我翻到第一页，感觉到那些字在移动。

resource:2.en: The Sect library held scrolls floor to ceiling, each one a *resource* for a different kind of cultivation path. Shen Wujiu told me that the rarest scrolls had been moved underground after a windstorm three years ago. I found the shelf marked for newcomers — it held only four scrolls. One of them was sealed with black thread.
resource:2.cnHint: 宗门藏书楼里的每一卷都是修炼的____，但有一卷被黑线封住了。
resource:2.hook: The black thread was tied in a knot no disciple should know.
resource:2.line: 'Every scroll here is a *resource* — but not every resource is safe,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The Sect library held scrolls floor to ceiling, each one a *resource* for a different kind of cultivation path.
Shen Wujiu told me that the rarest scrolls had been moved underground after a windstorm three years ago.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎告诉我，三年前的一场风暴后，最稀有的卷轴被移到了地下。

sentences.en: I found the shelf marked for newcomers — it held only four scrolls.
sentences.cn: 我找到了为新人标记的架子——上面只有四卷纸。

sentences.en: One of them was sealed with black thread.
sentences.cn: 其中一卷用黑线封着。

specific:2.en: Master Qingwu handed me a list of tasks for the week, then pointed to the third item. 'Be *specific* when you record each herb's weight,' she said. 'A vague number is the same as no number.' I looked at the empty column in the record book, then at the herbs in the bowl, and realised I had no scale.
specific:2.cnHint: 师尊要求我记录草药重量时必须____，我这才发现自己没有秤。
specific:2.hook: The scale had been in the hall that morning — now it was gone.
specific:2.line: 'Be *specific*: I need the exact weight, not your best guess,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu handed me a list of tasks for the week, then pointed to the third item.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊递给我一份本周的任务清单，然后指向第三项。

sentences.en: 'Be *specific* when you record each herb's weight,' she said.
'A vague number is the same as no number.'
sentences.cn: 一个模糊的数字和没有数字是一样的。

sentences.en: I looked at the empty column in the record book, then at the herbs in the bowl, and realised I had no scale.
sentences.cn: 我看着记录本里的空白栏，再看看碗里的草药，才意识到我没有秤。

due:1.en: The morning bell rang across the stone courtyard. Master Qingwu stood at the gate, her white robe still in the windless air. 'Your first lesson is *due* at sunrise,' she said. I had not slept. The sky above the sea of clouds burned faint gold, and somewhere below, a horn sounded — low, slow, and without cause.
due:1.cnHint: 师尊提醒我第一堂课____在日出时分开始，我彻夜未眠地等待着。
due:1.hook: The horn had no name, and no one else seemed to hear it.
due:1.line: 'Your trial is *due* before the last cloud clears — do not be late.'

sentences.en: The morning bell rang across the stone courtyard.
sentences.cn: 晨钟在石砌的院落里敲响。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the gate, her white robe still in the windless air.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在门前，白色的袍子在无风的空气中纹丝不动。

sentences.en: 'Your first lesson is *due* at sunrise,' she said.
I had not slept.
sentences.cn: 我没睡过。

sentences.en: The sky above the sea of clouds burned faint gold, and somewhere below, a horn sounded — low, slow, and without cause.
sentences.cn: 云海上方的天空烧出淡淡的金色，远处某处传来号角声——低沉、缓慢，无缘无故。

seek:1.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a folded leaf into my hand outside the herb hall. 'If you ever lose the word for wind, go to the eastern cliff and *seek* it in the grass,' he said, then walked away without looking back. The leaf held a single character I could not yet read. That night, the eastern cliff lit up — pale green, steady, like a held breath.
seek:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，如果忘记了某个词语，就去东边的悬崖____它。
seek:1.hook: The pale green light pulsed once, then spelled a shape I almost knew.
seek:1.line: 'We do not wait for wisdom here — we *seek* it before dawn finds us.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a folded leaf into my hand outside the herb hall.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在药草殿外把一片折好的叶子塞进我的手心。

sentences.en: 'If you ever lose the word for wind, go to the eastern cliff and *seek* it in the grass,' he said, then walked away without looking back.
The leaf held a single character I could not yet read.
sentences.cn: 叶片上写着一个我还认不出来的字。

sentences.en: That night, the eastern cliff lit up — pale green, steady, like a held breath.
sentences.cn: 那天晚上，东崖亮了起来——淡绿色的光，稳定而柔和，像一口被屏住的呼吸。

teach:2.en: Deep beneath the floating mountain, I found an old jade tablet half-buried in pale roots. Its carved signs glowed faintly — someone had placed it here on purpose. Master Qingwu once said the sect would *teach* only those who first sought knowledge alone. Perhaps this hidden chamber was never hidden at all.
teach:2.cnHint: 我在山底发现了一块玉简，似乎是宗门故意留下的，用来____那些主动寻道之人。
teach:2.hook: A second tablet lay deeper still, and it bore my name.
teach:2.line: 'I will *teach* you nothing you are not already reaching for,' Master Qingwu had written.

sentences.en: Deep beneath the floating mountain, I found an old jade tablet half-buried in pale roots.
sentences.cn: 在浮山的深处，我发现了一块半埋在苍白根系中的古玉片。

sentences.en: Its carved signs glowed faintly — someone had placed it here on purpose.
sentences.cn: 它上面刻的符号微微发亮——有人故意把它放在这里。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu once said the sect would *teach* only those who first sought knowledge alone.
Perhaps this hidden chamber was never hidden at all.
sentences.cn: 也许这间密室从来就没被隐藏过。

push:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread a worn map across the stone floor of the relay cave. Red marks traced a broad sweep from the western peaks to the cloud-sea shore. 'This is the sect's great *push*,' he said quietly — a season-long effort to reclaim five lost herb fields before the cold winds returned. My hands felt suddenly heavy.
push:2.cnHint: 师兄在中转洞中展示了地图，解释宗门即将展开一场大规模的____，以夺回失去的药田。
push:2.hook: One of the five fields, I noticed, was marked with a skull.
push:2.line: 'The *push* begins at dawn — and you will carry the first token,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread a worn map across the stone floor of the relay cave.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把一张陈旧的地图铺在中继洞的石地板上。

sentences.en: Red marks traced a broad sweep from the western peaks to the cloud-sea shore.
sentences.cn: 红色的标记从西边的山峰一直延伸到云海岸边，勾勒出一大片区域。

sentences.en: 'This is the sect's great *push*,' he said quietly — a season-long effort to reclaim five lost herb fields before the cold winds returned.
My hands felt suddenly heavy.
sentences.cn: 我的手突然感到沉甸甸的。

stick:0.en: Master Qingwu laid a single ink-brushed scroll on the stone table before me. 'Every word you learn must *stick*,' she said, pressing one finger to the page until the ink seemed to glow. I copied the character seven times, and on the seventh, the paper held a faint warmth long after my brush lifted.
stick:0.cnHint: 师尊告诫我，学到的每个词都要____在心中，我抄写第七遍时，纸上出现了奇异的温热。
stick:0.hook: The warmth spread to my fingertips, and the candle flame bent toward the scroll.
stick:0.line: 'Let the meaning *stick* to your bones before you dare speak the formula aloud.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu laid a single ink-brushed scroll on the stone table before me.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石桌前摊开了一张墨笔书写的卷轴。

sentences.en: 'Every word you learn must *stick*,' she said, pressing one finger to the page until the ink seemed to glow.
I copied the character seven times, and on the seventh, the paper held a faint warmth long after my brush lifted.
sentences.cn: 我把那个字抄了七遍，第七遍时，纸张在我放下笔后还保持着淡淡的温度。
